title.zh: 卷520 列傳三百七 藩部三 四子部落 茂明安 喀尔喀右翼 乌拉特 鄂尔多斯 阿拉善 额济纳
title.en: Volume 520 Biographies 307: Frontier Dependencies 3: Dorben Khuukhed, Muminggan, Ka Er Ka You Yi, Urad, Ordos, Alashan, Ejin
title.raw: 卷520 列傳三百七 藩部三 四子部落 茂明安 喀尔喀右翼 乌拉特 鄂尔多斯 阿拉善 额济纳

sentences.zh: 四子部落，在張家口外，至京師九百六十里。

translations.literal: The Dorben tribe was beyond Zhangjiakou, nine hundred and sixty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Dorben tribe lay beyond Zhangjiakou, nine hundred and sixty li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距二百三十五里，南北距二百四十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measured two hundred and thirty-five li; north to south, two hundred and forty li.
translations.idiomatic: It extended two hundred and thirty-five li from east to west and two hundred and forty li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東及北蘇尼特，西歸化城土默特，南察哈爾鑲紅旗牧廠。

translations.literal: On the east and north it bordered the Sonid; on the west, the Tumet of Guihua; on the south, the Chahar Bordered Red Banner pasture.
translations.idiomatic: To the east and north lay the Sonid; to the west, the Tumet of Guihua; to the south, the Chahar Bordered Red Banner grazing grounds.

sentences.zh: 元太祖弟哈布圖哈薩爾十五世孫諾延泰與其兄昆都倫岱青遊牧呼倫貝爾，均稱阿嚕蒙古。

translations.literal: Noyan Tai, fifteenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan's brother Khabutu Hasar, and his elder brother Kundulen Daiqing pastured in Hulun Buir; both were styled Aru Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Noyan Tai, a fifteenth-generation descendant of Khabutu Hasar, younger brother of Genghis Khan, and his elder brother Kundulen Daiqing grazed their herds in Hulun Buir; both were known as Aru Mongols.

sentences.zh: 昆都倫岱青裔詳阿嚕科爾沁部傳。

translations.literal: The line of Kundulen Daiqing is treated in detail in the biography of the Ar Khorchin tribe.
translations.idiomatic: The descendants of Kundulen Daiqing are covered in the Ar Khorchin tribe biography.

sentences.zh: 諾延泰子四：長僧格，號墨爾根和碩齊；

translations.literal: Noyan Tai had four sons: the eldest, Sengge, styled Mergen Khoshuu;
translations.idiomatic: Noyan Tai had four sons. The eldest, Sengge, took the title Mergen Khoshuu;

sentences.zh: 次索諾木，號達爾漢台吉；

translations.literal: the second, Sonom, styled Darhan Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: the second, Sonom, styled Darhan Taiji;

sentences.zh: 次鄂木布，號布庫台吉；

translations.literal: the third, Emebu, styled Buku Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: the third, Emebu, styled Buku Taiji;

sentences.zh: 次伊爾劄木，號墨爾根台吉。

translations.literal: the fourth, Irzamu, styled Mergen Taiji.
translations.idiomatic: the fourth, Irzamu, styled Mergen Taiji.

sentences.zh: 四子分牧而處，後遂為其部稱。

translations.literal: The four sons pastured separately, and their divisions later became the name of the tribe.
translations.idiomatic: The four sons grazed in separate districts, and in time their divisions gave the tribe its name.

sentences.zh: 天聰四年，阿嚕諸部長內附，伊爾紮木來獻駝馬貂皮，賜宴，命坐大貝勒代善右以優異之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tiancong, the chiefs of the Aru tribes submitted; Irzamu came to present camels, horses, and sable fur, was given a feast, and was ordered to sit to the right of the great beile Daišan as a mark of favor.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 4, the chiefs of the Aru tribes submitted. Irzamu presented camels, horses, and sable pelts, was feasted, and was seated to the right of the great beile Daišan in special honor.

sentences.zh: 五年，僧格從征明大淩河，敗錦州援兵，獻俘百餘。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Sengge followed the campaign against the Ming at Dalinghe, defeated the Jinzhou relief force, and presented more than a hundred captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Sengge joined the campaign against the Ming at Dalinghe, routed the Jinzhou relief army, and presented more than a hundred captives.

sentences.zh: 賜酒勞飲，給陣獲甲仗。

translations.literal: Wine was bestowed to reward the troops; armor and weapons taken in battle were given.
translations.idiomatic: They were rewarded with wine, and armor and weapons captured in the field were granted to them.

sentences.zh: 六年，僧格從征察哈爾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Sengge followed the campaign against the Chahar.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Sengge joined the expedition against the Chahar.

sentences.zh: 七年，索諾木、鄂木布、伊爾紮木相繼獻駝馬，賚甲胄、雕鞍、鞓帶及幣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Sonom, Emebu, and Irzamu presented camels and horses in succession; they were granted armor, carved saddles, belts, and silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Sonom, Emebu, and Irzamu presented camels and horses in turn and received armor, carved saddles, belts, and silks.

sentences.zh: 八年，鄂木布、伊爾紮木復獻駝馬，命諸貝勒以次宴之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Emebu and Irzamu again presented camels and horses; the princes were ordered to entertain them in turn.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Emebu and Irzamu again presented camels and horses, and the beiles were ordered to feast them in succession.

sentences.zh: 尋遣大臣赴碩翁科爾定諸籓牧，以都木達都騰格里克、鄂多爾台為其部牧界。

translations.literal: Soon a minister was sent to Shuangong Keer to fix the pasture boundaries of the banners; Dudumdad Tenggerik and Edor Tai were set as the tribe's pasture limits.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward a minister went to Shuangong Keer to fix the grazing boundaries of the banners, with Dudumdad Tenggerik and Edor Tai as the tribe's pasture borders.

sentences.zh: 九年夏，伊爾紮木隨大軍收察哈爾汗子額哲，盡降其眾。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, summer, Irzamu followed the main army to receive Erje, son of the Chahar khan, and all his people submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, summer, Irzamu followed the main army to receive Erje, son of the Chahar khan, and all his followers surrendered.

sentences.zh: 冬，獻駝馬、貂皮。

translations.literal: In winter he presented camels, horses, and sable fur.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he presented camels, horses, and sable pelts.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，宣諭朝鮮，其部伊爾遜德齎書從，遇明皮島兵，擊斬二人，還，得優賚。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, when an edict was proclaimed to Korea, Yiersunde of the tribe carried the letter; encountering Ming troops from Pidao, he killed two men and returned, and received generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1, when an edict was sent to Korea, Yiersunde of the tribe carried the dispatch; he met Ming troops from Pidao, killed two men, and on his return received generous rewards.

sentences.zh: 是年，授鄂木布扎薩克，俾統四子部落。

translations.literal: That year Emebu was appointed zasak and made to command the Dorben tribe.
translations.idiomatic: That year Emebu was appointed zasak and placed in command of the Dorben tribe.

sentences.zh: 三年，伊爾紮木從征明山東。

translations.literal: In the third year, Irzamu followed the campaign against Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Irzamu joined the Shandong campaign.

sentences.zh: 四年，從征松山。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed the campaign at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he joined the Songshan campaign.

sentences.zh: 師旋，以前遣兵不及額，又弗朝正，議奪所屬人戶。

translations.literal: When the army returned, because troops previously sent had not met the quota and he had failed to attend the New Year audience, it was proposed to strip him of his subjects.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, because the troops he had sent earlier fell short of the quota and he had failed to attend the New Year audience, officials proposed stripping him of his households.

sentences.zh: 詔從寬罰牲畜。

translations.literal: An edict imposed the lighter penalty of a livestock fine.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered the lighter penalty of a fine in livestock.

sentences.zh: 五年，來朝，賚甲胄、弓矢、采幣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he came to court and was granted armor, bows and arrows, and silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he came to court and received armor, bows and arrows, and silks.

sentences.zh: 六年，上親征明，圍松山，其部將都爾拜隨大軍設伏高橋及桑阿爾齋堡，追杏山逃卒，獲之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the emperor campaigned in person against the Ming and besieged Songshan; the tribal commander Dorbai of his tribe followed the main army to set an ambush at Gaoqiao and Sangerzhai Fort, pursued fugitives from Xingshan, and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the emperor led a personal campaign against the Ming and besieged Songshan; the tribal commander Dorbai followed the main army in ambush at Gaoqiao and Sangerzhai Fort and pursued fugitives from Xingshan until they were taken.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入山海關，擊流賊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry through Shanhai Pass and attacked the bandit Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he followed the army through Shanhai Pass and attacked the rebel Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 六年四月，追敍所屬昂安導鄂木布等來歸功，予世職。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixth year, in recognition of Ang'an of his tribe guiding Emebu and others in submission, a hereditary office was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year, Ang'an of his tribe was rewarded posthumously for guiding Emebu and others in submission, and a hereditary office was granted.

sentences.zh: 康熙十年，所部歉收，詔以宣府及歸化城儲粟賑之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Kangxi his tribe suffered a poor harvest; an edict ordered grain stored at Xuanfu and Guihua to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 10 the tribe suffered crop failure; an edict ordered grain from the Xuanfu and Guihua stores distributed to them.

sentences.zh: 十三年，調兵協剿陝西叛賊王輔臣，諭嘉其聞命即赴。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year troops were mobilized to help suppress the Shaanxi rebel Wang Fuchen; they were praised for setting out as soon as the order arrived.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year troops were sent to help suppress the Shaanxi rebel Wang Fuchen, and they were commended for marching as soon as the order came.

sentences.zh: 十四年，由寧夏進剿，尋分防太原、大同。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year they advanced from Ningxia to pursue the rebels and were then posted to guard Taiyuan and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year they advanced from Ningxia against the rebels and were then assigned to garrison Taiyuan and Datong.

sentences.zh: 十五年，調赴河南，聽江西大軍檄剿逆籓吳三桂。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year they were transferred to Henan and, on orders from the Jiangxi main army, joined the campaign against the rebel prince Wu Sangui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year they were moved to Henan and, at the Jiangxi army's order, joined the campaign against the rebel prince Wu Sangui.

sentences.zh: 十七年，以厄魯特額爾德尼和碩齊等掠烏喇特牧，諭嚴防汛。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, because the Oirat Erdeni Khoshuu and others raided Urad pastures, they were ordered to tighten frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, after Oirat Erdeni Khoshuu and others raided Urad pastures, they were ordered to tighten frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，詔發大同、宣府儲粟賑所屬貧戶，復以察哈爾牧產贍之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year an edict ordered grain from the Datong and Xuanfu stores distributed to poor households of the tribe, and Chahar pasture products were again given to sustain them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year an edict released grain from Datong and Xuanfu stores to poor households of the tribe, and Chahar pasture products were again allotted for their relief.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，選兵赴圖拉河偵噶爾丹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year selected troops were sent to scout Galdan on the Tula River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year selected troops were sent to scout Galdan along the Tula River.

sentences.zh: 會噶爾丹由喀爾喀河追襲昆都倫博碩克圖袞布，詔移兵駐歸化城，尋撤還。

translations.literal: When Galdan pursued and attacked Gombojab of Khalkha along the Khalkha River, an edict ordered troops moved to garrison Guihua; they were soon withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: When Galdan pursued Gombojab of Khalkha along the Khalkha River, troops were ordered to Guihua but soon withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，諭備兵聽西路軍調。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year they were ordered to keep troops ready for western-route army assignments.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year they were told to keep troops ready for assignment by the western-route army.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，隨大將軍費揚古敗噶爾丹於昭莫多，復簡兵百與茂明安兵百防喀爾喀親王善巴汛。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year they followed Grand Marshal Fiyanggu in defeating Galdan at Jao Modo, and a hundred men were again selected with a hundred from Muminggan to guard the Khalkha prince Shanba's post.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year they followed Grand Marshal Fiyanggu in defeating Galdan at Jao Modo, and another hundred men were chosen with a hundred from Muminggan to guard Prince Shanba of Khalkha's post.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，朔漠平，賜從征及坐塘監牧諸弁兵銀。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year the northern deserts were pacified; silver was granted to officers and soldiers who had campaigned and to those who manned relay stations and guarded pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year the northern deserts were pacified, and silver was granted to campaign officers and soldiers and to those who manned relay posts and guarded pastures.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，從剿噶爾丹策淩。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongzheng they joined the campaign against Galdan Tseren.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9 they joined the campaign against Galdan Tseren.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十一年，賑是部災。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Qianlong relief was given for disaster in the tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 11 relief was granted for disaster in the tribe.

sentences.zh: 十八年，議剿達瓦齊，詔購駝馬送軍。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when a campaign against Dawachi was planned, an edict ordered camels and horses purchased and sent to the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when a campaign against Dawachi was planned, they were ordered to supply camels and horses for the army.

sentences.zh: 所部一旗，駐烏蘭額爾濟坡。

translations.literal: The tribe had one banner, stationed at Ulan Erji Po.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe comprised one banner, based at Ulan Erji Po.

sentences.zh: 其爵為扎薩克多羅達爾漢卓哩克圖郡王。

translations.literal: Its rank was zasak Doroi Darhan Joliktu junwang.
translations.idiomatic: Its noble rank was zasak Doroi Darhan Joliktu junwang.

sentences.zh: 同治中，以回匪東竄，命副都統杜嘎爾軍擇駐其地，以當漠南北之沖。

translations.literal: In the Tongzhi era, as Muslim rebels raided eastward, Vice Commander-in-chief Dugar was ordered to choose a garrison in their territory to hold the pass between north and south of the desert.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongzhi era, as Muslim rebels pushed east, Vice Commander-in-chief Dugar was ordered to station troops in their territory to guard the desert corridor.

sentences.zh: 徵駝馬備防戍襄台差，皆較他部為亟。

translations.literal: Requisitions of camels and horses for frontier defense and relay service were more urgent than in other tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Calls for camels and horses for frontier defense and relay duty were heavier than in other tribes.

sentences.zh: 光緒十一年，察哈爾都統紹祺以勘土默特、達拉特爭界事經其部，奏：「四子王旗幫台駝馬，自同治年間藉詞西北軍興，差役繁重，潛自回旗，至今十餘年之久，屢催罔應。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Guangxu, Chahar commander Shaoji, surveying a boundary dispute between the Tumet and Dorbet, passed through the tribe and memorialized: "The Dorben Wang banner's relay camels and horses, since the Tongzhi period citing the northwestern military emergency and heavy corvee, have quietly returned to Muslim banners for more than ten years and repeatedly ignore summons."
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 11, Chahar commander Shaoji, investigating a Tumet-Dorbet boundary dispute, passed through the tribe and reported: "The Dorben Wang banner's relay camels and horses, since Tongzhi citing northwestern warfare and heavy corvee, have quietly shifted to Muslim banners for more than ten years and ignore repeated summons."

sentences.zh: 所屬部落，聞私墾者十已七八。

translations.literal: Of the tribes under them, it was said seven or eight in ten were privately cultivating land.
translations.idiomatic: It was said seven or eight tenths of their subordinate tribes were privately opening land to cultivation.

sentences.zh: 請下理籓院嚴催。

translations.literal: He asked that the Court of Colonial Affairs be ordered to press them strictly.
translations.idiomatic: He asked the Court of Colonial Affairs to press them strictly.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved the request.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳、教相仇，是部釀禍頗钜。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, as the Boxers and Christians clashed, the tribe suffered serious disturbances.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, when Boxers and Christians clashed, the tribe saw major unrest.

sentences.zh: 事定，議給教堂賠款銀十一萬兩。

translations.literal: After order was restored, an indemnity of one hundred and ten thousand taels of silver for churches was imposed.
translations.idiomatic: After order returned, they were assessed one hundred and ten thousand taels of silver in church indemnities.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，置山西武川廳同知，以是部及茂明安、喀爾喀右翼寄居人民村落隸之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year a sub-prefect of Wuchuan in Shanxi was established, and settled villages of the tribe together with Muminggan and Khalkha Right Wing were placed under him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year a Wuchuan sub-prefect in Shanxi was created, and settled villages of the tribe with Muminggan and Khalkha Right Wing were placed under his jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 自回匪平，山西大同鎮練軍駐其地，設防卡。

translations.literal: After the Muslim rebels were pacified, trained troops of the Datong garrison in Shanxi were stationed there and defense posts were set up.
translations.idiomatic: After the Muslim rebellion was suppressed, trained troops from the Shanxi Datong garrison were posted there with defense checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 其後綏遠城將軍督辦墾務，貽穀屢奏請飭認墾。

translations.literal: Later the Suiyuan general supervised land reclamation, and Yigu repeatedly memorialized urging recognition of opened land.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Suiyuan general supervised reclamation, and Yigu repeatedly urged the banners to register opened land.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，是部呈因債作抵之忽濟爾圖地一段，請由官局放墾。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the tribe reported a tract at Hujieritu pledged for debt and asked the government to open it for settlement.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year the tribe reported a tract at Hujieritu pledged for debt and asked official reclamation.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，呈所部之察罕依嚕格勒圖地段認墾。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year it reported the Chahan Ilu Geleitu tract for registered reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year it reported the Chahan Ilu Geleitu tract for registered reclamation.

sentences.zh: 有佐領二十。

translations.literal: There were twenty assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: It had twenty assistant commandants.

sentences.zh: 是部與茂明安、喀爾喀右翼、烏喇特同盟於烏蘭察布。

translations.literal: The tribe joined Muminggan, Khalkha Right Wing, and Urad in alliance at Ulan Chab.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe allied with Muminggan, Khalkha Right Wing, and Urad in the Ulan Chab league.

sentences.zh: 綏遠城將軍節制烏蘭察布、伊克昭二盟，故重大事件皆由將軍專奏焉。

translations.literal: The Suiyuan general controlled the Ulan Chab and Ike Zhao leagues, so major matters were memorialized by the general alone.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Suiyuan general oversaw the Ulan Chab and Ike Zhao leagues, major affairs were reported by the general directly.

sentences.zh: 茂明安部，在張家口外，至京師千二百四十里。

translations.literal: The Muminggan tribe lay beyond Zhangjiakou, one thousand two hundred and forty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Muminggan tribe was beyond Zhangjiakou, one thousand two hundred and forty li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距百里，南北距百九十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measured one hundred li; north to south, one hundred and ninety li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured one hundred li east to west and one hundred and ninety li north to south.

sentences.zh: 東喀爾喀右翼，西烏喇特，南歸化城土默特，北瀚海。

translations.literal: East, Khalkha Right Wing; west, Urad; south, Tumet of Guihua; north, the desert sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the east lay Khalkha Right Wing; to the west, Urad; to the south, the Tumet of Guihua; to the north, the desert.

sentences.zh: 元太祖弟哈布圖哈薩爾十三世孫鄂爾圖鼐布延圖子錫喇奇塔特，號土謝圖汗。

translations.literal: Siratai, thirteenth-generation descendant of Khabutu Hasar, son of Ertu Nembu Yan, styled Tusiyetu Khan.
translations.idiomatic: Siratai, thirteenth-generation descendant of Khabutu Hasar and son of Ertu Nembu Yan, styled Tusiyetu Khan.

sentences.zh: 有子三：長多爾濟，次固穆巴圖魯，次桑阿爾濟洪果爾，遊牧呼倫貝爾，均稱阿嚕蒙古。

translations.literal: He had three sons: the eldest Dorji, the second Gum Batulu, and the third Sang'arji Honggoer; they pastured in Hulun Buir and were all styled Aru Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: He had three sons—Dorji, Gum Batulu, and Sang'arji Honggoer—who pastured in Hulun Buir and were styled Aru Mongols.

sentences.zh: 多爾濟號布顏圖汗。

translations.literal: Dorji styled himself Buyantu Khan.
translations.idiomatic: Dorji styled himself Buyantu Khan.

sentences.zh: 子車根，嗣為茂明安部長。

translations.literal: His son Chegen succeeded as chief of the Muminggan tribe.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chegen succeeded as chief of Muminggan.

sentences.zh: 天聰七年，偕固倫巴圖魯暨台吉達爾瑪岱袞、烏巴什等攜戶千餘來歸，獻駝馬。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tiancong, together with Gulen Batulu and the taiji Darmadaigun, Ubasi, and others, he brought more than a thousand households to submit and presented camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 7, together with Gulen Batulu and the taiji Darmadaigun, Ubasi, and others, he brought more than a thousand households to submit and presented camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 八年，台吉揚固海杜淩、烏巴海、達爾漢巴圖魯、瑚棱、都喇勒、巴特瑪、額爾忻岱青、阿布泰繼至，均賜宴，賚甲胄、雕鞍、銀幣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the taiji Yangguhai Dulun, Ubahai, Darhan Batulu, Huleng, Dural, Batma, Erxin Daiqing, and Abutai arrived in succession; all were feasted and granted armor, carved saddles, and silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the taiji Yangguhai Dulun, Ubahai, Darhan Batulu, Huleng, Dural, Batma, Erxin Daiqing, and Abutai arrived in turn; all were feasted and given armor, carved saddles, and silver.

sentences.zh: 九年，烏巴海、達爾漢巴圖魯、都喇勒叛逃喀爾喀，遣兵由鄂諾河往剿，至阿古庫克特勒，斬叛屬千餘；

translations.literal: In the ninth year Ubahai, Darhan Batulu, and Dural rebelled and fled to Khalkha; troops were sent by the Onon River to pursue them, and at Agu Koktele more than a thousand rebels were beheaded;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Ubahai, Darhan Batulu, and Dural rebelled and fled to Khalkha; troops sent along the Onon River reached Agu Koktele and beheaded more than a thousand rebels;

sentences.zh: 追至喀木尼哈，盡俘以還。

translations.literal: pursuit continued to Khamniha, and all captives were brought back.
translations.idiomatic: the pursuit continued to Khamniha and all captives were brought back.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，巴特瑪、瑚棱等從征喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗，偵遁，乃還。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde, Batma, Huleng, and others followed the campaign against the Zasakhtu Khan of Khalkha; finding him fled, they returned.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3, Batma, Huleng, and others joined the campaign against the Zasakhtu Khan of Khalkha; when he fled they returned.

sentences.zh: 嗣征明山東，及蘇尼特、喀爾喀，皆以兵從。

translations.literal: Later they followed campaigns in Shandong and against the Sonid and Khalkha with troops.
translations.idiomatic: They later supplied troops for campaigns in Shandong and against the Sonid and Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，授車根長子僧格扎薩克，俾統其眾。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi, Chegen's eldest son Sengge was appointed zasak to command the tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3, Chegen's eldest son Sengge was appointed zasak to command the tribe.

sentences.zh: 十三年，調兵剿陝西叛鎮王輔臣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year troops were mobilized to suppress the Shaanxi rebel commander Wang Fuchen.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year troops were sent to suppress the Shaanxi rebel commander Wang Fuchen.

sentences.zh: 十四年，駐防大同。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year they garrisoned Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year they garrisoned Datong.

sentences.zh: 十五年，調赴河南，聽江西大軍檄剿逆籓吳三桂。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year they were transferred to Henan and, on orders from the Jiangxi main army, joined the campaign against the rebel prince Wu Sangui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year they were moved to Henan and, at the Jiangxi army's order, joined the campaign against the rebel prince Wu Sangui.

sentences.zh: 十九年，以厄魯特羅卜

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, because the Oirat Lob
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, because the Oirat Lob

sentences.zh: 藏丹台吉等掠其部牧產，遣官諭厄魯特察歸所掠。

translations.literal: zang Dan Taiji and others raided the tribe's herds, officials were sent to instruct the Oirat to investigate and return what was seized.
translations.idiomatic: zang Dan Taiji and others had raided the tribe's herds, officials were sent to instruct the Oirat to investigate and restore the plunder.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，諭嚴防汛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Galdan invaded Khalkha; they were ordered to tighten frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, when Galdan invaded Khalkha, they were ordered to tighten frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，噶爾丹襲喀爾喀昆都倫博碩克圖袞布，逾烏勒紮河，詔選兵駐歸化城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Galdan attacked Gombojab of Khalkha, crossed the Uldza River, and troops were selected to garrison Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Galdan attacked Gombojab of Khalkha, crossed the Uldza River, and selected troops were posted at Guihua.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，從西路大軍擊噶爾丹。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year they followed the western-route main army against Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year they followed the western-route main army against Galdan.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，朔漠平，賜從征弁兵銀。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year the northern deserts were pacified; silver was granted to campaigning officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year the northern deserts were pacified and silver was granted to campaigning officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，所部歉收，以呼坦和朔儲粟賑之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year the tribe suffered a poor harvest; grain stored at Hutang and Hoshuo was used to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year the tribe suffered crop failure and grain from Hutang and Hoshuo stores was distributed to them.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，從剿噶爾丹策淩，分兵赴固爾班賽堪駐防。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongzheng they joined the campaign against Galdan Tseren and detachments were sent to garrison Gurban Saikhan.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9 they joined the campaign against Galdan Tseren and detachments garrisoned Gurban Saikhan.

sentences.zh: 十年，移駐伯格爾。

translations.literal: In the tenth year they moved to Boerger.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year they moved to Boerger.

sentences.zh: 十三年，撤還。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 所部一旗，駐牧徹特塞哩，隸烏蘭察布盟。

translations.literal: The tribe had one banner, pasturing at Chete Seeri, subordinate to the Ulan Chab league.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe had one banner pasturing at Chete Seeri, subordinate to the Ulan Chab league.

sentences.zh: 爵二：扎薩克一等台吉一，附多羅貝勒一。

translations.literal: There were two ranks: one zasak of the first-class taiji, and one attached doroi beile.
translations.idiomatic: Noble ranks were two: one first-class taiji zasak and one attached doroi beile.

sentences.zh: 道光十二年，與土默特爭界，命松筠往勘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Daoguang, in a boundary dispute with the Tumet, Songyun was sent to survey.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 12, in a boundary dispute with the Tumet, Songyun was sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 八月，覆奏茂明安及達爾漢貝勒等所爭土默特遊牧，有乾隆年間原案、原圖，並所設封堆鄂博，向該台吉等逐加指示，心俱輸服。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the follow-up memorial stated that for pasture disputed by Muminggan and the Darhan beile with the Tumet there were Qianlong-era original cases, maps, and boundary cairns, which were shown in turn to the taiji, who all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the follow-up reported that pasture disputed by Muminggan and the Darhan beile with the Tumet had Qianlong cases, maps, and boundary cairns, which were shown to the taiji in turn until all acquiesced.

sentences.zh: 令按舊定界址各守遊牧，毋相侵越。

translations.literal: They were ordered to keep to the old boundaries for grazing and not encroach on one another.
translations.idiomatic: They were ordered to graze within the old boundaries and not encroach.

sentences.zh: 同治中，回匪東竄，是部被擾。

translations.literal: In the Tongzhi era, as Muslim rebels raided eastward, the tribe was disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: During Tongzhi, as Muslim rebels raided eastward, the tribe was harassed.

sentences.zh: 九年十二月，綏遠城將軍定安奏獲茂明安等旗肆掠馬賊巴噶安爾等，誅之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the ninth year, Suiyuan general Ding'an memorialized the capture and execution of the Muminggan banner horse-thief Baga'aner and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the ninth year, Suiyuan general Ding'an reported capturing and executing the Muminggan banner horse-thieves Baga'aner and others.

sentences.zh: 十年，茂明安扎薩克綽克巴達爾琥等，以違砲台站議處。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Muminggan zasak Chokbadarhu and others were punished for violating the battery-station agreement.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Muminggan zasak Chokbadarhu and others were punished for breaching the battery-station agreement.

sentences.zh: 是年，肅州回匪東竄烏拉特境，定安遣侍衛成山統吉林馬隊駐是部。

translations.literal: That year, as Suzhou Muslim rebels raided east into Urad territory, Ding'an sent the guardsman Chengshan with Jilin cavalry to station in the tribe.
translations.idiomatic: That year, when Suzhou Muslim rebels raided east into Urad territory, Ding'an sent guardsman Chengshan with Jilin cavalry to the tribe.

sentences.zh: 光緒末，綏遠城將軍貽穀督墾，勸諭報地。

translations.literal: Late in Guangxu the Suiyuan general Yigu supervised reclamation and urged registration of land.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Guangxu, Suiyuan general Yigu supervised reclamation and urged land registration.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，呈交水壕、帳房塔兩處地段認墾。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year it reported the Shuigou and Zhangfangta tracts for registered reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year it reported the Shuigou and Zhangfangta tracts for registered reclamation.

sentences.zh: 實則是部租給商民墾地頗多，境內漢民村落亦眾。

translations.literal: In fact the tribe had leased much land to Han merchants for cultivation, and Han villages within its territory were numerous.
translations.idiomatic: In practice the tribe had leased much land to Han merchants for cultivation, and Han villages within its borders were numerous.

sentences.zh: 有佐領四。

translations.literal: There were four assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: It had four assistant commandants.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀右翼部，在張家口外，至京師千一百三十里。

translations.literal: The Khalkha Right Wing tribe lay beyond Zhangjiakou, one thousand one hundred and thirty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Khalkha Right Wing tribe was beyond Zhangjiakou, one thousand one hundred and thirty li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距百二十里，南北距百三十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measured one hundred and twenty li; north to south, one hundred and thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured one hundred and twenty li east to west and one hundred and thirty li north to south.

sentences.zh: 東四子部落，西茂明安，南歸化城土默特，北瀚海。

translations.literal: East, the Dorben tribe; west, Muminggan; south, the Tumet of Guihua; north, the desert sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the east lay the Dorben tribe; to the west, Muminggan; to the south, the Tumet of Guihua; to the north, the desert.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十六世孫格哷森紮紮賚爾琿台吉，有子七，號喀爾喀七旗，分東、西、中三路，以三汗掌之。

translations.literal: Gersenjazai Erkhuutaiji, sixteenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, had seven sons styled the seven Khalkha banners, divided into eastern, western, and central routes under three khans.
translations.idiomatic: Gersenjazai Erkhuutaiji, a sixteenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, had seven sons who formed the seven Khalkha banners on eastern, western, and central routes under three khans.

sentences.zh: 其第三子諾諾和偉徵諾顏，有子二：長阿巴泰，號鄂齊賴賽因汗，為中路土謝圖汗祖；

translations.literal: His third son Nonuho Wezheng Noyan had two sons: the eldest Abatai, styled Okilai Sain Khan, ancestor of the central-route Tusiyetu Khan;
translations.idiomatic: His third son Nonuho Wezheng Noyan had two sons—the eldest Abatai, styled Okilai Sain Khan, ancestor of the central Tusiyetu Khan—

sentences.zh: 次阿布琥，號墨爾根諾顏。

translations.literal: the second Abuhu, styled Mergen Noyan.
translations.idiomatic: and the second Abuhu, styled Mergen Noyan.

sentences.zh: 子三：長昂噶海，襲父墨爾根號；

translations.literal: He had three sons: the eldest Anggahai inherited his father's Mergen title;
translations.idiomatic: He had three sons: Anggahai inherited the Mergen title;

sentences.zh: 次喇琥裏，號達賴諾顏，生本塔爾、巴什希、色爾濟、扎木素、額璘沁；

translations.literal: the second Rahuri, styled Dalai Noyan, fathered Bental, Bashixi, Serji, Zhamusu, and Elinqin;
translations.idiomatic: Rahuri, styled Dalai Noyan, fathered Bental, Bashixi, Serji, Zhamusu, and Elinqin;

sentences.zh: 次圖豪肯，號昆都倫諾楞，子車顏都朗，生袞布，皆為喀爾喀中路台吉，隸土謝圖汗。

translations.literal: the third Tuhaoken, styled Kundulen Nolun, whose son Cheyandulang bore Gunbu—all were central-route Khalkha taiji subordinate to the Tusiyetu Khan.
translations.idiomatic: and Tuhaoken, styled Kundulen Nolun, whose line through Cheyandulang and Gunbu were central-route Khalkha taiji under the Tusiyetu Khan.

sentences.zh: 順治十年二月，本塔爾以與土謝圖汗袞布隙，偕弟巴什希、扎木素、額璘沁及袞布，率戶千餘來歸。

translations.literal: In the second month of the tenth year of Shunzhi, because of a feud with the Tusiyetu Khan Gunbu, Bental came to submit with his brothers Bashixi, Zhamusu, Elinqin, and Gunbu, bringing more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 10, second month, Bental, at odds with Tusiyetu Khan Gunbu, submitted with brothers Bashixi, Zhamusu, Elinqin, and Gunbu, bringing more than a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 色爾濟獨留喀爾喀，其孫禮塔爾後來歸，授扎薩克台吉。

translations.literal: Serji alone remained in Khalkha; his grandson Litaer later submitted and was appointed zasak taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Serji stayed in Khalkha; his grandson Litaer later submitted and was made zasak taiji.

sentences.zh: 見土謝圖汗部傳。

translations.literal: See the biography of the Tusiyetu Khan tribe.
translations.idiomatic: See the Tusiyetu Khan tribe biography.

sentences.zh: 三月，詔封本塔爾為扎薩克和碩達爾漢親王，統其眾，賜牧塔嚕渾河，與內扎薩克諸部列，是為喀爾喀右翼。

translations.literal: In the third month an edict enfeoffed Bental as zasak hoshuo Darhan qinwang to command his people, granted pasture on the Tarluhun River, and ranked him with the inner zasaks—this was Khalkha Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Bental was enfeoffed zasak hoshuo Darhan qinwang, granted Tarluhun pasture, and ranked with inner zasaks as Khalkha Right Wing.

sentences.zh: 其稱左翼者，為貝勒袞布伊勒登，亦自喀爾喀來歸，受封在本塔爾後，互見其傳。

translations.literal: The so-called Left Wing was beile Gunbu Iledeng, who also came from Khalkha and was enfeoffed after Bental; see each biography.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha Left Wing was beile Gunbu Iledeng, who submitted after Bental; see the separate accounts.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十五年，喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗沙喇與土謝圖汗察琿多爾濟構釁，遣大臣蒞盟於庫倫伯勒齊爾，由歸化城齎糧往，詔所部扎薩克選駝助運。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Kangxi the Zasakhtu Khan Shara of Khalkha quarreled with the Tusiyetu Khan Chakhundorji; a minister went to Kulun Berkeqi'er to mediate, grain was sent from Guihua, and the tribe's zasaks were ordered to supply camels for transport.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 25 the Khalkha Zasakhtu Khan Shara feuded with Tusiyetu Khan Chakhundorji; a minister mediated at Kulun Berkeqi'er with grain from Guihua, and local zasaks were told to supply transport camels.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，選兵駐邊偵噶爾丹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year troops were selected to scout Galdan on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year frontier troops were chosen to scout Galdan.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，調赴圖拉河，酌留兵之半駐歸化城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year they were sent to the Tula River, with half the force left at Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year they went to the Tula River, leaving half the force at Guihua.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，詔發殺虎口倉粟賑其屬貧戶。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year grain from the Shashikou store was ordered distributed to poor households of the tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Shashikou store grain was released to poor households of the tribe.

sentences.zh: 三十五年五月，從大將軍費揚古由西路敗噶爾丹於昭莫多，凱旋，詔留軍營餘米給部眾。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the thirty-fifth year they followed Grand Marshal Fiyanggu on the western route to defeat Galdan at Jao Modo; on the triumphal return, surplus camp grain was granted to the tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the thirty-fifth year they followed Fiyanggu's western army to defeat Galdan at Jao Modo; on return, surplus camp grain was given to the tribe.

sentences.zh: 十月，發軍前馬瘠者留其地飼牧。

translations.literal: In the tenth month emaciated horses from the campaign were left there to recover.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month thin campaign horses were left to graze and recover.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，費揚古檄所部兵會大軍於喀爾喀郡王善巴界。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year Fiyanggu ordered the tribe's troops to join the main army at the border of Khalkha prince Shanba.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year Fiyanggu ordered tribal troops to the rendezvous at Prince Shanba of Khalkha's border.

sentences.zh: 師旋，賚從徵兵銀。

translations.literal: When the army returned, silver was granted to campaigning soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: After the campaign, silver was granted to the soldiers who had marched.

sentences.zh: 五十四年三月，因久雪傷牧產，詔發呼坦和朔儲粟賑之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifty-fourth year, because long snow had harmed pasture, grain from Hutang and Hoshuo stores was ordered distributed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifty-fourth year, after snow ruined pasture, Hutang and Hoshuo grain was distributed.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，大軍剿噶爾丹策淩，詔簡兵駐歸化城。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongzheng, when the main army campaigned against Galdan Tseren, selected troops were posted at Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9, during the campaign against Galdan Tseren, selected troops garrisoned Guihua.

sentences.zh: 十年，復隨鄂爾多斯郡王紮木揚駐烏喇特西界。

translations.literal: In the tenth year they again followed Ordos prince Zhamuyang to the western border of Urad.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year they again followed Ordos prince Zhamuyang to Urad's western border.

sentences.zh: 十三年，撤還。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年，遣大臣察閱備調兵，頒賞有差。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianlong a minister inspected ready troops and distributed rewards by rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 4 a minister inspected ready troops and granted graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 所部一旗，駐牧塔嚕渾河。

translations.literal: The tribe had one banner pasturing on the Tarluhun River.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe had one banner based on the Tarluhun River.

sentences.zh: 爵四：扎薩克多羅達爾漢貝勒一，由親王降襲；

translations.literal: There were four ranks: one zasak doroi darhan beile, demoted from prince;
translations.idiomatic: Noble ranks were four: one zasak doroi darhan beile, reduced from prince;

sentences.zh: 附固山卓哩克圖貝子一，由郡王降襲；

translations.literal: one attached gushan joliktu beizi, demoted from junwang;
translations.idiomatic: one attached gushan joliktu beizi, reduced from junwang;

sentences.zh: 固山貝子一；

translations.literal: one gushan beizi;
translations.idiomatic: one gushan beizi;

sentences.zh: 鎮國公一。

translations.literal: and one fuguo gong.
translations.idiomatic: and one fuguo gong.

sentences.zh: 道光十二年，與土默特爭界，松筠往勘，仍如舊界定之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Daoguang, in a boundary dispute with the Tumet, Songyun surveyed and the old boundary was upheld.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 12, in a Tumet boundary dispute, Songyun surveyed and upheld the old line.

sentences.zh: 同治十一年，肅州回匪東竄烏喇特，杜嘎爾遣侍衛永德率兵進駐是部之和林果爾一帶堵截之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, as Suzhou Muslim rebels raided east into Urad, Dugar sent guardsman Yongde with troops to block them in the Helinguo'er district of this tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 11, as Suzhou Muslim rebels raided into Urad, Dugar sent Yongde to block them at Helinguo'er in this tribe.

sentences.zh: 四月，杜嘎爾進軍剿竄賽盟阿爾必特公等旗之匪，飭是部與四子部落委員雇覓民駝趣應軍需。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Dugar advanced against rebels raiding the Alibitegong banners of the league and ordered this tribe and the Dorben tribe to hire civilian camels for army supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Dugar pursued rebels in the Alibitegong banners and ordered this tribe and Dorben to hire civilian camels for the army.

sentences.zh: 光緒末，議興西盟墾務。

translations.literal: Late in Guangxu, western-league reclamation was proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Guangxu, western-league reclamation was discussed.

sentences.zh: 是部報卓克蘇拉塔一帶地段認墾。

translations.literal: The tribe reported the Chokusulata tract for registered reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe reported the Chokusulata tract for registered reclamation.

sentences.zh: 有佐領四。

translations.literal: There were four assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: It had four assistant commandants.

sentences.zh: 烏喇特部，在歸化城西，至京師千五百二十里。

translations.literal: The Urad tribe lay west of Guihua, one thousand five hundred and twenty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Urad tribe was west of Guihua, one thousand five hundred and twenty li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距二百十五里，南北距三百里。

translations.literal: East to west it measured two hundred and fifteen li; north to south, three hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured two hundred and fifteen li east to west and three hundred li north to south.

sentences.zh: 東茂明安及歸化城土默特，西及南鄂爾多斯，北喀爾喀右翼。

translations.literal: East, Muminggan and the Tumet of Guihua; west and south, Ordos; north, Khalkha Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: To the east lay Muminggan and the Tumet of Guihua; to the west and south, Ordos; to the north, Khalkha Right Wing.

sentences.zh: 元太祖弟哈布圖哈薩爾十五世孫布林海，遊牧呼倫貝爾，號所部曰烏喇特。

translations.literal: Bulunhai, fifteenth-generation descendant of Khabutu Hasar, pastured in Hulun Buir and styled his tribe Urad.
translations.idiomatic: Bulunhai, fifteenth-generation descendant of Khabutu Hasar, pastured in Hulun Buir and named his tribe Urad.

sentences.zh: 子五：長賴噶，次布揚武，次阿爾薩瑚，次布嚕圖，次巴爾賽。

translations.literal: He had five sons: Laige, Buyangwu, Arsahu, Bultu, and Barsei.
translations.idiomatic: He had five sons: Laige, Buyangwu, Arsahu, Bultu, and Barsei.

sentences.zh: 後分烏喇特為三，賴噶孫鄂木布，巴爾賽次子哈尼斯青台吉之孫色棱，及第五子哈尼泰冰圖台吉之子圖巴，分領其眾，統號阿嚕蒙古。

translations.literal: Later Urad was divided into three: Laige's grandson Emebu, Barsei's second son Hanisinqing Taiji's grandson Seleng, and the fifth son Hanitai Bingtu Taiji's son Tuba each led a division, all styled Aru Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Urad was later split three ways among Emebu (Laige's line), Seleng (Barsei's line), and Tuba (Hanitai's line), all styled Aru Mongols.

sentences.zh: 天聰七年，率屬來歸，貢駝馬。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tiancong they led their subjects to submit and presented camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 7 they submitted with their followers and presented camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 八年，從大軍征明，由喀喇鄂博入得勝堡，略大同，克堡三、台一。

translations.literal: In the eighth year they followed the main army against the Ming, entered through Kara Ebo to Desheng Fort, raided Datong, and captured three forts and one platform.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year they joined the Ming campaign, entered by Kara Ebo through Desheng Fort, raided Datong, and took three forts and one platform.

sentences.zh: 師旋，以柰曼、翁牛特部違令罪各罰駝馬，詔分給所部。

translations.literal: When the army returned, the Naiman and Ongniud tribes were fined camels and horses for disobeying orders; an edict divided the penalties among Urad.
translations.idiomatic: On return, Naiman and Ongniud were fined camels and horses for disobedience; the penalties were divided among Urad.

sentences.zh: 嗣征朝鮮、喀爾喀及明錦州、松山、薊州，皆以兵從。

translations.literal: They later supplied troops for campaigns in Korea, Khalkha, and Ming Jinzhou, Songshan, and Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: They later sent troops to Korea, Khalkha, and Ming Jinzhou, Songshan, and Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 順治五年，敘功，時鄂木布、色棱已卒，以圖巴掌中旗，鄂木布子諤班掌前旗，色棱子巴克巴海掌後旗，各授扎薩克，封鎮國公、輔國公爵有差。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shunzhi, when merits were tallied, Emebu and Seleng had died; Tuba held the middle banner, Emebu's son Eban the front banner, and Seleng's son Bakbahai the rear banner; each was appointed zasak and enfeoffed as fuguo gong or fuguogong by rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 5, Emebu and Seleng being dead, Tuba held the middle banner, Eban the front, and Bakbahai the rear; each received zasak and ranked enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十六年，上閱兵盧溝橋，命其部來朝人從觀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Kangxi the emperor reviewed troops at Lugou Bridge and ordered tribesmen present at court to observe.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 26 the emperor reviewed troops at Lugou Bridge and had visiting tribesmen watch.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，諭嚴防汛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Galdan invaded Khalkha; they were ordered to tighten frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, when Galdan invaded Khalkha, they were ordered to tighten defenses.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，噶爾丹襲喀爾喀昆都倫博碩克圖袞布，逾烏勒紮河，命選兵駐歸化城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Galdan attacked Gombojab of Khalkha, crossed the Uldza River, and troops were selected for Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Galdan attacked Gombojab of Khalkha, crossed the Uldza, and troops were posted at Guihua.

sentences.zh: 三十年，以自厄魯特來歸之巴圖爾額爾克濟農和囉理叛逃，詔備兵五百偵剿。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year Batu Erke Jiyang Horoli, who had come from the Oirat, rebelled and fled; five hundred troops were ordered to scout and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year the Oirat defector Horoli rebelled and fled; five hundred troops were ordered to pursue.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，和囉理降，撤所備兵歸。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Horoli surrendered and the prepared troops returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Horoli surrendered and the troops returned.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，從西路大軍敗噶爾丹於昭莫多。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year they followed the western-route main army to defeat Galdan at Jao Modo.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year they followed the western army to defeat Galdan at Jao Modo.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，朔漠平，上由寧夏凱旋。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year the northern deserts were pacified and the emperor returned in triumph from Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year the northern deserts were pacified and the emperor returned triumphant from Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 四等台吉南春迎覲賀捷，稱旨，晉授一等台吉，並優賚從征及坐塘、監牧、鑿井諸弁兵。

translations.literal: Fourth-rank taiji Nanchun came to court to congratulate on the victory, pleased the throne, was promoted to first-rank taiji, and campaign troops and those who manned relays, guarded pasture, and dug wells were generously rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth-rank taiji Nanchun congratulated the victory, was promoted to first-rank taiji, and campaign and support troops were generously rewarded.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，以其屬有貧為盜者，諭諸扎薩克教養之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, because some subjects had turned to banditry from poverty, all zasaks were instructed to educate and support them.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year, with poverty driving some to banditry, zasaks were told to educate and support their people.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，所部歉收，以呼坦和朔儲粟賑之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year the tribe suffered a poor harvest; grain from Hutang and Hoshuo stores relieved them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year crop failure brought relief grain from Hutang and Hoshuo.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，大軍剿噶爾丹策淩，諭選兵防遊牧。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongzheng, when the main army campaigned against Galdan Tseren, they were ordered to select troops to guard pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9, during the campaign against Galdan Tseren, they were told to select troops to guard pastures.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十九年，議剿達瓦齊，詔購駝馬送軍。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Qianlong, when a campaign against Dawachi was planned, they were ordered to supply camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 19 they were ordered to supply camels and horses for the campaign against Dawachi.

sentences.zh: 所部三旗，駐牧哈達瑪爾。

translations.literal: The tribe had three banners pasturing at Hadama'er.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe had three banners based at Hadama'er.

sentences.zh: 爵三：扎薩克鎮國公二，輔國公一。

translations.literal: There were three ranks: two zasak fuguo gong and one fuguogong.
translations.idiomatic: Noble ranks were three: two zasak fuguo gong and one fuguogong.

sentences.zh: 是部墾事最先。

translations.literal: This tribe pioneered reclamation earliest.
translations.idiomatic: This tribe opened land to cultivation earliest.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十年，即將沿河牧地私租民人耕種。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Qianlong riverside pasture was already privately leased to Han cultivators.
translations.idiomatic: By Qianlong 30 riverside pasture was already leased to Han farmers.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，以積欠商人二萬兩，允佃種五年之限。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year, to settle a merchant debt of twenty thousand taels, tenancy for five years was allowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year, to cover a twenty-thousand-tael merchant debt, five years of tenancy were allowed.

sentences.zh: 道光十二年，扎薩克鎮國公巴圖鄂齊爾充烏蘭察布盟盟長，以茂明安等旗爭地不報歸化城副都統，輒向理籓院越訴，奪盟長。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Daoguang zasak fuguo gong Batu Oqir, as Ulan Chab league chief, was stripped of the league headship for appealing to the Court of Colonial Affairs over a land dispute with Muminggan instead of reporting to the Guihua vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 12, zasak Batu Oqir lost the Ulan Chab league headship for bypassing Guihua officials in a land dispute with Muminggan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，綏遠城將軍盛塤奏：「烏拉特三公旗生齒日繁，漸形窮苦。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng Suiyuan general Shengkan memorialized: "The three Urad duke banners are growing in population and growing poor.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3, Suiyuan general Shengkan reported: "The three Urad duke banners are multiplying and growing poor.

sentences.zh: 賒欠民人債物，及備辦軍台差使借貸銀錢，無力償還，陸續私租地畝數十處，每處寬長百十里或數十里。

translations.literal: Debts to Han creditors and loans for relay service cannot be repaid; dozens of pasture tracts, each tens or hundreds of li wide, have been privately leased.
translations.idiomatic: They cannot repay Han debts or relay loans and have privately leased dozens of tracts, each tens or hundreds of li wide.

sentences.zh: 酌擬變通，分別應禁應開。

translations.literal: Flexible measures are proposed to distinguish what should be forbidden and what opened.
translations.idiomatic: Flexible rules are proposed for what to forbid and what to open.

sentences.zh: 」下所司議行。

translations.literal: The responsible offices were ordered to implement.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices were ordered to act.

sentences.zh: 同治七年，回匪東竄，擾後套，山西大同鎮總兵馬升督兵往昆都侖、溝台梁一帶防剿。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tongzhi, as Muslim rebels raided east and disturbed the rear banner, Shanxi Datong commander Ma Sheng led troops to defend Kun Dulun and Goutailiang.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7, Muslim rebels raided the rear banner; Datong commander Ma Sheng defended Kun Dulun and Goutailiang.

sentences.zh: 九年，將軍定安奏：「烏拉特河北後套夙稱產糧之區，而糧所由產，皆出於內地民人私種蒙古遊牧之地。

translations.literal: In the ninth year general Ding'an memorialized: "The north bank of Urad has long been a grain-producing rear banner, and the grain comes from Han cultivators on Mongol pasture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year general Ding'an wrote: "Urad's north-bank rear banner is famed for grain produced by Han farming on Mongol pasture.

sentences.zh: 現金順、張曜、老湘、卓勝各營軍糧無不購買於此。

translations.literal: The armies of Jinshun, Zhang Yao, Old Hunan, and Zhuosheng all buy provisions there.
translations.idiomatic: Jinshun, Zhang Yao, Old Hunan, and Zhuosheng armies all buy grain there.

sentences.zh: 擬請將三公旗遊牧墾出地畝，無論應開應禁，均暫准種耕，責令按畝收租，留備各項差使之用。

translations.literal: It is proposed to allow all opened pasture of the three duke banners, whether previously forbidden or permitted, to be temporarily cultivated, with rent per mu kept for corvée expenses.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed temporarily allowing all opened pasture of the three banners to be farmed, with rent per mu reserved for corvée.

sentences.zh: 所產糧石供各路軍糈。

translations.literal: The grain produced would supply the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: The harvest would feed the armies.

sentences.zh: 」時回匪陷磴口，擾及是部後套一帶。

translations.literal: At that time Muslim rebels held Dengkou and raided the tribe's rear-banner area.
translations.idiomatic: Muslim rebels then held Dengkou and raided the rear-banner area.

sentences.zh: 二月，諭定安遣宋慶一軍赴舍太一帶剿除北路竄匪。

translations.literal: In the second month an edict ordered Ding'an to send Song Qing's army to clear northern raiders around Shetai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Ding'an was ordered to send Song Qing to clear northern raiders at Shetai.

sentences.zh: 尋鄂爾多斯貝子烏爾那遜督隊擊退。

translations.literal: Soon Ordos prince Uernasun led a detachment that drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Ordos prince Uernasun drove them off.

sentences.zh: 六月，諭定安等勸烏拉特居民趕興耕作，以裕足食之源。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Ding'an and others were urged to encourage Urad residents to farm and secure food supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Ding'an was urged to encourage Urad farming for food security.

sentences.zh: 十二月，諭金順防範烏拉特三旗地方遊弋回匪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Jinshun was ordered to guard against roaming Muslim rebels in the three Urad banners.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Jinshun was told to guard the three Urad banners against roaming rebels.

sentences.zh: 十年三月，回匪復自賽音諾顏之阿米爾畢特公旗擾是部中公旗洪庫勒塔拉地方。

translations.literal: In the third month of the tenth year rebels again raided the middle-banner Hongkule Tara from the Sain Noyan Amir Bitegong banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, third month, rebels from Amir Bitegong raided middle-banner Hongkule Tara.

sentences.zh: 六月，匪又擾中公旗之什巴克台。

translations.literal: In the sixth month rebels again disturbed middle-banner Shibaketai.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month they raided middle-banner Shibaketai.

sentences.zh: 杜嘎爾奏：「吉額、洪額等軍大敗之于布特地方，金運昌遣提督王鳳鳴剿前竄洪庫勒塔拉之匪于奔巴廟、察洪噶爾廟，皆殄之。

translations.literal: Dugar memorialized: "Ji'e and Hong'e armies defeated them at Bute; Jin Yunchang sent Commander Wang Fengming to destroy raiders at Benbamiao and Chahongga'ermiao.
translations.idiomatic: Dugar reported victories at Bute and Benbamiao and Chahongga'ermiao.

sentences.zh: 其後肅州回匪平，烏拉特始息警。

translations.literal: After Suzhou Muslim rebels were pacified, Urad finally had peace.
translations.idiomatic: After Suzhou rebels were pacified, Urad was finally quiet.

sentences.zh: 自征回軍興，西路文報及軍需駝馬，皆由是部設台分段接替，至阿拉善而止。

translations.literal: Since the anti-rebel campaigns began, western dispatches and army camels were relayed by this tribe in stages as far as Alxa.
translations.idiomatic: Since the anti-rebel war, western dispatches and army camels were relayed through Urad to Alxa.

sentences.zh: 西陲肅清，始復舊制。

translations.literal: When the far west was pacified, the old system was restored.
translations.idiomatic: When the far west was pacified, the old relay system returned.
(End of memorial.)

sentences.zh: 二十三年，山西巡撫胡聘之請開烏拉特三湖灣地方屯墾。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Shanxi governor Hu Pinzhi asked to open the Sanhuwan area of Urad for colonization.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year governor Hu Pinzhi proposed colonizing Urad's Sanhuwan.

sentences.zh: 既得俞旨，理籓院以蒙盟呈有礙遊牧，格其議。

translations.literal: After imperial approval, the Court of Colonial Affairs blocked the plan on league protests that it would harm pasture.
translations.idiomatic: Approval came, but the Court of Colonial Affairs blocked it when leagues said pasture would suffer.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，護山西巡撫趙爾巽、吳廷斌先後奏置五原廳同知，以是暨鄂爾多斯之達拉特、杭錦兩旗寄居民人村落隸之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year acting Shanxi governors Zhao Erxun and Wu Tingbin memorialized a Wuyuan sub-prefect, placing settled Han villages of Urad with Dörbet and Hanggin banners of Ordos under him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Zhao Erxun and Wu Tingbin created a Wuyuan sub-prefect over Urad and Ordos Dörbet and Hanggin settlements.

sentences.zh: 時兵部侍郎貽穀督墾，派員勸報地。

translations.literal: At the time Vice Minister Yigu supervised reclamation and sent officers to urge land registration.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Yigu then supervised reclamation and urged registration.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，奏烏拉特前旗以達拉特旗東之什拉胡魯素、紅門兔等地段，後旗以黃河西岸之紅洞灣地段，中旗以黃河西岸熟地莫多、噶魯泰兩段報墾，並修壩工，擴管道，防衝突，暢引灌。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year the front banner reported tracts east of Dörbet at Shilahulusu and Hongmentu, the rear banner the Hongdongwan west of the Yellow River, and the middle banner the mature lands Moduo and Galutai west of the river, with dikes and canals to ease conflict and irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year the three banners reported specific tracts for reclamation and canal works west of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 仍以民多官少，防範難周，蒙人時有爭渠阻墾情事入告。

translations.literal: Because officials were few and settlers many, Mongols often petitioned over water rights and blocked reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: With few officials and many settlers, Mongols often sued over water and blocked reclamation.

sentences.zh: 是部中旗有佐領十六，前旗十二，後旗六。

translations.literal: The middle banner had sixteen assistant commandants, the front twelve, and the rear six.
translations.idiomatic: The middle banner had sixteen assistant commandants, the front twelve, and the rear six.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾多斯部，在河套內，至京師千一百里。

translations.literal: The Ordos tribe lay within the Ordos loop, one thousand one hundred li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Ordos tribe lay within the Ordos loop, one thousand one hundred li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東歸化城土默特，西阿拉善，南陝西長城，北烏喇特。

translations.literal: East, the Tumet of Guihua; west, Alxa; south, the Shaanxi Great Wall; north, Urad.
translations.idiomatic: To the east lay the Tumet of Guihua; to the west, Alxa; to the south, the Shaanxi Great Wall; to the north, Urad.

sentences.zh: 東西北三面皆距河，袤延二千餘里。

translations.literal: On three sides it bordered rivers, stretching more than two thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Rivers bounded it on three sides over more than two thousand li.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十六世孫巴爾蘇博羅特始居河套，為鄂爾多斯濟農。

translations.literal: Barsuborot, sixteenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, first settled the loop and became Ordos jiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Barsuborot, a sixteenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, first settled the loop and became Ordos jiyang.

sentences.zh: 子袞弼哩克圖墨爾根繼之。

translations.literal: His son Gunbiligtü Mergen succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Gunbiligtü Mergen succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 有子九，分牧而處，今鄂爾多斯七扎薩克皆其裔。

translations.literal: He had nine sons who pastured separately; the present seven Ordos zasak banners are all their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: He had nine sons who pastured apart; today all seven Ordos zasak banners descend from them.

sentences.zh: 長諾顏達喇襲濟農號，為扎薩克郡王額璘臣一旗祖；

translations.literal: The eldest, Noyan Dara, inherited the jiyang title and was ancestor of the one banner of zasak prince Erinchen;
translations.idiomatic: The eldest, Noyan Dara, took the jiyang title and founded the banner of zasak prince Erinchen;

sentences.zh: 次巴雅斯呼朗諾顏，為扎薩克貝勒善丹一旗祖；

translations.literal: the second, Bayas Khulang Noyan, was ancestor of the one banner of zasak beile Sandan;
translations.idiomatic: the second, Bayas Khulang Noyan, founded the banner of zasak beile Sandan;

sentences.zh: 次偉達爾瑪諾顏，為扎薩克貝子沙克紮、鎮國公小扎木素二旗祖；

translations.literal: the third, Weidarma Noyan, was ancestor of the two banners of zasak beizi Shakja and gushan gong Xiao Jamusu;
translations.idiomatic: the third, Weidarma Noyan, founded the banners of zasak beizi Shakja and gushan gong Xiao Jamusu;

sentences.zh: 次諾捫塔喇尼華台吉，為扎薩克貝子額琳沁一旗祖；

translations.literal: the fourth, Nom Taniwa Taiji, was ancestor of the one banner of zasak beizi Erinchin;
translations.idiomatic: the fourth, Nom Taniwa Taiji, founded the banner of zasak beizi Erinchin;

sentences.zh: 次玻揚呼哩都噶爾岱青，為扎薩克台吉定咱喇什一旗祖；

translations.literal: the fifth, Boyang Khulidgar Daiqing, was ancestor of the one banner of zasak taiji Dingzanashi;
translations.idiomatic: the fifth, Boyang Khulidgar Daiqing, founded the banner of zasak taiji Dingzanashi;

sentences.zh: 次巴雅喇偉徵諾顏，為扎薩克貝子色棱一旗祖；

translations.literal: the sixth, Bayara Weijeng Noyan, was ancestor of the one banner of zasak beizi Seleng;
translations.idiomatic: the sixth, Bayara Weijeng Noyan, founded the banner of zasak beizi Seleng;

sentences.zh: 次巴特瑪薩木巴斡；

translations.literal: the seventh, Batma Samba O;
translations.idiomatic: the seventh, Batma Samba O;

sentences.zh: 次納穆達喇達爾漢諾顏；

translations.literal: the eighth, Namdara Darhan Noyan;
translations.idiomatic: the eighth, Namdara Darhan Noyan;

sentences.zh: 次翁拉罕伊勒登臺吉：皆為濟農，屬察哈爾。

translations.literal: the ninth, Wengalan Iliden Taiji: all were jiyang and belonged to Chahar.
translations.idiomatic: the ninth, Wengalan Iliden Taiji—all were jiyang under Chahar.

sentences.zh: 林丹汗虐，其部濟農額琳臣與喀喇沁、阿巴噶諸部長敗察哈爾兵四萬於土默特之趙城。

translations.literal: Lin Dan khan was tyrannical; their jiyang Erinchen together with the chiefs of Kharchin, Abaga, and other tribes defeated forty thousand Chahar troops at Zhaocheng in Tumet.
translations.idiomatic: When Lin Dan khan grew cruel, jiyang Erinchen and the chiefs of Kharchin, Abaga, and other tribes routed forty thousand Chahar troops at Zhaocheng in Tumet.

sentences.zh: 天聰九年，大軍收林丹汗子額哲於黃河西托里圖地，未至，額璘臣私要額哲盟，分其眾以行。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tiancong the main army received Erje, son of Lin Dan khan, at Toliutu west of the Yellow River; before they arrived, Erinchen privately sought alliance with Erje and divided his followers to depart.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 9 the main army was to receive Lin Dan khan's son Erje at Toliutu west of the Yellow River; before they arrived, Erinchen secretly allied with Erje and split off part of his following.

sentences.zh: 我軍追及之，索所獲，額璘臣懼，獻察哈爾戶千餘。

translations.literal: Our army overtook them and demanded what had been taken; Erinchen feared and presented more than a thousand Chahar households.
translations.idiomatic: Our troops overtook them and demanded the plunder; Erinchen, afraid, surrendered more than a thousand Chahar households.

sentences.zh: 自是所部內附，頒授條約。

translations.literal: From then on the tribe submitted and regulations were issued.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the tribe submitted and treaty regulations were issued.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，選兵隨英親王阿濟格赴陝西剿流賊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi troops were selected to follow Prince Ying Aijige to Shaanxi to suppress the bandit Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 troops were sent with Prince Ying Aijige to Shaanxi against the rebel Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 二年，師旋，得優賚。

translations.literal: In the second year the army returned and received generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the army returned and was richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 六年，台吉大扎木素及多爾濟叛劫我使圖嚕錫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year taiji Daa Jamusu and Dorji rebelled and plundered our envoy Tuluxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year taiji Daa Jamusu and Dorji rebelled and robbed our envoy Tuluxi.

sentences.zh: 敕曰：「聞爾等背叛，即欲加兵。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Hearing that you have rebelled, I immediately wish to send troops.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ran: "Hearing of your rebellion, I am ready to send troops at once.

sentences.zh: 但念受朕恩有年，且生靈堪惜，故不忍遽用干戈。

translations.literal: But remembering that you have received my grace for years, and that lives are worth sparing, I do not wish hastily to use arms.
translations.idiomatic: But you have enjoyed my favor for years, and lives are precious; I cannot bring myself to war so quickly.

sentences.zh: 爾能悔過來朝，即宥罪恩養。

translations.literal: If you can repent and come to court, your crimes will be pardoned and you will be nurtured in grace.
translations.idiomatic: If you repent and come to court, I will pardon you and show favor.

sentences.zh: 儻恃險不即歸順，當發兵窮爾蹤跡，必不容爾偷生。

translations.literal: If you rely on difficult terrain and do not promptly submit, troops will be sent to hunt out your tracks, and you will not be allowed to live on in secret.
translations.idiomatic: If you trust in difficult ground and refuse to submit, I will send troops to hunt you down and will not let you survive in hiding.

sentences.zh: 」時額璘臣偕同族固嚕岱青善丹、小扎木素、沙克紮、額琳沁、色棱等，攜自額濟內阿喇克鄂拉徙牧博羅陀海。

translations.literal: At that time Erinchen together with his kinsmen Gulu Daiqing Sandan, Xiao Jamusu, Shakja, Erinchin, Seleng, and others, moving from Alak Ola within Eji, pastured at Boluotuohai.
translations.idiomatic: By then Erinchen, with kinsmen Gulu Daiqing Sandan, Xiao Jamusu, Shakja, Erinchin, Seleng, and others, had moved from Alak Ola in Eji to pasture at Boluotuohai.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其不助逆，詔封郡王、貝勒、貝子、鎮國公有差，各授扎薩克，凡六旗。

translations.literal: The throne commended their refusal to aid rebellion; by edict prince, beile, beizi, and gushan gong titles were conferred in due rank, each granted zasak, six banners in all.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised their refusal to join the rebels and enfeoffed them as prince, beile, beizi, and gushan gong in due rank, granting zasak over six banners.

sentences.zh: 七年，大扎木素降，詔宥其罪。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Daa Jamusu submitted; an edict pardoned his crime.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Daa Jamusu surrendered and was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 諭多爾濟降，不從。

translations.literal: Dorji was instructed to submit; he refused.
translations.idiomatic: Dorji was ordered to surrender; he refused.

sentences.zh: 九年，遣兵擒斬多爾濟於阿拉善。

translations.literal: In the ninth year troops were sent to capture and execute Dorji in Alxa.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year troops captured and executed Dorji in Alxa.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年冬，調所部兵三千五百會剿陝西叛鎮王輔臣。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirteenth year of Kangxi, three thousand five hundred troops of the tribe were mobilized to join the campaign against the Shaanxi rebel commander Wang Fuchen.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Kangxi 13, three thousand five hundred tribal troops joined the campaign against Shaanxi rebel Wang Fuchen.

sentences.zh: 十四年，復神木、定邊、花馬池各城堡，敘功，晉扎薩克等爵，台吉各加一級。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the fortresses of Shenmu, Dingbian, and Huamachi were recovered; merit was recorded, zasak ranks were advanced, and taiji each received one promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Shenmu, Dingbian, and Huamachi were retaken; zasak titles were raised and each taiji promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，奉詔簡兵二千防汛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Galdan invaded Khalkha; by imperial order two thousand troops were selected for frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, when Galdan invaded Khalkha, two thousand troops were ordered to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，至所部界，扎薩克等率屬渡河朝御營，獻馬。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor campaigned in person against Galdan; when he reached the tribe's border, the zasak and others led their followers across the river to attend the imperial camp and presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor marched in person against Galdan; at the tribal border the zasak crossed the river with their followers to attend the imperial camp and present horses.

sentences.zh: 上手諭皇太子曰：「朕至鄂爾多斯地方，見其人皆有禮貌，不失舊時蒙古規模。

translations.literal: The emperor personally instructed the crown prince: "When I reached the Ordos region, I saw that the people are all courteous and have not lost the old Mongol ways.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the crown prince: "In Ordos I found the people courteous and still true to old Mongol custom.

sentences.zh: 各旗俱和睦如一體，無盜賊，駝馬牛羊不必防守。

translations.literal: All banners live in harmony as one body; there are no thieves, and camels, horses, cattle, and sheep need no guarding.
translations.idiomatic: Every banner lives in harmony; there is no theft, and camels, horses, cattle, and sheep need no guard.

sentences.zh: 生計周全，牲畜蕃盛，較他蒙古殷富。

translations.literal: Livelihoods are secure and livestock flourish; they are wealthier than other Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Their livelihood is secure, their herds abundant—they are richer than other Mongols.

sentences.zh: 圍獵嫺熟，雉兔復多。

translations.literal: They are skilled at hunting drives, and pheasants and hares are abundant.
translations.idiomatic: They hunt well, and pheasants and hares are plentiful.

sentences.zh: 所獻馬皆極馴，取馬不用套竿，隨手執之。

translations.literal: The horses presented are all very tame; to take a horse one needs no lasso pole but may seize it by hand.
translations.idiomatic: The horses they presented are wonderfully tame—one needs no lasso, only to take them by hand.

sentences.zh: 水土食物皆甚相宜。

translations.literal: The water, soil, and food are all very suitable.
translations.idiomatic: Water, soil, and fare all suit them well.

sentences.zh: 」三十六年，允扎薩克等請設站阿都海，軍奏及糧運俱由其地行。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year the zasak request to establish a relay station at Aduhai was approved; military dispatches and grain transport all passed through that place.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year the zasak were allowed a relay station at Aduhai; dispatches and grain transport all went that way.

sentences.zh: 時扎薩克等率兵扈蹕，頒賚白金。

translations.literal: At the time the zasak and others led troops in escort of the imperial procession, and white silver was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: The zasak then escorted the imperial procession with troops and received gifts of white silver.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，理籓院劾運米遲誤罪，詔寬免。

translations.literal: That winter the Court of Colonial Affairs impeached them for delayed grain transport; an edict granted leniency.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Court of Colonial Affairs charged them with late grain delivery; the throne pardoned them.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，諭曰：「鄂爾多斯饑饉洊臻，戶口流散，可速遣官察覈，務令各遂生業。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year an instruction said: "Ordos has suffered repeated famine and households have scattered; officials should quickly be sent to investigate and ensure each may pursue his livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year the throne ordered: "Ordos has suffered famine after famine and people have scattered; send officials at once to investigate and restore each to his livelihood.

sentences.zh: 」五十二年，詔定其部牧界。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year an edict fixed the tribe's pasture boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year pasture boundaries for the tribe were fixed by edict.

sentences.zh: 先是郡王松喇布請暫牧察罕托輝，尚書穆和倫等往勘，議於柳苾、剛柳苾、房苾、西苾四台外，暫令駐牧。

translations.literal: Earlier prince Songlab had asked to pasture temporarily at Chahantuohui; Minister Mu Helun and others went to survey, and it was decided that outside the four stations Liubi, Gangliubi, Fangbi, and Xibi they would temporarily be allowed to pasture.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Prince Songlab had asked to graze temporarily at Chahantuohui; Minister Mu Helun surveyed the site and allowed temporary pasture beyond the four stations Liubi, Gangliubi, Fangbi, and Xibi.

sentences.zh: 至是寧夏總兵范時捷奏：「察罕托輝系版圖內地，蒙古遊牧與民樵采混雜，不便。

translations.literal: At this time Ningxia commander Fan Shijie memorialized: "Chahantuohui lies within mapped territory; Mongol pasturing mixed with civilian wood-gathering is inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia commander Fan Shijie then reported: "Chahantuohui is mapped imperial territory; Mongol grazing mixed with civilian woodcutting is unworkable.

sentences.zh: 請令仍以黃河為界。

translations.literal: I ask that the Yellow River again be made the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the Yellow River again serve as the boundary.

sentences.zh: 」遣官勘，議從時捷所請。

translations.literal: Officials were sent to survey, and the request of Shijie was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Surveyors were dispatched and Shijie's request was granted.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，詔簡兵二千從大軍防禦策妄阿喇布坦。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year an edict selected two thousand troops to follow the main army in defense against Tsewang Araptan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year two thousand troops were ordered to join the main army against Tsewang Araptan.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，所部歉收，遣官往賑，凡七千九百餘戶，三萬一千餘丁。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year the tribe's harvest was poor; officials were sent to relieve them, totaling more than seven thousand nine hundred households and thirty-one thousand persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year, after a poor harvest, relief was sent to more than seven thousand nine hundred households and thirty-one thousand persons.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，復命賑恤。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng relief was again ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 relief was ordered again.

sentences.zh: 十年，以調赴固爾班賽堪兵三千，不堪用者五百，又中途逃歸四百餘，為將軍達爾濟所劾，論王、貝勒、貝子等罪，各降爵。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, of three thousand troops dispatched to Gurban Saikhan, five hundred were unfit and more than four hundred fled en route; they were impeached by General Darji, and the princes, beile, and beizi were found guilty and each demoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, of three thousand troops sent to Gurban Saikhan, five hundred proved useless and more than four hundred deserted on the march; General Darji impeached them and the princes, beile, and beizi were demoted.

sentences.zh: 尋以次予復。

translations.literal: Soon their ranks were restored in order.
translations.idiomatic: Their titles were soon restored in turn.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，詔增設一旗，以一等台吉定咱喇什領之，授扎薩克。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong an edict added one banner, led by first-rank taiji Dingzanashi and granted zasak.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 one banner was added under first-rank taiji Dingzanashi, who received zasak.

sentences.zh: 是年，允陝西榆林、神木等處民邊種鄂爾多斯餘閒套地完租。

translations.literal: That year approval was given for civilians of Yulin, Shenmu, and elsewhere in Shaanxi to cultivate surplus Ordos loop lands on the border and pay full rent.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shaanxi settlers at Yulin, Shenmu, and elsewhere were allowed to farm surplus Ordos loop lands on the border at full rent.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，陝甘總督福康安奏：「黃河改向西流，原在河西民人反在河東。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year Shaanxi-Gansu governor Fukangan memorialized: "The Yellow River has changed to flow westward, and civilians who originally were west of the river are now east of it.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year governor Fukangan reported: "The Yellow River now runs westward, leaving people who were west of the river on its east bank.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾多斯蒙古貪利，濫以現行黃河為界，謂民人佔據所部遊牧地方。

translations.literal: Ordos Mongols, greedy for profit, indiscriminately take the present course of the Yellow River as the boundary and claim that civilians occupy their tribe's pasture lands.
translations.idiomatic: Ordos Mongols, seeking profit, treat the river's present course as the boundary and accuse settlers of occupying tribal pasture.

sentences.zh: 」命侍郎賽音博爾克圖往勘，仍如前黃河舊流之地為界，釘椿立碑。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Saiyinboerke was sent to survey; the boundary was fixed as before along the old course of the Yellow River, and stakes were driven and monuments erected.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Saiyinboerke was sent to survey; the boundary was reset to the old river course and marked with stakes and steles.

sentences.zh: 所部七旗，自為一盟，曰伊克昭。

translations.literal: The tribe's seven banners formed a league of their own, called Ike Juu.
translations.idiomatic: Its seven banners formed their own league, Ike Juu.

sentences.zh: 與哲哩木、卓索圖、昭烏達、錫林郭勒、烏蘭察布五盟同列內扎薩克。

translations.literal: With the five leagues of Jirem, Josotu, Juu Uda, Xilingol, and Ulaanchab they were ranked among the Inner zasak.
translations.idiomatic: They stood with Jirem, Josotu, Juu Uda, Xilingol, and Ulaanchab among the Inner zasak leagues.

sentences.zh: 左翼前旗，一名準噶爾旗，駐劄勒穀。

translations.literal: The left front banner, also called the Junggar banner, was stationed at Legu.
translations.idiomatic: The left front banner, or Junggar banner, was stationed at Legu.

sentences.zh: 左翼中旗，一名郡王旗，駐敖西喜峰。

translations.literal: The left middle banner, also called the prince banner, was stationed at Aoxixifeng.
translations.idiomatic: The left middle banner, or prince banner, was stationed at Aoxixifeng.

sentences.zh: 左翼後旗，一名達拉特旗，駐巴爾哈遜湖。

translations.literal: The left rear banner, also called the Dorbet banner, was stationed at Barhason Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The left rear banner, or Dorbet banner, was stationed at Barhason Lake.

sentences.zh: 右翼前旗，一名烏審旗，駐巴哈池。

translations.literal: The right front banner, also called the Uxin banner, was stationed at Baha Chi.
translations.idiomatic: The right front banner, or Uxin banner, was stationed at Baha Chi.

sentences.zh: 右翼中旗，一名鄂拓克旗，駐西喇布哩都池。

translations.literal: The right middle banner, also called the Ötok banner, was stationed at Xilabliidu Chi.
translations.idiomatic: The right middle banner, or Ötok banner, was stationed at Xilabliidu Chi.

sentences.zh: 右翼後旗，一名杭錦旗，駐鄂爾吉虎泊。

translations.literal: The right rear banner, also called the Hanggin banner, was stationed at Erjihu Po.
translations.idiomatic: The right rear banner, or Hanggin banner, was stationed at Erjihu Po.

sentences.zh: 後增一旗，曰左翼前末旗，一名扎薩克旗。

translations.literal: Later one banner was added, called the left front rear banner, also known as the zasak banner.
