translations.idiomatic: Later a banner was added—the left front rear banner, also called the zasak banner.

sentences.zh: 爵八：扎薩克多羅郡王一；

translations.literal: There were eight titles: one zasak duoluo prince;
translations.idiomatic: Titles numbered eight: one zasak duoluo prince;

sentences.zh: 附輔國公一；

translations.literal: one attached fuguo gong;
translations.idiomatic: one attached fuguo gong;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅貝勒一；

translations.literal: one zasak duoluo beile;
translations.idiomatic: one zasak duoluo beile;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克固山貝子四，一由鎮國公晉襲；

translations.literal: four zasak gushan beizi, one promoted from gushan gong;
translations.idiomatic: four zasak gushan beizi, one raised from gushan gong;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克一等台吉一。

translations.literal: one zasak first-rank taiji.
translations.idiomatic: one zasak first-rank taiji.

sentences.zh: 是部墾事最早。

translations.literal: This tribe opened land to cultivation earliest.
translations.idiomatic: This tribe was earliest to open land to cultivation.

sentences.zh: 乾隆以後，是部招墾民人近陝西者，分隸陝西神木、定邊兩理事同知，及神木、府穀、懷遠、靖邊、定邊等縣。

translations.literal: After Qianlong, settlers recruited near Shaanxi were placed under the two sub-prefects of Shenmu and Dingbian in Shaanxi, and the counties of Shenmu, Fugu, Huaiyuan, Jingbian, and Dingbian.
translations.idiomatic: After Qianlong, settlers near Shaanxi fell under the Shenmu and Dingbian sub-prefects and the counties of Shenmu, Fugu, Huaiyuan, Jingbian, and Dingbian.

sentences.zh: 近山西者，分隸薩拉齊、托克托城、清水河三廳，偏關、河曲等縣。

translations.literal: Those near Shanxi were placed under the three departments of Salaqi, Toketu, and Qingshuihe, and the counties of Pianguan and Hequ.
translations.idiomatic: Those near Shanxi were assigned to Salaqi, Toketu, and Qingshuihe departments and the counties of Pianguan and Hequ.

sentences.zh: 而因地滋爭之案亦時有。

translations.literal: Disputes arising from land likewise occurred from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: Land disputes arose from time to time as well.

sentences.zh: 道光八年，達拉特旗之才吉、波羅塔拉地方，以抵還債項，奏准租給商種五年。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Daoguang, the areas of Caiji and Boluotara in the Dorbet banner, to repay debts, were approved for lease to merchants to cultivate for five years.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 8 the Dorbet banner tracts of Caiji and Boluotara were leased to merchants for five years to settle debts.

sentences.zh: 十四年，綏遠城將軍彥德奏：「達拉特旗台吉人等招民私墾驛站草地，致越界侵種，其旗遊牧地方貝子親往驅逐。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Suiyuan general Yande memorialized: "Dorbet banner taiji and others recruited civilians to cultivate privately on relay-station pasture, causing cross-border encroachment; the banner's beizi went in person to drive them from the pasture lands.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Suiyuan general Yande reported: "Dorbet taiji had settlers farm relay-station pasture illegally, encroaching across boundaries; the banner beizi went in person to drive them off.

sentences.zh: 民人恃眾，砍傷二等台吉薩音吉雅等。

translations.literal: Civilians, relying on their numbers, cut and wounded second-rank taiji Sayinjiya and others.
translations.idiomatic: Settlers, trusting their numbers, hacked and wounded second-rank taiji Sayinjiya and others.

sentences.zh: 」詔山西巡撫鄂順安派員捕治之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Shanxi governor Eshun'an to send officers to arrest and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered Shanxi governor Eshun'an to send men to arrest and punish them.

sentences.zh: 其後相沿奉部文而承種者有之，由台吉私放者有之，由各廟喇嘛公放者有之。

translations.literal: Thereafter some continued cultivation in accordance with ministry documents, some by private lease from taiji, and some by public lease from lamas of various temples.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward some farmed under ministry permits, some on leases from taiji, and some on leases from temple lamas.

sentences.zh: 開墾頗多，產糧亦盛。

translations.literal: Reclamation was considerable and grain production flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Reclamation spread widely and grain harvests grew strong.

sentences.zh: 同治初元，回匪役興，辦團練，購糧儲，皆取濟於此。

translations.literal: At the start of the Tongzhi era, as the Muslim rebellion began, militia organization and grain purchase all drew supplies from here.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tongzhi Muslim rebellion began, militia and grain stores alike drew on this region.

sentences.zh: 是年，調鄂爾多斯兵赴甘協剿。

translations.literal: That year Ordos troops were mobilized to Gansu to join the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ordos troops were sent to Gansu to join the campaign.

sentences.zh: 六年，回匪屢入境，皆為貝子紮那格爾第兵所敗。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Muslim rebels repeatedly entered the border and were all defeated by the troops of beizi Zanegerdi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year rebels crossed the border repeatedly and were beaten each time by beizi Zanegerdi's troops.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，陝西寧條梁之陷，匪遂大入遊牧，南自依克沙巴爾、北至固爾根柴達木，焚掠殆遍。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, with the fall of Ningtiaoliang in Shaanxi, rebels entered the pasturelands in force, from Yikeshabaer in the south to Gurgin Chaidam in the north, burning and plundering nearly everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, first month, after Ningtiaoliang in Shaanxi fell, rebels poured into the pastures from Yikeshabaer south to Gurgin Chaidam north, burning and looting almost everywhere.

sentences.zh: 要地如古城、答拉寨、十里長灘諸處皆不守。

translations.literal: Key places such as Gucheng, Dalazhai, and Shilichangtan were all abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Strongpoints such as Gucheng, Dalazhai, and Shilichangtan were all lost.

sentences.zh: 蒙兵不能戰，屢請撤退。

translations.literal: Mongol troops could not fight and repeatedly asked to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol troops could not hold and repeatedly asked to pull back.

sentences.zh: 四月，綏遠城將軍德勒克多爾濟奏飭紮那格爾第簡精壯蒙兵五百，合準噶爾旗壯丁及察哈爾馬隊各五百，均歸統帶，擇駐神木要隘，相機迎剿。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Suiyuan general Delek Dorji memorialized ordering Zanegerdi to select five hundred elite Mongol troops, combined with five hundred strong men of the Junggar banner and five hundred Chahar cavalry, all under unified command, to be stationed at key points in Shenmu and engage the rebels as opportunity allowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Suiyuan general Delek Dorji ordered Zanegerdi to pick five hundred elite Mongols, join them with five hundred Junggar banner men and five hundred Chahar cavalry under one command, and hold Shenmu passes to strike when chance allowed.

sentences.zh: 別以達拉特旗兵五百駐適中草地。

translations.literal: Separately five hundred Dorbet banner troops were posted at a central pasture.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred Dorbet banner troops were posted separately on central pasture.

sentences.zh: 朝旨飭寧夏副都統金順一軍援之。

translations.literal: The court ordered Ningxia vice commander Jinshun's army to assist.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Ningxia vice commander Jinshun to reinforce them.

sentences.zh: 六月，金順深入蒙地，遇匪于野狐井、門家梁、王家溝，皆捷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Jinshun penetrated deep into Mongol territory and encountered rebels at Yehujing, Menjialiang, and Wangjiagou, winning each engagement.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Jinshun pushed deep into Mongol lands and won fights at Yehujing, Menjialiang, and Wangjiagou.

sentences.zh: 嵩武軍統領提督張曜一軍亦赴援，屢挫之，古城、十里長灘之匪皆遁。

translations.literal: Commander Zhang Yao of the Songwu Army also went to aid, repeatedly defeating them; rebels at Gucheng and Shilichangtan all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Zhang Yao of the Songwu Army also came to help, beat them repeatedly, and rebels at Gucheng and Shilichangtan fled.

sentences.zh: 張曜又敗匪于達拉特旗，進駐古城。

translations.literal: Zhang Yao again defeated rebels in the Dorbet banner and advanced to station at Gucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yao defeated rebels again in the Dorbet banner and moved up to Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 而竄杭錦、烏審、郡王等旗之匪，亦為綏遠城將軍所遣達爾濟一軍所敗。

translations.literal: And rebels who had fled into the Hanggin, Uxin, and prince banners were also defeated by the army of Darji dispatched by the Suiyuan general.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels who had slipped into the Hanggin, Uxin, and prince banners were also beaten by Darji's force from Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 是為鄂部七旗初次肅清。

translations.literal: This was the first pacification of the seven Ordos banners.
translations.idiomatic: This was the first clearing of the seven Ordos banners.

sentences.zh: 綏遠城將軍定安遂奏撤伊克昭盟兵一千九百回本遊牧防守，仍留前挑兵五百，令紮那格爾第統帶探賊進剿。

translations.literal: Suiyuan general Ding'an then memorialized to withdraw one thousand nine hundred Ike Juu league troops to their home pastures for defense, while retaining five hundred previously selected troops under Zanegerdi to seek out and pursue rebels.
translations.idiomatic: General Ding'an then asked to send one thousand nine hundred Ike Juu troops home to guard their pastures, leaving five hundred picked men under Zanegerdi to hunt rebels.

sentences.zh: 十二月，阿拉善之磴口不守，回匪又大入，昭鹽海子、纏金一帶皆被擾。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Dengkou in Alxa was lost and Muslim rebels entered again in force; the area around Zhaoyanhai and Chanjin was all disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Dengkou in Alxa fell and rebels poured in again, ravaging Zhaoyanhai and Chanjin.

sentences.zh: 時匪自磴口水路進撲，副都統杜嘎爾派參領成山等合烏爾圖那遜兵分往纏金及阿拉善旗烏蘭木頭地方剿之，匪皆敗遁。

translations.literal: At the time rebels advanced by water from Dengkou; vice commander Dugar sent assistant commandant Chengshan and others together with Uertunasun's troops to Chanjin and the Wulanmutou area of Alxa banner to suppress them, and all rebels were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels then came by water from Dengkou; vice commander Dugar sent Chengshan and Uertunasun to Chanjin and Wulanmutou in Alxa banner, and the rebels were routed.

sentences.zh: 六月，張曜自古城進剿，屢敗匪於察罕諾爾、沙金托海，追至賀蘭山，達爾濟、紮那格爾第兩軍擊殄杭錦、達拉特、郡王諸旗之匪。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Zhang Yao advanced from Gucheng, repeatedly defeating rebels at Chahan Nuur and Shajintuohai, pursuing to Helan Mountain; the two armies of Darji and Zanegerdi exterminated rebels in the Hanggin, Dorbet, and prince banners.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Zhang Yao marched from Gucheng, winning at Chahan Nuur and Shajintuohai and pursuing to Helan Mountain while Darji and Zanegerdi wiped out rebels in the Hanggin, Dorbet, and prince banners.

sentences.zh: 朝旨又增遣宋慶一軍西援。

translations.literal: The court again dispatched Song Qing's army westward in support.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent Song Qing's army west in further support.

sentences.zh: 八月，敗擾郡王旗之匪於東嶺，擊退擾烏審、鄂拓克等旗之匪，進至哈拉寨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month rebels disturbing the prince banner were defeated at Dongling, rebels disturbing the Uxin and Ötok banners were driven back, and the advance reached Halazhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month rebels in the prince banner were beaten at Dongling, raiders in the Uxin and Ötok banners were repulsed, and the advance reached Halazhai.

sentences.zh: 金順軍磴口，張曜軍寧夏，沿途自舍太至三道河、石嘴山皆駐官軍。

translations.literal: Jin Shun's army was at Dengkou and Zhang Yao's army at Ningxia; along the route from Shetai to Sandaohe and Shizuishan government troops were stationed throughout.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun held Dengkou and Zhang Yao held Ningxia, and government troops were posted all along the line from Shetai through Sandaohe and Shizuishan.

sentences.zh: 宋慶是冬追剿逆於準噶爾、昭鹽海子諸處，悉殄之。

translations.literal: That winter Song Qing pursued and suppressed rebels at Junggar, Zhaoyan Salt Lake, and other places, destroying them all.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Song Qing hunted down rebels around Junggar and Zhaoyan Salt Lake and wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 九年，金積回匪以官軍攻急，自石嘴北犯，冀梗我運道。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Jinjibao Muslim rebels, pressed hard by government attacks, invaded north from Shizui hoping to block our supply routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Jinjibao Muslim rebels, hard pressed by government forces, raided north from Shizui to cut our supply lines.

sentences.zh: 於是沙金托海以西匪騎出沒，而準噶爾、杭錦、鄂拓克諸旗復擾。

translations.literal: Thereupon rebel cavalry appeared and disappeared west of Shajintuohai, and the Junggar, Hanggin, and Ötok banners were disturbed again.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel horsemen then raided west of Shajintuohai, and the Junggar, Hanggin, and Ötok banners were thrown into turmoil once more.

sentences.zh: 宋慶、達爾濟諸軍復進剿，迭捷。

translations.literal: The armies of Song Qing, Darji, and others advanced again to suppress them and won successive victories.
translations.idiomatic: Song Qing, Darji, and the other columns pushed forward again and won one victory after another.

sentences.zh: 七月，烏審旗管帶官赤樓多爾濟以剿匪陣亡于霍里木廟，然各旗亦屢挫來擾之匪。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Uxin banner officer Chiledorji died fighting rebels at Huolimumiao, yet the various banners also repeatedly checked the raiding rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Chiledorji, the Uxin banner officer, fell suppressing rebels at Huolimumiao, though the banners also beat back repeated raids.

sentences.zh: 梅楞章京紮棟巴等以剿挫陝西懷遠邊外之匪，予優獎。

translations.literal: Meileng zhangjing Zhadongba and others were given special rewards for suppressing rebels beyond Huaiyuan in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Meileng zhangjing Zhadongba and others received special rewards for driving off rebels beyond Huaiyuan in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是部再告奠定。

translations.literal: The tribe was settled once more.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe was pacified again.

sentences.zh: 至金積蕩平，而警報始息。

translations.literal: Only when Jinjibao was completely pacified did the alarms finally cease.
translations.idiomatic: Not until Jinjibao was fully suppressed did the frontier alarms finally die down.

sentences.zh: 歷次陣亡蒙旗官兵及出力者，均時予恤獎。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers of the Mongol banners who fell in successive battles and those who exerted themselves were all granted timely consolation and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol banner officers and men killed in the fighting, and those who had served with distinction, were consoled and rewarded as each case arose.

sentences.zh: 其纏金諸地，則山西仍置防戍。

translations.literal: As for the Chanjin and other areas, Shanxi still maintained garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chanjin region and elsewhere, Shanxi continued to keep troops on guard.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，邊外馬賊肆擾，是部達拉特、杭錦等旗地戶商人蹂躪特重，渠廢田蕪，迄不可復。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu frontier bandits ran riot; settlers and merchants in the Dorbet, Hanggin, and other banners of the tribe suffered especially heavy devastation, and canals were abandoned and fields went to waste, never to be restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2 frontier bandits ravaged the border; Dorbet, Hanggin, and the other banners saw their settlers and merchants worst hit, their canals ruined and fields left waste beyond recovery.

sentences.zh: 十年，伊克昭盟長貝子紮那濟爾迪呈：「準噶爾旗以頻年荒歉，請開墾空閒牧場一段，東西八十里，南北十五里，收租散賑，接濟窮蒙。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Ike Zhao league chief beizi Zana Jerdi presented: "The Junggar banner, owing to years of famine, asks to open a section of idle pasture eighty li east to west and fifteen li north to south, to collect rent for relief distribution and aid the poor Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year league chief beizi Zana Jerdi of Ike Zhao presented: "The Junggar banner, after years of famine, asks to open a tract of unused pasture eighty li from east to west and fifteen li from north to south, collect rent for relief, and succor impoverished Mongols.

sentences.zh: 」下理籓院議行。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to the Court of Colonial Affairs for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: It was referred to the Court of Colonial Affairs for deliberation and action.

sentences.zh: 以招種民人分隸山西河曲、陝西府穀。

translations.literal: They were to recruit cultivators assigned respectively to Hequ in Shanxi and Fugu in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Settlers were to be recruited and registered under Hequ in Shanxi and Fugu in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 時歸化城土默特與達拉特旗以黃河改道爭界，署山西巡撫奎斌、大理寺少卿郭勒敏布以綏遠城將軍斷分之案偏袒土默特，奏劾。

translations.literal: At the time Guihua Tumet and the Dorbet banner disputed boundaries over the Yellow River's change of course; acting Shanxi governor Kuibin and Dalisi vice-president Geleminbu impeached the Suiyuan general's division for favoring Tumet.
translations.idiomatic: Guihua Tumet and the Dorbet banner were then disputing their boundary after the Yellow River shifted; acting Shanxi governor Kuibin and Dalisi vice-president Geleminbu impeached the Suiyuan general for a ruling that favored Tumet.

sentences.zh: 命察哈爾都統紹祺往勘，援乾隆五十一年黃河舊漕為斷之諭，以南之地四成歸達拉特，以北之地六成歸土默特。

translations.literal: Shaoqi, the Chahar commander, was ordered to survey the case; citing the Qianlong fifty-first year precedent of the Yellow River's old channel as the dividing line, forty percent of the land south of the river went to Dorbet and sixty percent of the land north of it to Tumet.
translations.idiomatic: Chahar commander Shaoqi was sent to investigate; following the Qianlong 51 ruling that took the river's former course as the boundary, forty percent of the land south of the channel went to Dorbet and sixty percent north of it to Tumet.

sentences.zh: 尋經勘定，北自烏拉特界，南至準噶爾界，達拉特應分地週六百四十八里。

translations.literal: After the survey was completed, from the Urad border in the north to the Junggar border in the south, the land allotted to Dorbet measured six hundred forty-eight li in circumference.
translations.idiomatic: The survey fixed Dorbet's share at six hundred forty-eight li in circuit, from the Urad boundary north to the Junggar boundary south.

sentences.zh: 十二年，伊犁領隊大臣長庚奏纏金等處宜開屯田。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Ili assistant commander Chang Geng memorialized that Chanjin and similar areas should be opened for colonization.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Ili assistant commander Chang Geng proposed opening colonization at Chanjin and other such places.

sentences.zh: 山西巡撫剛毅覆奏：「纏金即才吉地，在河北外套伊克昭盟之達拉特、杭錦兩旗牧界。

translations.literal: Shanxi governor Gangyi replied: "Chanjin is Caijidi, on the north bank of the river in the rear banner within the pasture boundaries of the Dorbet and Hanggin banners of Ike Zhao league.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi governor Gangyi replied: "Chanjin is Caijidi, on the north bank in the rear banner within the grazing lands of the Dorbet and Hanggin banners of Ike Zhao league.

sentences.zh: 河自改行南道，蒙古始招商租種分佃，修成管道。

translations.literal: After the river shifted to the southern course, the Mongols began recruiting merchants to lease and cultivate the land, and irrigation channels were built.
translations.idiomatic: Once the river turned south, Mongols began inviting merchants to rent and farm the land, and main irrigation channels were dug.

sentences.zh: 西則纏金，計共五渠，東則後套，計共三渠，紆回約二百里，中間支渠曲折蜿蜒，不可枚數。

translations.literal: To the west was Chanjin, with five main channels in all; to the east was the rear banner, with three; the system wound about two hundred li, and the branch channels twisting between them were beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: West lay Chanjin with five trunk canals; east lay the rear banner with three; the network ran some two hundred li, with branch channels too numerous to count.

sentences.zh: 後遭馬賊之擾，不特纏金、牛壩商號不過數家，即後套左右亦只二百餘家。

translations.literal: Later, after raids by bandits, there were no more than a few shops in Chanjin and Niuba, and on both sides of the rear banner barely two hundred households remained.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit raids later left only a handful of shops at Chanjin and Niuba, and barely two hundred households on either side of the rear banner.

sentences.zh: 達拉特旗昔歲收租銀十萬，近所收租錢不及三千串。

translations.literal: The Dorbet banner once collected one hundred thousand taels of rent in a year; recently it barely reached three thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: Dorbet had once taken in one hundred thousand taels of rent a year; lately it collected less than three thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 閱伍至薩拉齊之包頭，面與伊克昭盟長貝子紮那吉爾迪籌商，謂當明示各旗，斷不使該旗牧界日久歸於民人。

translations.literal: While inspecting troops at Baotou in Salarqi, he met face to face with Ike Zhao league chief beizi Zanagird and agreed that each banner should be told plainly that its pasture would never, over time, pass permanently to civilian cultivators.
translations.idiomatic: On an inspection tour at Baotou in Salarqi he met league chief beizi Zanagird and agreed to make clear to every banner that its grazing lands would not be allowed to slip permanently into civilian hands.

sentences.zh: 」因上議屯三端：曰分段，曰修渠，曰設官。

translations.literal: He therefore submitted three proposals for colonization: subdivision, channel repair, and the establishment of officials.
translations.idiomatic: He then submitted three colonization proposals: dividing the land into sections, repairing the canals, and appointing officials.

sentences.zh: 下所司議，格。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to the responsible offices for deliberation and was rejected.
translations.idiomatic: It was referred to the relevant offices for review and blocked.

sentences.zh: 二十六年拳匪之案，鄂爾多斯七旗，如達拉特、鄂拓克、烏審、準噶爾各旗，釀禍均重。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, in the Boxer affair, among the seven Ordos banners such as Dorbet, Ötok, Uxin, and Junggar, each bore heavy blame for the trouble that arose.
translations.idiomatic: In the Boxer year twenty-six, Dorbet, Ötok, Uxin, Junggar, and the other Ordos banners all bore heavy responsibility for the disturbances.

sentences.zh: 事定，議有賠款。

translations.literal: After the affair was settled, indemnities were proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Once order was restored, indemnities were discussed.

sentences.zh: 達拉特一旗至三十七萬兩。

translations.literal: The Dorbet banner alone owed three hundred seventy thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: Dorbet alone was assessed three hundred seventy thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 教堂欲得銀，蒙旗欲抵地，久未結。

translations.literal: The churches wanted silver while the Mongol banners wanted to pay in land, and the matter long remained unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: The churches demanded cash while the Mongol banners wanted to settle in land, and the dispute dragged on.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，命兵部侍郎貽穀辦晉邊墾務，咨調烏、伊兩盟長詣歸化商訂，迄未至，而呈理籓院請免開辦。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year vice-minister of War Yigu was ordered to manage reclamation on the Shanxi frontier; the chiefs of the Urad and Ike Zhao leagues were summoned to Guihua to negotiate, but they never came and instead petitioned the Court of Colonial Affairs to be excused from opening the project.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year Yigu of the Ministry of War was put in charge of Shanxi frontier reclamation; the Urad and Ike Zhao league chiefs were called to Guihua to negotiate, yet they never appeared and asked the Court of Colonial Affairs to drop the scheme.

sentences.zh: 廷旨下院嚴飭盟長迅與貽穀等會商，不得推諉。

translations.literal: An imperial order went down to the bureau sternly directing the league chiefs to meet promptly with Yigu and the others and not to shirk responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the bureau to press the league chiefs to confer with Yigu at once and forbid further evasion.

sentences.zh: 於是貽穀等先以贖還達拉特旗教案熟地二千頃給銀十七萬兩者，為墾務入手之策。

translations.literal: Thereupon Yigu and his colleagues first took as their point of entry the redemption of two thousand qing of cultivated mission land in the Dorbet banner for one hundred seventy thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: Yigu and his staff therefore began by redeeming two thousand qing of mission land already under cultivation in Dorbet for one hundred seventy thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，達拉特、杭錦兩旗始派員就議報墾，郡王、鄂拓克、烏審、準噶爾、扎薩克五旗亦相繼報地，而杭錦旗貝子阿爾賓巴雅爾時充盟長，仍請緩辦，堅拒出具交地印文。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the Dorbet and Hanggin banners first sent representatives to negotiate and report land for reclamation; the prince, Ötok, Uxin, Junggar, and Jasak banners also reported land in turn, but Hanggin beizi Arbin Bayar, then serving as league chief, still asked to delay matters and firmly refused to issue the stamped documents surrendering land.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Dorbet and Hanggin sent men to negotiate reclamation; the prince, Ötok, Uxin, Junggar, and Jasak banners followed with their own reports, yet Hanggin beizi Arbin Bayar, then league chief, still sought delay and refused to issue the land-surrender seals.

sentences.zh: 三十年，貽穀以抗不遵辦，掣動全局劾之，以副盟長烏審旗貝子察克都爾色楞代署。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year Yigu impeached him for obstructing compliance and dragging down the whole undertaking, and vice league chief Chak Dor Seleng of the Uxin banner was appointed to act in his place.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Yigu impeached him for defiance that stalled the entire project and had Uxin vice-chief beizi Chak Dor Seleng serve as acting league chief.

sentences.zh: 三月，套匪滋事，山西練軍平之。

translations.literal: In the third month bandits in the rear banner stirred up trouble, and Shanxi militia pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month rear-banner bandits rose in revolt, and Shanxi militia put them down.

sentences.zh: 九月，察克都爾色楞等以烏審、扎薩克兩旗公中之地，北起阿拜素、南至巴蓋補拉克一段，歸官報墾，祝皇太后七旬萬壽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Chak Dor Seleng and others reported for reclamation a tract of common land of the Uxin and Jasak banners from Abaisu in the north to Bagai Bulak in the south, in celebration of the empress dowager's seventieth birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Chak Dor Seleng and others offered for reclamation a stretch of common land between the Uxin and Jasak banners from Abaisu north to Bagai Bulak south, honoring the empress dowager's seventieth birthday.

sentences.zh: 予察克都爾色楞郡王銜，沙克都爾紮布鎮國公銜。

translations.literal: Chak Dor Seleng was granted the rank of prince, and Shak Dorjab was granted the rank of defender of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Chak Dor Seleng received the title of prince, and Shak Dorjab the title of defender of the state.

sentences.zh: 三十一年二月，阿爾賓巴雅爾復呈悔過情形，報出杭錦旗中巴噶地一段。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirty-first year Arbin Bayar again presented an account of his repentance and reported a section of land at Baga in the Hanggin banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirty-first year Arbin Bayar submitted a statement of repentance and offered a tract at Baga in Hanggin.

sentences.zh: 貽穀奏烏、伊兩盟地皆封建，與察哈爾之比於郡縣者不同，定押荒歲租皆一半歸官，一半歸蒙，別提修渠費。

translations.literal: Yigu memorialized that the lands of the Urad and Ike Zhao leagues were feudal holdings, unlike Chahar's comparison to prefectures and counties, and fixed the annual rent on pledged wasteland so that half went to the government and half to the Mongols, with canal repair costs assessed separately.
translations.idiomatic: Yigu reported that Urad and Ike Zhao lands were feudal domains, not county-style holdings like Chahar's, and set pledged wasteland rent at half to the government and half to the Mongols, with canal costs charged apart.

sentences.zh: 旨下所司知之。

translations.literal: An imperial order was sent down to the responsible offices to take note.
translations.idiomatic: The court directed the relevant offices to act accordingly.

sentences.zh: 七月，貽穀奏：「杭錦、達拉特兩旗地戶將原有各渠報墾歸公，因改長勝渠名長濟，纏金渠名永濟，挑濬深通，老郭等渠以次及之，計可溉田萬頃。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Yigu memorialized: "The settlers of the Hanggin and Dorbet banners have reported their existing canals for public reclamation; the Changsheng canal was renamed Changji, the Chanjin canal Yongji, and after dredging them deep and clear the older canals such as Laoguo were taken up in turn, so that roughly ten thousand qing of fields could be irrigated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Yigu memorialized: "Hanggin and Dorbet settlers have turned their existing canals over for public reclamation; Changsheng was renamed Changji and Chanjin Yongji, and once dredged deep and open, canals such as Laoguo followed in turn, irrigating about ten thousand qing.

sentences.zh: 後套地必附渠，渠日加多，即地日廣。

translations.literal: Land in the rear banner must depend on canals, and as canals increase day by day, the land grows wider day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Rear-banner land depends on canals; as the canals multiply, so does the cultivated area.

sentences.zh: 就現在應收之款，悉歸工作，回環挹注，務竟其功。

translations.literal: All revenues now due should go entirely to the work, circulating back into the project until the task is finished.
translations.idiomatic: Every sum now collectible should be poured back into the work until the project is complete.

sentences.zh: 請各旗押荒地租各款應歸公者，均暫緩提撥，備渠工大修之費。

translations.literal: He asked that all pledged wasteland rents and other sums due to the government from the various banners be temporarily withheld from allocation to cover major canal repairs.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that pledged wasteland rents and other government shares from the banners be held back for the time being to pay for major canal work.

sentences.zh: 」九月，準噶爾旗協理台吉丹丕爾不悅於墾，糾眾抗阻，攻劫局所，貽穀遣兵捕治之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Junggar banner assistant taiji Danpier, displeased with reclamation, gathered a crowd to resist, attacked and plundered the office, and Yigu sent troops to capture and punish him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Danpier, assistant taiji of the Junggar banner, resentful of reclamation, rallied men to obstruct it, raided the bureau, and Yigu dispatched troops to seize and punish him.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，貽穀奏定郡王等五旗旱地押荒歲租。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year Yigu memorialized fixed annual rents on pledged dry land in the five banners of the prince and the others.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year Yigu fixed the annual rent on pledged dry land in the prince's banner and the other four banners.

sentences.zh: 陝西巡撫恩壽會奏以郡王、扎薩克兩旗墾地置東勝廳，隸山西歸綏道。

translations.literal: Shaanxi governor Enshou jointly memorialized establishing Dongsheng sub-prefecture over reclaimed land in the prince and Jasak banners, subordinate to the Guihua circuit of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi governor Enshou joined in proposing Dongsheng sub-prefecture for reclaimed land in the prince and Jasak banners, under Shanxi's Guihua circuit.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，貽穀蒙譴，復阿爾賓巴雅爾盟長。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year Yigu was punished by the throne, and Arbin Bayar was restored as league chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year Yigu fell from imperial favor, and Arbin Bayar was reinstated as league chief.

sentences.zh: 信勤、瑞良等相繼為墾務大臣。

translations.literal: Xin Qin, Ruiliang, and others succeeded one another as reclamation commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Qin, Ruiliang, and others served in turn as reclamation commissioners.

sentences.zh: 是部墾事進行未廢。

translations.literal: Reclamation in the tribe continued without being abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Reclamation work in the tribe went on without halt.

sentences.zh: 佐領即左翼中旗十七，右翼中旗八十四，左右翼前旗各四十二，左翼後旗四十，右翼後旗三十六，左翼前末旗十三。

translations.literal: There were seventeen zuoling in the left middle banner, eighty-four in the right middle banner, forty-two each in the left and right front banners, forty in the left rear banner, thirty-six in the right rear banner, and thirteen in the left front terminal banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zuoling numbered seventeen in the left middle banner, eighty-four in the right middle, forty-two each in the left and right front banners, forty in the left rear, thirty-six in the right rear, and thirteen in the left front terminal banner.

sentences.zh: 阿拉善厄魯特部，至京師五千里。

translations.literal: The Alxa Oirat department was five thousand li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Alxa Oirat department lay five thousand li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東鄂爾多斯，西額濟訥，南寧夏、涼州、甘州，北逾瀚海接賽音諾顏、扎薩克圖盟。

translations.literal: It bordered Ordos on the east, Ejin on the west, Ningxia, Liangzhou, and Ganzhou on the south, and beyond the Gobi it met the Sayin Noyon and Jasaktu leagues on the north.
translations.idiomatic: East lay Ordos, west Ejin, south Ningxia, Liangzhou, and Ganzhou, and north across the Gobi it adjoined the Sayin Noyon and Jasaktu leagues.

sentences.zh: 袤延七百餘里，即賀蘭山地駐牧蒙古。

translations.literal: It stretched more than seven hundred li, and Mongols pastured along the Helan Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The department ran more than seven hundred li; Mongols grazed along the Helan range.

sentences.zh: 系出元太祖弟哈布圖哈薩爾，與和碩特同族。

translations.literal: They descended from Khabtugh Khasar, younger brother of Genghis Khan, and were of the same clan as the Khoshut.
translations.idiomatic: Their line went back to Khabtugh Khasar, Genghis Khan's younger brother, and they shared clan with the Khoshut.

sentences.zh: 和碩特舊為四額魯特之一，故稱額魯特部。

translations.literal: The Khoshut had formerly been one of the four Oirats, hence the name Oirat department.
translations.idiomatic: The Khoshut were once one of the four Oirat tribes, which is why the department was called Oirat.

sentences.zh: 哈布圖哈薩爾十九傳至圖魯拜琥，號顧實汗。

translations.literal: Khabtugh Khasar's nineteenth-generation descendant Tursibayhu styled himself Gushi Khan.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth generation from Khabtugh Khasar came Tursibayhu, who took the title Gushi Khan.

sentences.zh: 有子巴延阿布該阿玉什，兄拜巴噶斯初育以為子。

translations.literal: He had a son, Bayan Abukhai Ajushi, whom his elder brother Baibagas first raised as his own.
translations.idiomatic: He had a son, Bayan Abukhai Ajushi, whom his elder brother Baibagas at first reared as his own child.

sentences.zh: 後自生子二：長鄂齊爾圖，次阿巴賴。

translations.literal: Later he himself had two sons: the elder Ejeit, the younger Abalai.
translations.idiomatic: He later fathered two sons of his own: the elder Ejeit and the younger Abalai.

sentences.zh: 遊牧河西套，稱西套厄魯特。

translations.literal: They pastured in the Western Hetao west of the Yellow River and were called the Western Hetao Oirats.
translations.idiomatic: They grazed in the Western Hetao west of the Yellow River and were known as the Western Hetao Oirats.

sentences.zh: 巴延阿布該阿玉什號達賴烏巴什。

translations.literal: Bayan Abukhai Ajushi styled himself Dalai Ubashi.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan Abukhai Ajushi took the title Dalai Ubashi.

sentences.zh: 子十六，居西套者，曰和囉理，曰墨爾根，曰額爾克，曰都喇勒，曰哈什哈，曰陀音，曰土謝圖羅卜藏，曰博第，曰多爾濟紮布，曰諾爾布扎木素，曰愛博果特，曰鄂木布。

translations.literal: Of his sixteen sons, those who lived in the Western Hetao were Helori, Morgen, Erke, Dulal, Hashiha, Tuoyin, Tuxietu Lobzang, Bodi, Dorji Jab, Norbuzamsu, Aibogote, and Ebum.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen sons followed him; those in the Western Hetao were Helori, Morgen, Erke, Dulal, Hashiha, Tuoyin, Tuxietu Lobzang, Bodi, Dorji Jab, Norbuzamsu, Aibogote, and Ebum.

sentences.zh: 和囉理號巴圖爾額爾克濟農，以來歸授扎薩克，賜牧阿拉善，諸昆弟子姓隸之。

translations.literal: Helori styled himself Batu Erke Jiyang; for coming over to submit he was appointed zasak, granted pasture at Alxa, and all his brothers, sons, and clansmen were placed under him.
translations.idiomatic: Helori styled himself Batu Erke Jiyang; on submitting he received the zasak appointment, was given Alxa for pasture, and his brothers, sons, and kinsmen were placed under his rule.

sentences.zh: 其居青海者，曰紮布，曰阿南達，曰伊特格勒，曰巴特巴。

translations.literal: Those who lived in Qinghai were Zhab, Ananda, Itegele, and Batba.
translations.idiomatic: Those who settled in Qinghai were Zhab, Ananda, Itegele, and Batba.

sentences.zh: 紮布授扎薩克，領其族。

translations.literal: Zhab was appointed zasak and led his clan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhab received the zasak appointment and headed his people.

sentences.zh: 見青海厄魯特部傳。

translations.literal: See the biography of the Qinghai Oirat department.
translations.idiomatic: See the account of the Qinghai Oirat department.

sentences.zh: 鄂齊爾圖號車臣汗，子三：長額爾德尼，子噶勒丹多爾濟；

translations.literal: Ejeit styled himself Sechen Khan and had three sons: the eldest Erdeni, whose son was Galdan Dorji;
translations.idiomatic: Ejeit took the title Sechen Khan and had three sons: the eldest Erdeni, whose son was Galdan Dorji;

sentences.zh: 次噶爾第巴，子羅卜藏袞布阿拉喇布坦；

translations.literal: the second Galdiba, whose son was Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan;
translations.idiomatic: the second Galdiba, whose son was Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan;

sentences.zh: 次伊拉古克三班第達呼圖克圖。

translations.literal: and the third Iraguk San Bandi Khutukhtu.
translations.idiomatic: and the third Iraguk San Bandi Khutukhtu.

sentences.zh: 後皆絕嗣。

translations.literal: Later all their lines died out.
translations.idiomatic: In time all these lines ended without heirs.

sentences.zh: 阿巴賴裔為準噶爾所掠，故不著。

translations.literal: Abalai's descendants were carried off by the Dzungars and are therefore not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Abalai's line was seized by the Dzungars and is omitted here.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，鄂齊爾圖遣使貢駝馬。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi Ejeit sent envoys presenting camels and horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 Ejeit sent tribute envoys with camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 六年，阿巴賴繼至。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Abalai followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Abalai came in turn.

sentences.zh: 七年，鄂齊爾圖使至，以喀爾喀煽蘇尼特部長騰機思叛，奏稱：「力能鋤逆，當相機為之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Ejeit's envoy arrived; because the Khalkha had incited Sunite chief Tenggis to rebel, he memorialized: "If I have the strength to root out the rebels, I shall act when the moment is right.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Ejeit's envoy came; learning that the Khalkha had stirred Sunite chief Tenggis to rebellion, he reported: "If I am able to destroy the rebels, I shall move when the time is ripe.

sentences.zh: 否則亦必修貢如初，不敢稍萌異志。

translations.literal: Otherwise I shall still maintain tribute as before and dare not harbor the slightest disloyal intent.
translations.idiomatic: If not, I shall still keep tribute as before and dare not cherish the least disloyal thought.

sentences.zh: 」諭絕喀爾喀，勿私通好。

translations.literal: He was ordered to break with the Khalkha and not communicate with them privately.
translations.idiomatic: He was instructed to sever ties with the Khalkha and make no private overtures.

sentences.zh: 嗣因額爾德尼、噶爾第巴、伊拉古克三班第達呼圖克圖及所部台吉、宰桑等朝貢，至者相接。

translations.literal: Thereafter Erdeni, Galdiba, Iraguk San Bandi Khutukhtu, and the taiji, zaisang, and others of their tribes came in succession to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Erdeni, Galdiba, Iraguk San Bandi Khutukhtu, and their taiji, zaisang, and other followers arrived one after another with tribute.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾台吉噶爾丹遊牧阿爾台，號博碩克圖汗，覬為厄魯特長。

translations.literal: Dzungar taiji Galdan pastured at Altai and styled himself Botoktu Khan, aspiring to become chief of the Oirats.
translations.idiomatic: Dzungar taiji Galdan grazed at Altai, styled himself Botoktu Khan, and sought to lead the Oirats.

sentences.zh: 鄂齊爾圖妻以孫女阿努，尋與隙。

translations.literal: Ejeit gave him his granddaughter Anu in marriage, but they soon fell out.
translations.idiomatic: Ejeit married his granddaughter Anu to him, yet they soon quarreled.

sentences.zh: 康熙十六年，噶爾丹以兵襲西套，戕鄂齊爾圖，破其部。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Kangxi Galdan attacked the Western Hetao with troops, killed Ejeit, and broke up his tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 16 Galdan marched on the Western Hetao, killed Ejeit, and shattered his tribe.

sentences.zh: 鄂齊爾圖妻曰多爾濟喇布坦，與喀爾喀墨爾根汗額列克妻，皆土爾扈特汗阿玉奇女兄也。

translations.literal: Ejeit's wife was Dorji Rabtan; the wife of Khalkha Morgen Khan Erlek was also a sister of Torghut Khan Ayuki.
translations.idiomatic: Ejeit's wife was Dorji Rabtan; Khalkha Morgen Khan Erlek's wife was likewise a sister of Torghut Khan Ayuki.

sentences.zh: 額列克孫察琿多爾濟號土謝圖濟汗，偵噶爾丹侵鄂齊爾圖兵援之不及，多爾濟喇布坦奔土爾扈特。

translations.literal: Erlek's grandson Chahur Dorji styled himself Tuxietu Ji Khan; learning that Galdan's force attacking Ejeit could not arrive in time to help, Dorji Rabtan fled to the Torghuts.
translations.idiomatic: Erlek's grandson Chahur Dorji styled himself Tuxietu Ji Khan; seeing that Galdan's army could not reach Ejeit in time, Dorji Rabtan fled to the Torghuts.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹遣使獻俘，諭曰：「鄂爾齊圖汗與噶爾丹向俱納貢。

translations.literal: Galdan sent envoys presenting captives, and an edict said: "Sechen Khan Ejeit and Galdan both formerly paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan sent envoys with captives, and the throne replied: "Sechen Khan Ejeit and Galdan both once paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 今噶爾丹侵殺鄂齊爾圖，獻所獲弓矢等物，朕不忍納也。

translations.literal: Now Galdan has invaded and killed Ejeit and presents bows, arrows, and other things taken from him; I cannot bear to accept them.
translations.idiomatic: Now Galdan has attacked and killed Ejeit and offers the bows, arrows, and other spoils; I cannot bring myself to receive them.

sentences.zh: 其卻之！

translations.literal: Send them back!
translations.idiomatic: Send them back!

sentences.zh: 」西套厄魯特既潰，或奔依達賴喇嘛，或被噶爾丹掠去。

translations.literal: Once the Western Hetao Oirats were broken, some fled to the Dalai Lama and others were carried off by Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: With the Western Hetao Oirats routed, some took refuge with the Dalai Lama while others were seized by Galdan.

sentences.zh: 和囉理率族屬避居大草灘，廬幙萬餘，守汛者遣之去，仍逐水草，徒戀處邊外。

translations.literal: Helori led his clansmen to take refuge at Dacaotan; more than ten thousand tents were there, and though the border guards sent them away, they still followed grass and water, lingering on the outer frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Helori withdrew with his people to Dacaotan, where more than ten thousand tents gathered; border guards drove them off, yet they still followed pasture and water, clinging to the outer marches.

sentences.zh: 有楚琥爾烏巴什者，噶爾丹叔父也。

translations.literal: There was one Chuwur Ubashi, Galdan's uncle.
translations.idiomatic: One Chuwur Ubashi was Galdan's uncle.

sentences.zh: 子五：長巴哈班第，次阿南達，次羅卜藏呼圖克圖，次犖章，次羅卜藏額琳沁。

translations.literal: He had five sons: the eldest Bahabandi, the second Ananda, the third Lobzang Khutukhtu, the fourth Luozhang, and the fifth Lobzang Erinchen.
translations.idiomatic: He had five sons: the eldest Bahabandi, the second Ananda, the third Lobzang Khutukhtu, the fourth Luozhang, and the fifth Lobzang Erinchen.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹以私憾襲殺巴哈班第，執楚琥爾烏巴什及羅卜藏額琳沁等禁之。

translations.literal: Galdan, over a private grudge, attacked and killed Bahabandi, then seized Chuwur Ubashi, Lobzang Erinchen, and the others and held them prisoner.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan, nursing a private grievance, struck down Bahabandi, then seized Chuwur Ubashi, Lobzang Erinchen, and the rest and imprisoned them.

sentences.zh: 巴哈班第子罕都為和囉理甥，時年十有三。

translations.literal: Bahabandi's son Han'u was Helori's nephew and was then thirteen years old.
translations.idiomatic: Bahabandi's son Han'u, Helori's nephew, was only thirteen.

sentences.zh: 其屬額爾德尼和碩齊攜之逃，以兵四百掠烏喇特戶畜，竄就和囉理，居額濟訥河。

translations.literal: His follower Erdeni Hoshoi fled with him at the head of four hundred soldiers, raided Urad households and livestock, and joined Helori on the Ejin River.
translations.idiomatic: His man Erdeni Hoshoi escaped with him and four hundred troops, looted Urad families and herds, and went to Helori on the Ejin River.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀台吉畢瑪里吉哩諦偵以告。

translations.literal: Khalkha taiji Bimrijirdi reported what he had learned.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha taiji Bimrijirdi sent word of what he had discovered.

sentences.zh: 會青海墨爾根台吉等察獻額爾德尼和碩齊所掠，遣使詰知為準噶爾屬，諭噶爾丹捕額爾德尼和碩齊治罪，並收和囉理歸牧，或非所屬當以告。

translations.literal: At the same time Qinghai Morgen taiji and others investigated and presented what Erdeni Hoshoi had plundered; envoys were sent to establish that they were Dzungar subjects, and Galdan was instructed to capture Erdeni Hoshoi for punishment, restore Helori to his pasture, or report if they were not his subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai Morgen taiji and others also examined the booty taken by Erdeni Hoshoi; envoys confirmed they were Dzungar followers, and Galdan was ordered to seize Erdeni Hoshoi for punishment, return Helori to his grazing grounds, or explain if they were not under his authority.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，噶爾丹奏和囉理等歸，達賴喇嘛已遣使召請，以醜年四月為限。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year Galdan reported that Helori and the others had returned and that the Dalai Lama had already sent envoys to summon them, with the fourth month of the yichou year as the deadline.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Galdan reported that Helori and his people had come back and that the Dalai Lama had summoned them, setting the fourth month of the yichou year as the limit.

sentences.zh: 是年蓋歲在亥。

translations.literal: That year happened to be a year of the boar.
translations.idiomatic: That year was indeed a boar year.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，罕都偕額爾德尼和碩齊遣使貢，請宥掠烏喇特罪，而和囉理戚屬嘗掠茂明安諸部牧產，前以服罪故宥之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Han'u together with Erdeni Hoshoi sent envoys with tribute, asking pardon for raiding Urad, while Helori's kinsmen had once plundered the herds of the Muminggan and other tribes and had earlier been pardoned after submitting.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Han'u and Erdeni Hoshoi sent tribute envoys begging forgiveness for raiding Urad; Helori's kin had also once looted Muminggan and other tribes, but were spared after confessing guilt.

sentences.zh: 至是諭曰：「和囉理既免罪，額爾德尼和碩齊等著一體赦。

translations.literal: At this time an edict said: "Since Helori has already been pardoned, Erdeni Hoshoi and the others are likewise to be forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: At this the throne ordered: "Helori having already been pardoned, Erdeni Hoshoi and his men shall be forgiven as well.

sentences.zh: 所貢准上納。

translations.literal: What they had presented in tribute was approved for acceptance.
translations.idiomatic: Their tribute was accepted.

sentences.zh: 先是羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦避噶爾丹，走唐古特。

translations.literal: Earlier Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan, fleeing Galdan, had gone to Tangut.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, fleeing Galdan, Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan had taken refuge in Tangut.

sentences.zh: 以達賴喇嘛言，表請賜居龍頭山，轄西套遺眾。

translations.literal: At the Dalai Lama's word he memorialized, asking to be granted residence at Longtoushan to rule the remnant people of the Western Hetao.
translations.idiomatic: On the Dalai Lama's recommendation he petitioned to settle at Longtoushan and bring the Western Hetao refugees under his authority.

sentences.zh: 命兵部督捕理事官拉都琥往勘。

translations.literal: Raduhu, the Board of War supervising officer for apprehension affairs, was ordered to go and investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Raduhu, a Board of War apprehension officer, was dispatched to inspect the site.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「龍頭山，蒙古謂之阿拉克鄂拉，乃甘州城北東大山，山脈綿延邊境。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Longtoushan, which the Mongols call Arak Ola, is the great mountain northeast of Ganzhou; its range extends along the border.
translations.idiomatic: He reported: "Longtoushan — the Mongols' Arak Ola — is the great massif northeast of Ganzhou, with ranges running along the frontier.

sentences.zh: 山口即邊關，建夏口城，距滍川堡五里；

translations.literal: The mountain pass is the border post; Xiakou Fort was built there, five li from Zhichuan Fort;
translations.idiomatic: The pass itself is a border station; Xiakou Fort stands there, five li from Zhichuan Fort;

sentences.zh: 山盡為寧遠堡，距龍頭山里許，有昌寧湖界之。

translations.literal: Where the mountain ends lies Ningyuan Fort, about a li from Longtoushan, with Changning Lake marking the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: The range ends at Ningyuan Fort, a li or so from Longtoushan, bounded by Changning Lake.

sentences.zh: 內地兵民耕牧已久，不宜令新附蒙古居。

translations.literal: Inland soldiers and civilians have long farmed and grazed there; it is not fitting to let newly submitted Mongols live there.
translations.idiomatic: Han soldiers and settlers have farmed and grazed there for years; newly submitted Mongols should not be placed there.

sentences.zh: 」上可其奏。

translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦徙牧布隆吉爾，土謝圖汗琿多爾濟以女妻之。

translations.literal: Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan moved to pasture at Bulungir, and Tuxietu Khan Chahur Dorji gave him a daughter in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan moved his herds to Bulungir, and Chahur Dorji, Tuxietu Khan of Khalkha, married a daughter to him.

sentences.zh: 事聞，諭廷臣曰：「前鄂齊爾圖汗為噶爾丹所戕，其孫羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦往求達賴喇嘛指授所居之地，達賴喇嘛令駐牧阿拉克鄂拉，因以為請。

translations.literal: When this was reported, the emperor told the court: "Formerly when Galdan killed Ejeit, his grandson Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan went to ask the Dalai Lama where he should live; the Dalai Lama told him to graze at Arak Ola, and so the request was made.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing this, the emperor told his ministers: "When Galdan killed Ejeit, his grandson Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan had asked the Dalai Lama where to settle; the Lama directed him to Arak Ola, and that was the basis of the petition.

sentences.zh: 鄂齊爾圖汗從子和囉理前沿邊駐牧罾曾，檄噶爾丹收取之，令羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦與喀爾喀互為犄角。

translations.literal: Ejeit's nephew Helori pastured along the frontier at Zengeng; an order was sent to Galdan to take them in, so that Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan and the Khalkha might serve as horns of a pincer.
translations.idiomatic: Ejeit's nephew Helori had grazed along the border at Zengeng; Galdan was ordered to receive them so Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan and the Khalkha could pin him from two sides.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹欲以兵向和囉理等，則恐喀爾喀躡之；

translations.literal: If Galdan wished to march against Helori and the others, he feared the Khalkha would press him from behind;
translations.idiomatic: If Galdan marched on Helori and his men, he feared the Khalkha would harry him from the rear;

sentences.zh: 欲以兵向喀爾喀，則恐和囉理等襲之。

translations.literal: if he wished to march against the Khalkha, he feared Helori and the others would strike from behind.
translations.idiomatic: if he marched on the Khalkha, he feared Helori and his men would strike from behind.

sentences.zh: 此必非噶爾丹所能收取也。

translations.literal: This was certainly not something Galdan could simply take by force.
translations.idiomatic: This was plainly beyond what Galdan could seize by force alone.

sentences.zh: 」二十四年，和囉理請賜敕印鈐部眾。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Helori requested an imperial patent and seal to govern his tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Helori asked for an imperial patent and seal to govern his people.

sentences.zh: 廷臣以遊牧未定，議不允。

translations.literal: The court, because their pastoral lands were unsettled, deliberated and refused.
translations.idiomatic: The court, finding their grazing grounds still unsettled, deliberated and refused.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「和囉理等以避亂，故離其舊牧，來至邊境，劫掠茂明安、烏喇特諸部，本應即行殄滅。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Helori and the others left their old pastures because of disorder and came to the frontier, where they raided the Muminggan, Urad, and other tribes — for this they should have been destroyed at once.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ran: "Helori and his people fled disorder and came to the frontier, where they raided Muminggan, Urad, and other tribes — they deserved immediate destruction.

sentences.zh: 朕俯念鄂齊爾圖汗世奉職貢，恪恭奔走，兼之彼亦迫於饑困，是以宥其罪戾。

translations.literal: I took thought for Ejeit's generations of loyal tribute and diligent service, and also that they were driven by hunger and hardship, and so pardoned their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: I remembered Ejeit's generations of loyal tribute and faithful service, and that hunger and hardship had driven them, and so I pardoned their crimes.

sentences.zh: 又羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦系鄂爾齊圖汗孫，為和囉理從子，應令聚合一處。

translations.literal: Moreover Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan is a grandson of Ejeit and Helori's nephew; they should be brought together in one place.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan is Ejeit's grandson and Helori's nephew; they should be gathered in one place.

sentences.zh: 其遣官往諭朕旨，度可居地歸併安置，封授名號，給賜金印璽書，以示朕興滅繼絕至意。

translations.literal: Send officials to convey My will, find suitable pasture for consolidated settlement, grant titles, and bestow a golden seal and patent letter to show My intent to restore the fallen and continue the broken line.
translations.idiomatic: Send officials to proclaim My will, find fit pasture for their consolidated settlement, grant titles, and bestow a golden seal and patent to show My intent to restore the fallen and carry on the broken line.

sentences.zh: 」理籓院尚書阿喇尼遵旨往諭。

translations.literal: Arani, minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, was dispatched on imperial command to proclaim this.
translations.idiomatic: Arani, minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, was sent to deliver the imperial message.

sentences.zh: 和囉理奏：「皇上令臣等聚處，乃殊恩。

translations.literal: Helori memorialized: "Your Majesty's order to gather us together is extraordinary grace.
translations.idiomatic: Helori memorialized: "Your Majesty's command to gather us together is extraordinary grace.

sentences.zh: 達賴喇嘛亦謂羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦居布隆吉爾，地隘草惡，不若與臣同處。

translations.literal: The Dalai Lama also said that Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan's pasture at Bulungir is cramped and the grass poor, and that it would be better for him to live with me.
translations.idiomatic: The Dalai Lama also said Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan's Bulungir pasture is cramped and the grass poor, and that he would do better to live with me.

sentences.zh: 臣等欲環居阿喇克山陰，遏寇盜，靖邊疆。

translations.literal: We wish to encamp around the northern slope of Arak Mountain to hold back raiders and pacify the border.
translations.idiomatic: We wish to encamp around the northern face of Arak Mountain to check raiders and quiet the frontier.

sentences.zh: 令部眾從此地而北，當喀爾喀台吉畢瑪里吉哩諦牧地，由噶爾拜瀚海、額濟訥河、姑喇柰河、雅布賴山、巴顏努魯、喀爾占、布林古特、洪果爾鄂隆以內，東倚喀爾喀丹津喇嘛牧，西極高河居之。

translations.literal: We would have our tribesmen move north from this place to the pasture of Khalkha taiji Bimrijirdi, and live within Garbayan Lake, the Ejin River, Guranai River, Yabrai Mountain, Bayannur, Karzhan, Buringut, and Hongguor Olong, with Khalkha Danjin Lama's pasture to the east and the Gaoge River as the western limit.
translations.idiomatic: We would move our people north from here to the grazing grounds of Khalkha taiji Bimrijirdi — within Garbayan Lake, the Ejin River, Guranai River, Yabrai Mountain, Bayannur, Karzhan, Buringut, and Hongguor Olong, bordered on the east by Khalkha Danjin Lama's pasture and on the west by the Gaoge River.

sentences.zh: 奏至，遣使諭達賴喇嘛曰：「噶爾丹滅鄂齊爾圖汗時，和囉理及羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦等紛紜離散，來至邊境，又以生計窘迫，妄行劫掠。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, envoys were sent to tell the Dalai Lama: "When Galdan destroyed Ejeit, Helori and Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan and the rest scattered in disarray to the frontier, and in their dire livelihoods they raided wantonly.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, envoys told the Dalai Lama: "When Galdan destroyed Ejeit, Helori, Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan, and the rest fled in disorder to the frontier and, pressed by hardship, raided recklessly.

sentences.zh: 朕宥其罪，不即發兵剿滅。

translations.literal: I pardoned their crimes and did not immediately send troops to exterminate them.
translations.idiomatic: I pardoned their crimes and did not send troops at once to destroy them.

sentences.zh: 和囉理等亦戴朕恩，屢請敕印，依朕為命。

translations.literal: Helori and the others also received My grace and repeatedly begged for patents and seals, obeying My command.
translations.idiomatic: Helori and his people also received My grace, repeatedly begged for patents and seals, and obeyed My command.

sentences.zh: 朕前諭噶爾丹收取，彼約以醜年四月為期，今逾期已數月矣。

translations.literal: I had earlier instructed Galdan to take them in; he set the fourth month of the yichou year as the deadline, and now that deadline has passed by several months.
translations.idiomatic: I had earlier ordered Galdan to receive them; he fixed the fourth month of the yichou year as the limit, and that limit is now months overdue.

sentences.zh: 伊等骨肉分離，散處失所，朕心殊為惻然！

translations.literal: Their flesh and blood are divided, scattered and homeless — My heart is deeply moved with pity!
translations.idiomatic: Kin are divided and scattered without a home — My heart is deeply moved with pity!

sentences.zh: 鄂齊爾圖汗於爾喇嘛為護法久矣，何忍漠視其子孫宗族至於窮困？

translations.literal: Ejeit has long been a guardian of your faith, Lama — how can you bear to ignore his sons and clan in such destitution?
translations.idiomatic: Ejeit has long guarded your faith, Lama — how can you ignore his sons and clan in such destitution?

sentences.zh: 今朕欲將伊等歸併安置，爾喇嘛其遣使與朕使偕往定議！

translations.literal: Now I wish to gather and settle them; you, Lama, should send envoys to go with Mine and fix the arrangement!
translations.idiomatic: Now I wish to gather and settle them; you, Lama, must send envoys with Mine to settle the matter!

sentences.zh: 二十五年，達賴喇嘛奏已遣使，上遣拉都琥往會勘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the Dalai Lama reported that he had sent envoys; the emperor sent Raduhu to meet and inspect.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year the Dalai Lama reported that he had sent envoys; the emperor dispatched Raduhu to meet and survey the ground.

sentences.zh: 拉都琥偕達賴喇嘛使約和囉理至東大山北，語之曰：「爾所謂噶爾拜瀚海地，聽爾遊牧。

translations.literal: Raduhu together with the Dalai Lama's envoys summoned Helori to the north of the Eastern Mountains and told him: "As for the Garbayan Lake country of which you spoke, you may graze there.
translations.idiomatic: Raduhu and the Dalai Lama's envoys summoned Helori to the north of the Eastern Mountains and told him: "The Garbayan Lake country you named is yours to graze.

sentences.zh: 外自寧夏所屬玉泉營西羅薩喀喇山嘴，後至賀蘭山陰一帶布林哈蘇台口，又自寧夏所屬倭波嶺塞口北努渾努魯山后甘州所屬鎮番塞口，北沿陶蘭泰、薩喇、椿濟、雷琿、希理等地，西南至額濟訥河，俱以距邊六十里為界，畫地識之。

translations.literal: Beyond that, from the Salakalashan Pass west of Yuquan Camp under Ningxia, then back to the northern slopes of Helan Mountain at Bulinhasutai Pass; and from Woboling Pass north of Yuquan Camp under Ningxia through Nuhunnuru Mountain to Zhenfan Pass under Ganzhou, then north along Taolantai, Sala, Chunji, Leihui, Xili, and other places, southwest to the Ejin River — all shall be bounded sixty li from the border, and the line shall be marked on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond that, from Salakalashan Pass west of Ningxia's Yuquan Camp back to the Helan northern slope at Bulinhasutai Pass; and from Woboling Pass north of Ningxia's Yuquan Camp through Nuhunnuru Mountain to Ganzhou's Zhenfan Pass, then north along Taolantai, Sala, Chunji, Leihui, Xili, and the like, southwest to the Ejin River — the boundary shall lie sixty li from the border throughout, and the line shall be marked on the ground.

sentences.zh: 」定議：蒙古殺邊民論死；

translations.literal: Agreement: Mongols who kill border subjects are punished by death;
translations.idiomatic: It was agreed: Mongols who kill frontier subjects shall be put to death;

sentences.zh: 盜牲畜、奪食物者鞭之；

translations.literal: those who steal livestock or seize food are flogged;
translations.idiomatic: those who steal livestock or seize food shall be flogged;

sentences.zh: 私入邊遊牧者，台吉、宰桑各罰牲畜有差；

translations.literal: those who enter the border to graze privately — taiji and zaisang are fined livestock in proportion;
translations.idiomatic: those who graze inside the border without permission — taiji and zaisang shall be fined livestock in proportion;

sentences.zh: 所屬犯科一次，罰濟農牲畜以五九。

translations.literal: for one offense by a subordinate, ji-nong livestock is fined on the five-nine scale.
translations.idiomatic: for one offense by a subordinate, ji-nong livestock shall be fined on the five-nine scale.

sentences.zh: 時罕都及額爾德尼和碩齊請與和囉理同牧。

translations.literal: At the time Han'u and Erdeni Hoshoi asked to graze with Helori.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Han'u and Erdeni Hoshoi asked to graze together with Helori.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦偵其女兄阿努攜兵千赴藏，道嘉峪關外，懼襲己，備之，以故未即徙。

translations.literal: Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan learned that his elder sister Anu was leading a thousand troops to Tibet by the route outside Jiayuguan; fearing she would attack him, he made preparations and therefore did not move at once.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan learned that his sister Anu was leading a thousand troops to Tibet by the road outside Jiayuguan; fearing an attack, he made ready and did not move at once.

sentences.zh: 拉都琥奏至，詔以所定地域及罰例檄甘肅守臣知之。

translations.literal: When Raduhu's memorial arrived, an edict ordered the fixed territory and penalties proclaimed to the Gansu frontier officials.
translations.idiomatic: When Raduhu's memorial arrived, an edict ordered the settled boundaries and penalties sent to the Gansu frontier officials.

sentences.zh: 蓋自是和囉理屬始定牧阿拉善。

translations.literal: From this time forward Helori's followers were first assigned pasture at Alxa.
translations.idiomatic: From this time Helori's followers were first assigned pasture at Alxa.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，和囉理欲往援，察琿多爾濟乞師於朝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Galdan invaded Khalkha; Helori wished to go to their aid, and Chahur Dorji begged the court for troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Galdan invaded Khalkha; Helori wished to go to their aid, and Chahur Dorji begged the court for troops.

sentences.zh: 時諭噶爾丹罷兵。

translations.literal: At the time an edict had been sent ordering Galdan to cease hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: At the time an edict had already ordered Galdan to cease hostilities.

sentences.zh: 使已就道，詔不允和囉理請。

translations.literal: The envoys were already on the road when an edict disallowed Helori's request.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys were already on the road when an edict refused Helori's request.

sentences.zh: 而羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦自率兵援喀爾喀，遇我使於道，宣諭之，亦撤歸布隆吉爾。

translations.literal: But Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan himself led troops to aid Khalkha; meeting Our envoys on the road, after they announced the imperial will he also withdrew to Bulungir.
translations.idiomatic: But Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan himself led troops to aid Khalkha; meeting Our envoys on the road, he accepted their proclamation and withdrew to Bulungir.

sentences.zh: 察琿多爾濟尋為噶爾丹所敗，上復遣使諭噶爾丹，將行，命之曰：「噶爾丹若問和囉理事，爾等宜述醜年之約，並言達賴喇嘛向雖遣使定議，令和囉理與羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦歸併安置，迄今尚未同居。

translations.literal: Chahur Dorji was soon defeated by Galdan; the emperor again sent envoys to instruct Galdan, and before they set out he ordered them: "If Galdan asks about Helori, you should recount the yichou-year agreement and say that although the Dalai Lama formerly sent envoys to settle the matter and ordered Helori and Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan to be gathered and settled together, they have still not lived together to this day.
translations.idiomatic: Chahur Dorji was soon defeated by Galdan; the emperor again sent envoys to instruct Galdan, and before they set out ordered them: "If Galdan asks about Helori, recount the yichou-year agreement and say that though the Dalai Lama once sent envoys to settle the matter and ordered Helori and Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan gathered and settled together, they have still not lived together.

sentences.zh: 和囉理雖居遊牧邊地，亦未編設旗隊。

translations.literal: Although Helori grazes on the border, banners and companies have not yet been organized for him.
translations.idiomatic: Although Helori grazes on the frontier, no banners or companies have yet been organized for him.

sentences.zh: 前喀爾喀與額魯特交惡，和囉理曾請兵討爾。

translations.literal: Formerly, when Khalkha and the Oirats were at enmity, Helori once asked for troops to punish you.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, when Khalkha and the Oirats were at enmity, Helori once asked for troops to punish you.

sentences.zh: 朕仍諭遣之曰：『朕欲使爾等安處遊牧而已，豈肯給爾兵耶？

translations.literal: I still sent him word: 'I only wish you to dwell safely on your pastures — would I give you troops?'
translations.idiomatic: I still sent word: 'I only wish you to dwell safely on your pastures — would I give you troops?'

sentences.zh: 』其以是告之，令罷兵。

translations.literal: Tell him this and order him to cease hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: Tell him this and order him to cease hostilities.

sentences.zh: 」噶爾丹不從。

translations.idiomatic: Galdan would not comply.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，以羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦卒，賜祭。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan died and sacrificial offerings were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan died, and sacrificial offerings were granted.

sentences.zh: 其妻及宰桑等請召噶爾丹多爾濟轄部眾，允之。

translations.literal: His wife and zaisang and others asked to summon Galdan Dorji to govern the tribesmen; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: His wife and zaisang and others asked to summon Galdan Dorji to govern the tribesmen; this was granted.

sentences.zh: 時噶爾丹多爾濟遊牧準噶爾界，諭曰：「羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦屬內附，所遺部眾恐致流亡。

translations.literal: At the time Galdan Dorji was grazing on the Dzungar border; an edict said: "Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan's followers have submitted; the tribesmen he left behind may flee and scatter.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Galdan Dorji was grazing on the Dzungar border; an edict said: "Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan's people have submitted; the tribesmen he left behind may flee and scatter.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹多爾濟尚幼，召之恐未即至。

translations.literal: Galdan Dorji is still young; if summoned he may not arrive promptly.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Dorji is still young; if summoned he may not arrive at once.

sentences.zh: 著和囉理前往布隆吉爾，暫為約束人民。

translations.literal: Helori is to go to Bulungir and temporarily restrain the people.
translations.idiomatic: Helori is to go to Bulungir and temporarily keep the people in order.

sentences.zh: 俟噶爾丹多爾濟至，仍歸本地。

translations.literal: When Galdan Dorji arrives he shall return to his own place.
translations.idiomatic: When Galdan Dorji arrives he shall return to his own place.

sentences.zh: 務期共相扶掖，勿侵據所部。

translations.literal: They must support one another and not encroach on one another's followers.
translations.idiomatic: They must support one another and not encroach on one another's followers.

sentences.zh: 」噶爾丹多爾濟以所部饑，告不克即徙。

translations.literal: Galdan Dorji, because his tribesmen were starving, reported that he could not move at once.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Dorji, his tribesmen starving, reported that he could not move at once.

sentences.zh: 詔授諾顏號，遣侍讀學士達琥諭恤所部貧民。

translations.literal: An edict granted him the title of noyan; Reader of the Hanlin Academy Dahu was sent to relieve the poor among his tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted him the title of noyan; Hanlin reader Dahu was sent to relieve the poor among his tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 其母紮木蘇攜噶爾丹多爾濟至，詔轄羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦眾，附阿拉善牧。

translations.literal: His mother Zamsu brought Galdan Dorji; an edict placed Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan's people under his rule, attached to Alxa pasture.
translations.idiomatic: His mother Zamsu brought Galdan Dorji; an edict placed Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan's people under his rule on Alxa pasture.

sentences.zh: 有拜達者，罕都屬也，偕額爾德尼和碩齊誘其主棄和囉理，私以厄魯特兵千掠邊番。

translations.literal: One Baida, a follower of Han'u, together with Erdeni Hoshoi induced his master to abandon Helori and privately led a thousand Oirat troops to raid frontier tribes.
translations.idiomatic: One Baida, a follower of Han'u, together with Erdeni Hoshoi persuaded his master to abandon Helori and privately led a thousand Oirat troops to raid frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 守汛者責之，為所戕，且抗官軍。

translations.literal: The border guards reproved them; they were killed, and they also resisted the government troops.
translations.idiomatic: The border guards reproved them; they killed the guards and also resisted the government troops.

sentences.zh: 甘肅提督孫思克以兵屯邊，將剿之。

translations.literal: Gansu provincial commander-in-chief Sun Sike stationed troops on the frontier and was about to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu commander-in-chief Sun Sike posted troops on the frontier and was about to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 罕都懼，乃降詔宥罪，仍駐牧阿拉善。

translations.literal: Han'u feared; an edict then pardoned the offense and allowed him to remain grazing at Alxa.
translations.idiomatic: Han'u was afraid; an edict then pardoned the offense and allowed him to remain grazing at Alxa.

sentences.zh: 其叔父羅卜藏額琳沁尋自準噶爾至，奏為噶爾丹所禁十餘年，以準噶爾與喀爾喀戰，乘間脫，挈孥屬千餘至，乞與兄子罕都同居，允之。

translations.literal: His uncle Lobzang Erinchen soon came from Dzungar, memorializing that Galdan had held him prisoner for more than ten years; when Dzungar and Khalkha were at war he seized the chance to escape, bringing more than a thousand wives, children, and followers, and begged to live with his brother's son Han'u; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Lobzang Erinchen soon came from Dzungar, reporting that Galdan had held him for more than ten years; when Dzungar and Khalkha were at war he seized the chance to escape with more than a thousand wives, children, and followers, and begged to live with his brother's son Han'u; this was granted.

sentences.zh: 三十年，和囉理以不遵旨徙牧歸化城，懼大兵討，叛遁。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year Helori, for failing to obey the order to move pasture to Guihua, feared punitive troops and rebelled and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Helori, having failed to obey the order to move pasture to Guihua, feared punitive troops and rebelled and fled.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹多爾濟、羅卜藏額琳沁、罕都等從之，分道竄。

translations.literal: Galdan Dorji, Lobzang Erinchen, Han'u, and others followed him and fled by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Dorji, Lobzang Erinchen, Han'u, and others followed him and fled by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 將軍尼雅漢等招降噶爾丹多爾濟屬納木喀班爾等五十餘戶、和囉理女弟之夫克奇及從者二十一人以聞，詔安置歸化城。

translations.literal: General Niyahan and others induced the surrender of more than fifty households of Galdan Dorji's follower Namkabandar and Helori's younger sister's husband Keqi with twenty-one followers; an edict ordered them settled at Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: General Niyahan and others induced the surrender of more than fifty households of Galdan Dorji's follower Namkabandar and Helori's brother-in-law Keqi with twenty-one followers; an edict ordered them settled at Guihua.

sentences.zh: 時和囉理弟博第遊牧中衛邊外，距阿拉善三百餘里，聞其兄叛遁，欲往會偵。

translations.literal: At the time Helori's younger brother Bodi was grazing beyond Zhongwei on the frontier, more than three hundred li from Alxa; hearing his elder brother had rebelled and fled, he wished to go join him and scout.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Helori's younger brother Bodi was grazing beyond Zhongwei on the frontier, more than three hundred li from Alxa; hearing his elder brother had rebelled and fled, he wished to join him and scout.

sentences.zh: 副將軍陳祚昌等屯昌寧湖，遣子索諾木至軍，詭稱假道詢南山，否則請牧馬昌寧湖。

translations.literal: Vice-general Chen Zuochang and others were stationed at Changning Lake; Bodi sent his son Sonom to the army, falsely claiming he sought passage to inquire about the southern mountains, otherwise asking to graze horses at Changning Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Vice-general Chen Zuochang and others were stationed at Changning Lake; Bodi sent his son Sonom to the army, falsely claiming he sought passage to inquire about the southern mountains, otherwise asking to graze horses at Changning Lake.

sentences.zh: 祚昌知為緩軍計，令挈屬至歸化城。

translations.literal: Zuochang knew this was a delaying tactic and ordered him to bring his followers to Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: Zuochang saw this as a delaying tactic and ordered him to bring his followers to Guihua.

sentences.zh: 不從，擊之，斬五百餘級，博第僅以身免，走伊巴賴，遇和囉理屬台吉齊奇克假糧馬，竄額濟訥河。

translations.literal: He refused; they attacked, killed more than five hundred, and Bodi barely escaped with his life; he fled to Yibai, met Helori's tribesman taiji Qiqike to borrow grain and horses, and fled to the Ejin River.
translations.idiomatic: He refused; they attacked and killed more than five hundred; Bodi barely escaped, fled to Yibai, met Helori's taiji Qiqike to borrow grain and horses, and fled to the Ejin River.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，和囉理悔罪，降，命仍牧阿拉善。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Helori repented and submitted; he was ordered to graze at Alxa again.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Helori repented and submitted; he was ordered to graze at Alxa again.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏額琳沁、罕都、齊奇克等從和囉理降。

translations.literal: Lobzang Erinchen, Han'u, Qiqike, and others submitted with Helori.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Erinchen, Han'u, Qiqike, and others submitted with Helori.

sentences.zh: 尋復叛走。

translations.literal: Before long they rebelled and fled again.
translations.idiomatic: Before long they rebelled and fled again.

sentences.zh: 提督孫思克以兵追至庫勒圖，斬四十餘級。

translations.literal: Provincial commander Sun Sike pursued with troops to Kuletu and killed more than forty.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Sun Sike pursued with troops to Kuletu and killed more than forty.

sentences.zh: 齊奇克就擒，詔宥死，附和囉理牧。

translations.literal: Qiqike was captured; an edict pardoned his life and allowed him to graze with Helori.
translations.idiomatic: Qiqike was captured; an edict spared his life and allowed him to graze with Helori.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏額琳沁、罕都逸，遇自青海來歸之喀爾喀台吉阿海岱青班第，掠其貲，復竄哈密。

translations.literal: Lobzang Erinchen and Han'u escaped; meeting Khalkha taiji Ahaidai Qingbandi returning from Qinghai, they plundered his goods and fled again to Hami.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Erinchen and Han'u escaped; meeting Khalkha taiji Ahaidai Qingbandi returning from Qinghai, they plundered his goods and fled again toward Hami.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏袞布阿喇布坦有女弟曰阿海，始與策妄阿喇布坦議婚，噶爾丹奪之。

translations.literal: Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan had a younger sister named Ahai; she had first been betrothed to Tsewang Alakhabtan, but Galdan seized her.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Gunbu Alakhabtan had a younger sister named Ahai; she had first been betrothed to Tsewang Alakhabtan, but Galdan seized her.

sentences.zh: 策妄阿喇布坦怒，噶爾丹徙額琳哈畢爾噶。

translations.literal: Tsewang Alakhabtan was enraged; Galdan moved to Ergen Khobirga.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewang Alakhabtan was enraged; Galdan moved to Ergen Khobirga.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，遣員外郎馬迪齎敕諭令絕噶爾丹。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of this, he sent Department Director Ma Di bearing an imperial patent ordering him to break with Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of this, he sent Department Director Ma Di with an imperial patent ordering him to break with Galdan.

sentences.zh: 道哈密，羅卜藏額琳沁、罕都等偕噶爾丹屬圖克齊哈什哈、哈爾海達顏額爾克以兵劫之，由大草灘毀邊垣遁，為青海台吉額爾德尼納木紮勒所擊，走死。

translations.literal: On the road through Hami, Lobzang Erinchen, Han'u, and others together with Galdan's followers Tuketi Hashiha, Har Hai Dayan Erke, and others waylaid him with troops; they broke through the border wall at Dacaotan and fled, were struck by Qinghai taiji Erdeni Namjazal, and fled to their deaths.
translations.idiomatic: On the road through Hami, Lobzang Erinchen, Han'u, and others together with Galdan's followers Tuketi Hashiha, Har Hai Dayan Erke, and others waylaid him with troops; they broke through the border wall at Dacaotan and fled, were struck down by Qinghai taiji Erdeni Namjazal, and perished in flight.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，和囉理弟博第率屬百餘降，乞仍與兄同牧，許之，命輯所屬潰散者。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year Helori's younger brother Bodi led more than a hundred followers to submit, begging to graze again with his elder brother; this was granted, and he was ordered to gather his scattered followers.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year Helori's younger brother Bodi led more than a hundred followers to submit, begging to graze again with his elder brother; this was granted, and he was ordered to gather his scattered followers.

sentences.zh: 未幾，齊奇克復叛遁。

translations.literal: Before long Qiqike rebelled and fled again.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Qiqike rebelled and fled again.

sentences.zh: 和囉理遣所部莽奈哈什哈等以兵追諸耨爾格山，諭之降，不從，擊斬之。

translations.literal: Helori sent Mangnai Hashiha and others with troops in pursuit to Zhunuo'erge Mountain; they urged him to submit, and when he refused they attacked and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Helori sent Mangnai Hashiha and others in pursuit to Zhunuo'erge Mountain; they urged him to submit, and when he refused they attacked and killed him.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，所部兵隨西路大軍敗噶爾丹於昭莫多，副都統阿南達奉命設哨，以和囉理屬布林噶齊達爾漢宰桑瑪賴額爾克哈什哈、齊勞墨爾根薩里呼納沁齊倫琿塔漢占哈什哈、布達哩杜喇勒和碩齊等，分屯額布格特、阿木格特、昆都倫、額濟訥及布隆吉爾之博羅椿濟敖齊、喀喇莽奈諸地。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the tribesmen followed the western-route main army in defeating Galdan at Jao Modo; Vice-commandant Ananda was ordered to set outposts, with Helori's followers — zaisang Malai Erke Hashiha of Blingachidarhan, Qilaomergen Sari Hunaqin Qilun Hutahan Hashiha, Budiri Dural Hoshoi, and others — stationed separately at Ebugte, Amugte, Khundlun, Ejin, Bolochunji Aoqi of Bulungir, Kar Mangnai, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year the tribesmen followed the western-route main army in defeating Galdan at Jao Modo; Vice-commandant Ananda was ordered to set outposts, with Helori's followers — zaisang Malai Erke Hashiha of Blingachidarhan, Qilaomergen Sari Hunaqin Qilun Hutahan Hashiha, Budiri Dural Hoshoi, and others — posted separately at Ebugte, Amugte, Khundlun, Ejin, Bolochunji Aoqi of Bulungir, Kar Mangnai, and other places.

sentences.zh: 時噶爾丹多爾濟竄徙嘉峪關外。

translations.literal: At the time Galdan Dorji had fled outside Jiayuguan.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Galdan Dorji had fled outside Jiayuguan.

sentences.zh: 有哨卒拜格者，其屬也。

translations.literal: There was one sentry Baige, one of his followers.
translations.idiomatic: There was one sentry Baige, one of his followers.

sentences.zh: 阿南達召至，遣歸說噶爾丹多爾濟曰：「上待汝恩甚厚，將撫育之，顧叛逃可乎？

translations.literal: Ananda summoned him and sent him back to tell Galdan Dorji: "The emperor's grace toward you is very great; he will nurture you — yet can you rebel and flee?
translations.idiomatic: Ananda summoned him and sent him back to tell Galdan Dorji: "The emperor's grace toward you is very great; he will nurture you — yet can you rebel and flee?

sentences.zh: 和囉理棄牧時，汝不能輯屬，故從往。

translations.literal: When Helori abandoned his pasture you could not keep your followers together, and so you followed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Helori abandoned his pasture you could not keep your followers together, and so you followed him.

sentences.zh: 上灼知汝情，念汝祖鄂齊爾圖汗，將玉成汝，汝其思之！

translations.literal: The emperor knows your circumstances clearly; remembering your grandfather Ejeit, he will see you through to success — think on this!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor knows your circumstances clearly; remembering your grandfather Ejeit, he will see you through — think on this!

sentences.zh: 」噶爾丹多爾濟遣告曰：「上念臣祖兄，令臣與和囉理接壤居。

translations.literal: Galdan Dorji sent word: "The emperor, mindful of my grandfather and elder brother, ordered me to live adjoining Helori.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Dorji sent word: "The emperor, mindful of my grandfather and elder brother, ordered me to live adjoining Helori.

sentences.zh: 臣無知，從和囉理叛遁，今悔罪欲死。

translations.literal: I was ignorant and followed Helori in rebellion and flight; now I repent and wish to die.
translations.idiomatic: I was ignorant and followed Helori in rebellion and flight; now I repent and wish to die.

sentences.zh: 臣幼，臣母一婦人，未能達。

translations.literal: I am young; my mother is but a woman and cannot make herself understood.
translations.idiomatic: I am still young; my mother is only a woman and cannot speak for herself.

sentences.zh: 乞以情代奏。

translations.literal: I beg that you relay my feelings on my behalf.
