translations.idiomatic: I beg you to report my circumstances in my stead.

sentences.zh: 」阿南達欲堅內附志，遣使歸，約如期會肅州，諭設哨援哈密，復檄哈密伯克額貝都拉曰：「噶爾丹至汝地，汝即召噶爾丹多爾濟援，勿復疑。

translations.literal: " Ananda, wishing to strengthen his resolve to remain within the empire, sent the envoy back, appointed a meeting at Suzhou on schedule, instructed that outposts be set to aid Hami, and again wrote to Hami beg Ebedula: "If Galdan comes to your territory, summon Galdan Dorji to aid you at once — do not doubt again.
translations.idiomatic: " Ananda, wishing to fix his mind on inner submission, sent the envoy back, fixed a date to meet at Suzhou, ordered outposts set to support Hami, and again instructed Hami beg Ebedula: "If Galdan reaches your lands, call Galdan Dorji to your aid at once — harbor no further doubts.

sentences.zh: 」噶爾丹多爾濟遣宰桑阿約等齎降表，表至肅州。

translations.literal: " Galdan Dorji sent zaisang Ayue and others bearing a submission petition; the petition reached Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " Galdan Dorji sent zaisang Ayue and others with a surrender memorial, which reached Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 會上視師寧夏，阿南達馳疏至，詔優恤所部眾。

translations.literal: Just then the emperor was inspecting the army at Ningxia when Ananda's urgent memorial arrived; an edict ordered generous relief for his tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor happened to be reviewing troops at Ningxia when Ananda's urgent memorial arrived; an edict ordered special relief for his people.

sentences.zh: 未幾，唐古特部第巴煽青海諸台吉盟察罕托羅海，繕軍械助之。

translations.literal: Before long the Tangut depa incited the Qinghai taijis to assemble at Chagan Torohai and supplied them with arms.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Tangut depa stirred the Qinghai taijis to league at Chagan Torohai and furnished them with weapons.

sentences.zh: 檄噶爾丹多爾濟以兵往，辭不赴，遣使俄濟通問策妄阿喇布坦，自攜兵百會阿南達於布隆吉爾。

translations.literal: An order summoned Galdan Dorji with troops, but he declined; he sent envoy Oji to consult Tsewang Rabtan and personally brought a hundred men to meet Ananda at Bulungir.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to march with troops but refused; he sent envoy Oji to sound out Tsewang Rabtan and himself brought a hundred men to join Ananda at Bulungir.

sentences.zh: 阿南達偵噶爾丹死，其從子丹濟拉竄瀚海，遣噶爾丹多爾濟屬輝特台吉羅卜藏等駝赴噶斯，而自偕噶爾丹多爾濟以兵繼之。

translations.literal: Ananda learned that Galdan was dead and his nephew Danjila had fled into the Gobi; he sent Galdan Dorji's follower, Khoshid taiji Lobzang, and others with camels to Gas, while he himself followed with Galdan Dorji and troops.
translations.idiomatic: Ananda learned that Galdan had died and his nephew Danjila had fled into the desert; he sent Galdan Dorji's man, Khoshid taiji Lobzang, and others with camels toward Gas, while he himself followed with Galdan Dorji and troops.

sentences.zh: 至色爾滕，值俄濟歸，以丹濟拉將自郭蠻喇嘛所往附策妄阿喇布坦告。

translations.literal: At Serteng they met Oji returning and learned that Danjila was about to go from Guoman Lama's place to join Tsewang Rabtan.
translations.idiomatic: At Serteng they met Oji on his return, who reported that Danjila was about to leave Guoman Lama's seat and submit to Tsewang Rabtan.

sentences.zh: 因撤噶斯兵，遣噶爾丹多爾濟仍赴布隆設哨，其屬阿勒達爾哈什哈、恭格等煽之叛，至西欣驛劫駝馬，奉母劄木蘇由吉爾喀喇烏蘇遁。

translations.literal: Accordingly he withdrew the Gas troops and sent Galdan Dorji again to Bulung to set outposts; but followers Aledar Hashiha, Gongge, and others incited him to rebel. At Xixin Post they looted camels and horses and fled with his mother Zamsu by way of Jier Kar Usu.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore recalled the Gas detachment and sent Galdan Dorji back to Bulung to man outposts; but his followers Aledar Hashiha, Gongge, and others stirred him to revolt. At Xixin Post they seized camels and horses and fled with his mother Zamsu by way of Jier Kar Usu.

sentences.zh: 阿南達遣兵四百追之，不及，招降其屬茂海、烏納恩巴圖爾、阿喇木劄木巴、阿喇木把及輝特台吉羅卜藏等，遣歸阿拉善。

translations.literal: Ananda sent four hundred men in pursuit but failed to overtake them; he induced the surrender of followers Maohai, Unaen Batu, Alam Zamba, Alamba, and Khoshid taiji Lobzang, and sent them back to Alxa.
translations.idiomatic: Ananda sent four hundred men in pursuit but could not catch them; he won over followers Maohai, Unaen Batu, Alam Zamba, Alamba, and Khoshid taiji Lobzang and sent them back to Alxa.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏後徙牧喀爾喀，即附扎薩克圖汗部之厄魯特扎薩克也。

translations.literal: Lobzang later moved his herds to Khalkha and became the Oirat zasak attached to the Jasaktu Khan league.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang later migrated to Khalkha and became the Oirat zasak under the Jasaktu Khan league.

sentences.zh: 是年，和囉理以所部數叛，請視四十九旗例編佐領。

translations.literal: That year, because his tribesmen had rebelled repeatedly, Helori asked that they be organized into company officers after the example of the forty-nine banners.
translations.idiomatic: That year Helori, his people having rebelled several times, asked that they be registered into company officers on the model of the forty-nine banners.

sentences.zh: 廷臣議徙烏喇特界，諭曰：「若將和囉理移牧近地，則沿邊別部蒙古甚多，豈可盡徙？

translations.literal: Court officials proposed moving them to the Urad border; an edict said: "If Helori is moved to graze nearer in, there are many other Mongol tribes all along the frontier — can they all be moved?
translations.idiomatic: Court officials proposed relocating them to the Urad frontier; the throne replied: "If Helori is moved to graze nearer the border, there are many other Mongol tribes along the marches — can they all be relocated?

sentences.zh: 且治蒙古貴得其道，不系地之遠近。

translations.literal: Moreover, governing Mongols depends on doing it rightly, not on how near or far the land may be.
translations.idiomatic: Besides, governing Mongols depends on doing it well, not on whether the land is near or far.

sentences.zh: 著停徙，仍遊牧阿拉善地。

translations.literal: Order the move halted; let them continue to graze in Alxa.
translations.idiomatic: Let the relocation cease; they shall continue to pasture in Alxa.

sentences.zh: 」詔和囉理為多羅貝勒，給扎薩克印。

translations.literal: " Helori was enfeoffed as Doroi beile and given the zasak seal.
translations.idiomatic: " Helori was made Doroi beile and granted the zasak seal.

sentences.zh: 復以噶爾丹多爾濟竄赴準噶爾，敕策妄阿喇布坦曰：「噶爾丹多爾濟率屬來降，安置耕種。

translations.literal: Because Galdan Dorji had fled to Dzungaria, an edict was sent to Tsewang Rabtan: "Galdan Dorji led his people in submission and was settled to farm.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Dorji having fled to Dzungaria, the throne instructed Tsewang Rabtan: "Galdan Dorji came leading his followers in surrender and was settled to cultivate the land.

sentences.zh: 今忽留其屬人，棄眾私遁，其中必有不得已之情，務即察明具奏。

translations.literal: Now he has suddenly left his people behind and fled alone; there must be compelling reasons — investigate at once and report in full.
translations.idiomatic: Now he has suddenly abandoned his followers and fled in secret; there must be reasons beyond his control — investigate immediately and report fully.

sentences.zh: 朕於噶爾丹多爾濟略無責備之意，且降旨收集其遺眾。

translations.literal: I harbor no intention of blaming Galdan Dorji, and have already ordered his scattered people gathered in.
translations.idiomatic: I have no wish to reproach Galdan Dorji, and have already ordered his remaining people collected.

sentences.zh: 儻往汝地，汝可善為撫恤。

translations.literal: If he comes to your territory, treat him kindly and give him relief.
translations.idiomatic: Should he reach your lands, receive him kindly and provide for him.

sentences.zh: 如欲內徙，即行遣歸。

translations.literal: If he wishes to move inward, send him back at once.
translations.idiomatic: If he wishes to move within the empire, send him back immediately.

sentences.zh: 」時噶爾丹多爾濟陽附策妄阿喇布坦，陰貳之。

translations.literal: " At the time Galdan Dorji outwardly submitted to Tsewang Rabtan while secretly wavering in loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: " At this time Galdan Dorji openly submitted to Tsewang Rabtan but secretly turned disloyal.

sentences.zh: 策妄阿喇布坦將侵哈薩克，噶爾丹多爾濟詭以兵從，中道遁庫車，為回眾所殺。

translations.literal: When Tsewang Rabtan was about to invade the Kazakhs, Galdan Dorji falsely offered to follow with troops, then fled midway to Kucha and was killed by the Muslim people there.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewang Rabtan was preparing to attack the Kazakhs; Galdan Dorji pretended to march with him, then broke away midway to Kucha and was killed by the local Muslims.

sentences.zh: 母劄木蘇攜屬九百餘奔青海部，青海諸台吉以獻。

translations.literal: His mother Zamsu fled with more than nine hundred followers to the Qinghai tribes; the Qinghai taijis presented them to the court.
translations.idiomatic: His mother Zamsu fled with more than nine hundred followers to Qinghai; the Qinghai taijis delivered them to the court.

sentences.zh: 詔安置什巴爾台，隸察哈爾。

translations.literal: An edict ordered them settled at Shibaertai under Chahar jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: An edict settled them at Shibaertai under Chahar.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，和囉理子阿寶尚郡王，授和碩額駙，賜第京師。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year Helori's son Aboo, already a junwang, was made Hoshoi efu and granted a residence in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year Helori's son Aboo, already a prince of the second rank, was made imperial son-in-law and given a mansion in the capital.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，襲貝勒。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year he succeeded to the beile rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year he inherited the beile title.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，以參贊往會西安將軍廣柱等，駐巴里坤，襲擊準噶爾於伊勒布林和碩、阿克塔斯、烏魯木齊諸地，皆捷。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, as assistant minister he joined Xi'an General Guangzhu and others, stationed at Barkul, and raided the Dzungars at Ile Bulin Khoshuu, Aqtas, Urumqi, and other places — all with success.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year, serving as assistant minister, he joined Xi'an General Guangzhu at Barkul and struck the Dzungars at Ile Bulin Khoshuu, Aqtas, Urumqi, and elsewhere — all successfully.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，參贊平逆將軍延信軍敗準噶爾，有克河、齊諾郭勒、綽瑪喇諸捷，護達賴喇嘛入藏。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year, as assistant minister under Pacification General Yanxin, he helped defeat the Dzungars, winning victories at Kehe, Qinogol, and Chuomala, and escorted the Dalai Lama into Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year, as assistant minister under Pacification General Yanxin, he helped rout the Dzungars at Kehe, Qinogol, Chuomala, and other battles, and escorted the Dalai Lama into Tibet.

sentences.zh: 年羹堯奉諭遣歸遊牧。

translations.literal: Nian Gengyao, by imperial order, sent him back to his pastures.
translations.idiomatic: On imperial instruction Nian Gengyao sent him back to graze his herds.

sentences.zh: 未幾，來朝，上憫其勞，詔封多羅郡王。

translations.literal: Before long he came to court; the emperor, pitying his labors, enfeoffed him as Doroi junwang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he came to court; moved by his service, the throne enfeoffed him as Doroi junwang.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，大軍定青海，王大臣等議阿拉善為寧夏邊外要地，青海顧實汗諸子裔舊皆遊牧山后，今或徙山前，請敕阿拉善扎薩克郡王阿寶飭青海眾歸牧山后，允之。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 2, after the main army pacified Qinghai, princes and ministers agreed that Alxa was a vital place beyond the Ningxia border; the descendants of Gushi Khan's sons had formerly grazed north of the mountains, but some had now moved south of them — they asked that Alxa zasak junwang Aboo be ordered to drive the Qinghai people back to graze north of the mountains, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2, once the main army had pacified Qinghai, princes and ministers held that Alxa was a key point beyond the Ningxia frontier; Gushi Khan's descendants had long pastured north of the mountains, but some had now shifted south — they asked that Alxa zasak junwang Aboo be instructed to return the Qinghai tribes to the northern slopes, and this was approved.

sentences.zh: 阿寶奏：「臣祖顧實汗歸誠內附，百年於茲，受天朝恩甚厚。

translations.literal: Aboo memorialized: "My ancestor Gushi Khan submitted in good faith; a hundred years have passed, and the grace of the dynasty has been exceedingly great.
translations.idiomatic: Aboo memorialized: "My ancestor Gushi Khan came over in sincere submission; a century has passed since then, and the dynasty's favor has been boundless.

sentences.zh: 前青海昆弟阻兵構亂，上幹天討，臣當束身受誅。

translations.literal: When my Qinghai kinsmen took up arms in rebellion, Heaven's punishment fell upon them; I ought to have bound myself and awaited execution.
translations.idiomatic: When my Qinghai brothers raised arms in rebellion, the court invoked Heaven's judgment; I should have offered myself for punishment.

sentences.zh: 重荷恩宥，令安遊牧，感激莫報。

translations.literal: Instead I have again received pardon and been allowed to graze in peace — my gratitude cannot be repaid.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I was again spared and allowed to pasture in peace — gratitude beyond repayment.

sentences.zh: 乞賜青海曠地，令臣鈐諸部，不復萌異志。

translations.literal: I beg that open lands in Qinghai be granted me to keep the tribes in order, so that disloyal thoughts may never arise again.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that vacant Qinghai pasture be granted me to keep the tribes in hand, so that no disloyal thought may arise again.

sentences.zh: 」詔以青海貝子丹忠所遺博囉充克克牧地給之，並諭撫遠大將軍年羹堯遣員齎餉助徙牧。

translations.literal: " An edict granted him the Bolochunke pasture left by Qinghai beile Danzhong, and the Pacification General Nian Gengyao was instructed to send officials with provisions to assist the move.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict granted him the Bolochunke grazing grounds left by Qinghai beile Danzhong, and Pacification General Nian Gengyao was ordered to send men with rations to help the migration.

sentences.zh: 博囉充克克者，即漢書地理志所稱潢水也。

translations.literal: Bolochunke is the Huangshui River named in the Han shu's "Treatise on Geography."
translations.idiomatic: Bolochunke is the Huangshui River mentioned in the Han shu's "Treatise on Geography."

sentences.zh: 七年，阿寶以博囉充克克牧地隘，擅請徙烏蘭穆倫及額濟訥河界，議罪削爵。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Aboo, finding the Bolochunke pasture too narrow, on his own authority asked to move to the Ulan Moron and Ejin River border; officials proposed stripping his rank as punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Aboo, finding Bolochunke too cramped, privately requested a move to the Ulan Moron and Ejin River frontier; officials proposed demoting him as punishment.

sentences.zh: 尋命復之。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was ordered restored.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was ordered reinstated.

sentences.zh: 詔仍歸阿拉善牧，不復居青海。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him back to Alxa pasture; he was not to remain in Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent him back to graze in Alxa; he was no longer to live in Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 阿寶子袞布，八年，以所部兵赴巴里坤防準噶爾援樊廷，賊遁。

translations.literal: Aboo's son Gunbu, in the eighth year, led his tribesmen to Barkul to guard against Dzungar relief for Fan Ting; the rebels fled.
translations.idiomatic: Aboo's son Gunbu, in the eighth year, marched his tribesmen to Barkul to block Dzungar relief for Fan Ting; the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 九年，錄其勞，封輔國公。

translations.literal: In the ninth year his service was recorded and he was enfeoffed as fuguo gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year his merit was recorded and he was made fuguo gong.

sentences.zh: 十年，晉貝子。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to beizi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was raised to beizi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆六年，降襲爵之索諾木多爾濟為鎮國公。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 6 Sonom Dorji, who had inherited a reduced rank, was demoted to gurun gong.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 6 Sonom Dorji, who had succeeded to a lowered title, was reduced to gurun gong.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，二等台吉達瓦車淩從大軍剿危魯特竄黨，遇伏於博囉齊，奮擊之，陣歿。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year second-rank taiji Dawa Cheleng followed the main army in suppressing fugitive Oirat bands, met an ambush at Boluoqi, fought fiercely, and fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year second-rank taiji Dawa Cheleng joined the main army against fugitive Oirat bands, was ambushed at Boluoqi, fought hard, and died on the field.

sentences.zh: 詔議恤，入祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered posthumous honors and entry into the Zhaozhong Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted posthumous honors and enshrined him in the Zhaozhong Shrine.

sentences.zh: 先是阿寶屬達瑪琳從靖邊大將軍傅爾丹擊準噶爾於和通呼爾哈諾爾，為所掠。

translations.literal: Earlier Aboo's follower Damarin had followed Frontier-pacifying General Furdan in attacking the Dzungars at Khoto Khorkhanor and had been captured.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Aboo's man Damarin had followed Frontier-pacifying General Furdan against the Dzungars at Khoto Khorkhanor and was taken captive.

sentences.zh: 至是攜孥及屬布庫勒等四十戶詣都統雅爾哈善軍，請歸阿拉善舊牧。

translations.literal: Now he came with his family and more than forty households of followers including Bokule to the camp of commander Yalhishan, asking to return to their old Alxa pastures.
translations.idiomatic: Now he arrived with his family and more than forty households of followers, including Bokule, at commander Yalhishan's camp and asked to return to their former Alxa grazing grounds.

sentences.zh: 詔如所請，徒眾仍置伊犁。

translations.literal: An edict granted the request; the tribesmen were still placed at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request; the people were nevertheless settled at Ili.

sentences.zh: 所部一旗。

translations.literal: The department had one banner.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe comprised one banner.

sentences.zh: 爵三：曰扎薩克和碩親王，由貝勒晉襲；

translations.literal: There were three ranks: zasak hoshoi qinwang, advanced from beile by inheritance;
translations.idiomatic: Three titles: zasak hoshoi qinwang, raised from beile by succession;

sentences.zh: 附鎮國公二，一由貝子降襲，一由輔國公晉襲。

translations.literal: and two attached gurun gong — one by demotion from beizi, one by promotion from fuguo gong.
translations.idiomatic: with two attached gurun gong — one by demotion from beizi, one by promotion from fuguo gong.

sentences.zh: 阿寶次子羅卜藏多爾濟初襲貝勒。

translations.literal: Aboo's second son Lobzang Dorji at first inherited the beile rank.
translations.idiomatic: Aboo's second son Lobzang Dorji first succeeded to the beile title.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十一年，詔以兵赴北路。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 21 an edict ordered him to march to the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 21 an edict ordered him to the northern front.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以俘逆賊巴雅爾功，晉郡王，授參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, for capturing the rebel Bayar, he was promoted to junwang and appointed assistant minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, for capturing the rebel Bayar, he was raised to junwang and made assistant minister.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，以剿俘已叛宰桑恩克圖功，予雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, for suppressing and capturing the already-rebelled zaisang Enketu, he was granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, for defeating and capturing the rebel zaisang Enketu, he received the double-eyed peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，以台吉達瓦、佐領布岱等剿瑪哈沁及逆回布拉呢敦功，優賚之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, for the service of taiji Dawa, company officer Budai, and others in suppressing Mahaxin and the rebel Muslim Buranidun, he was richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, for taiji Dawa, company officer Budai, and others in suppressing Mahaxin and the rebel Muslim Buranidun, he received special rewards.

sentences.zh: 三十年，晉羅卜藏多爾濟親王。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year Lobzang Dorji was promoted to qinwang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Lobzang Dorji was raised to qinwang.

sentences.zh: 三十七年十一月，以甘肅民人私挖阿拉善旗哈布塔哈拉山金沙，命勒爾謹捕治之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the thirty-seventh year, because Gansu commoners were secretly mining gold sand on Habutahara Mountain in the Alxa banner, Le-erjin was ordered to arrest and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the thirty-seventh year, because Gansu civilians were illicitly mining gold on Habutahara Mountain in the Alxa banner, Le-erjin was ordered to seize and punish them.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，大軍剿薩拉爾逆回於華林寺，四十九年，又剿逆回於石峰堡邸店。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year the main army suppressed the rebel Muslims of Sarlar at Hualin Temple; in the forty-ninth year it again suppressed rebels at Shifeng Fort and Didian.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year the main army crushed Sarlar's rebel Muslims at Hualin Temple; in the forty-ninth year it again defeated rebels at Shifeng Fort and Didian.

sentences.zh: 是部皆以兵從，均有功。

translations.literal: This tribe followed with troops in every case and all performed meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: The tribe furnished troops in each campaign and all distinguished themselves.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，允阿拉善鹽由水路運至山西臨縣磧口。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year Alxa salt was permitted to be shipped by water to Qikou in Lin County, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year Alxa salt was allowed to be transported by water to Qikou in Lin County, Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，是部鹽入銀八千兩。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year this tribe's salt revenue amounted to eight thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year the tribe's salt income came to eight thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏多爾濟子旺沁班巴爾襲親王。

translations.literal: Lobzang Dorji's son Wangqin Bambal succeeded to the qinwang rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Dorji's son Wangqin Bambal inherited the qinwang title.

sentences.zh: 後嘗一為寧夏將軍，以袒庇屬人爭勘地界，罷之。

translations.literal: Later he once served as Ningxia General, but was dismissed for shielding his followers in a boundary dispute.
translations.idiomatic: He later served once as Ningxia General, but was removed for favoring his followers in a boundary survey.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，陝甘總督長麟奏徵是部征教匪兵歸其部。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing 4 Shaanxi-Gansu Governor Chang Lin memorialized that the troops of this tribe sent against the Teaching-bandits sect should be returned to their banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 Shaanxi-Gansu Governor Chang Lin memorialized that this tribe's troops sent against the Teaching-bandits should be returned to the banner.

sentences.zh: 五年，甘肅按察使姜開陽疏言：「中衛邊外有大小鹽池，今為阿拉善王所轄，其鹽潔白堅好，內地之民皆喜食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Gansu Surveillance Commissioner Jiang Kaiyang memorialized: "Beyond the Zhongwei frontier are large and small salt ponds, now under the Alxa prince's jurisdiction; the salt is clean, white, and firm, and people of the interior all prefer it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Gansu Surveillance Commissioner Jiang Kaiyang reported: "Beyond the Zhongwei frontier lie large and small salt ponds, now under the Alxa prince; the salt is bright, white, and hard, and inland people all favor it.

sentences.zh: 大約甘肅全省食阿拉善鹽者十分之六，陝西一省亦居其三。

translations.literal: Roughly six-tenths of all salt consumed in Gansu province is Alxa salt, and Shanxi province also accounts for three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: About six-tenths of Gansu's salt consumption is Alxa salt, and Shanxi accounts for another three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 聞阿拉善王但於兩池置官收稅，不論蒙古、漢人，聽其轉運，故於民甚便。

translations.literal: I hear that the Alxa prince merely places officials at the two ponds to collect tax, and whether Mongol or Han, all are free to transport it — hence it is very convenient for the people.
translations.idiomatic: I am told the Alxa prince only stations officials at the two ponds to collect tax, and Mongols and Han alike may transport freely — which makes it very convenient for the people.

sentences.zh: 私販甚多，駱駝牛騾什佰成群，持梃格鬥，吏役不敢呵止。

translations.literal: Smuggling is extensive: camels, oxen, and mules come in groups of tens and hundreds, and the carriers fight with clubs; clerks and runners dare not stop them.
translations.idiomatic: Smuggling is rampant — camels, cattle, and mules travel in bands of tens and hundreds, club-fighting as they go, while clerks and runners dare not intervene.

sentences.zh: 今擬令沿邊各州縣於各隘口鹽所從入之處，設局收稅，亦計所馱多少為稅之輕重。

translations.literal: It is now proposed that frontier prefectures and counties set up tax offices at each pass where salt enters, also calculating the load carried to determine the tax rate.
translations.idiomatic: It is proposed that frontier counties establish tax offices at each pass where salt enters, levying according to the size of each load.

sentences.zh: 彼所收者池稅，我所收者過稅，既無礙於阿拉善王，又易私販為官販，兩便之道。

translations.literal: What they collect is pond tax; what we collect is transit tax — this neither harms the Alxa prince nor replaces smuggling with official trade; it is a path that benefits both sides.
translations.idiomatic: They collect pond tax; we would collect transit tax — this would not harm the Alxa prince, yet would turn smuggling into official trade — a course that serves both sides.

sentences.zh: 」十一年，阿拉善王因回民私販麗法，獻其池歸官辦，置運判於磴口。

translations.literal: " In the eleventh year, because Hui people were smuggling salt in violation of the law, the Alxa prince surrendered his ponds to official management; a transport intendant was placed at Dengkou.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eleventh year, because Hui smugglers were breaking the salt laws, the Alxa prince offered his ponds for official operation; a transport intendant was stationed at Dengkou.

sentences.zh: 每年予阿拉善王銀八千兩，池屬寧夏道專管。

translations.literal: Each year eight thousand taels of silver were granted the Alxa prince; the ponds came under the exclusive management of the Ningxia circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Alxa prince was granted eight thousand taels of silver annually; the ponds were placed under the Ningxia circuit.

sentences.zh: 十七年，改歸商辦，酌定口岸，示以限制，改磴口大使為皇甫川大使，專司稽察。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year management was changed to merchant operation; crossing points were fixed and limits set; the Dengkou commissioner was replaced by a Huangfuchuan commissioner charged solely with inspection.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the ponds were turned over to merchant management; crossing points were fixed and limits posted; the Dengkou commissioner became the Huangfuchuan commissioner for inspection alone.

sentences.zh: 吉鹽水販止准運至皇甫川，以鹽池敕還阿拉善王，停其償歲，而以吉鹽八萬七千餘引配於潞引，由潞商包納吉課。

translations.literal: Ji salt carried by water might be transported only as far as Huangfuchuan; the salt ponds were returned by edict to the Alxa prince, his annual compensation was stopped, and more than eighty-seven thousand ji salt quotas were assigned to Lu quotas, with Lu merchants paying the Ji tax in a lump sum.
translations.idiomatic: Ji salt by water was limited to Huangfuchuan; the ponds were returned by edict to the Alxa prince, his yearly payment ceased, and more than eighty-seven thousand ji salt quotas were folded into Lu quotas, with Lu merchants paying the Ji levy in bulk.

sentences.zh: 咸豐四年七月，親王呈捐輸開採哈勒津庫察地方銀礦。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of Xianfeng 4 the prince memorialized offering to open silver mines at Khalejin Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Xianfeng 4 the prince offered to open silver mines at Khalejin Kucha as a contribution.

sentences.zh: 定甘肅收阿拉善鹽商稅濟軍餉。

translations.literal: It was decided that Gansu would collect merchant tax on Alxa salt to support military pay.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu was authorized to collect merchant tax on Alxa salt to fund military supplies.

sentences.zh: 同治初年，回匪滋事，屢徵是部兵協剿。

translations.literal: In the early Tongzhi years, when Muslim rebels rose in disorder, this tribe's troops were repeatedly summoned to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Tongzhi era, when Muslim rebels broke out, this tribe's troops were repeatedly called to help suppress them.

sentences.zh: 三年，阿拉善親王貢桑珠爾默特以匪擾寧夏，呈理籓院乞援。

translations.literal: In the third year Alxa qinwang Gunsangjuermete, because rebels were harassing Ningxia, memorialized the Court of Colonial Affairs begging for aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Alxa qinwang Gunsangjuermete, rebels having disturbed Ningxia, petitioned the Court of Colonial Affairs for relief.

sentences.zh: 時西路多警，是部設台遞送，南自甘、涼，西自額濟訥土爾扈特，軍報至烏拉特以達歸化。

translations.literal: At the time alarms were frequent on the western route; this tribe set up relay stations, carrying military reports south from Gan and Liang and west from the Ejin Torghut as far as Urad to reach Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: Alarms were frequent on the western route; the tribe established relay stations, carrying dispatches south from Gan and Liang and west from the Ejin Torghut through Urad to Guihua.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，都興阿軍大破回匪於平羅、寶豐，是旗協理台吉阿布哩亦敗撲入磨石口之匪。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year Duxinga's army routed the Muslim rebels at Pingluo and Baofeng, and the banner's assistant taiji Abuli also defeated rebels who had pushed into Moshi Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year Duxinga's army crushed the Muslim rebels at Pingluo and Baofeng, and the banner's assistant taiji Abuli also defeated rebels who had forced into Moshi Pass.

sentences.zh: 諭嘉獎貢桑珠爾默特，仍飭嚴防各口，兼辦駝運。

translations.literal: An edict praised Gunsangjuermete and again ordered strict defense of every pass, together with camel transport duty.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended Gunsangjuermete and again ordered every pass strictly guarded, with camel transport maintained as well.

sentences.zh: 七年，貢桑珠爾默特採買米麥濟穆圖善中鋪之軍，解耕牛一百餘只酌借貧民，俾時耕種。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Gunsangjuermete purchased grain to supply Mutushan's army at Zhongpu, and released more than a hundred plow oxen to be lent to the poor so they could sow on time.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Gunsangjuermete bought grain and wheat to supply Mutushan's army at Zhongpu, and lent more than a hundred plow oxen to the poor so they could farm in season.

sentences.zh: 四月奏入，上復嘉獎之。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived in the fourth month, the emperor again praised him.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial arrived in the fourth month, and the throne again commended him.

sentences.zh: 十二月，回匪由平羅竄是部，大肆劫掠，至磴口踞之，攻圍王府，殺傷官兵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Muslim rebels from Pingluo raided this tribe, looting on a great scale; they seized Dengkou, besieged the princely residence, and killed and wounded officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Muslim rebels from Pingluo broke into the tribe and looted widely; they occupied Dengkou, besieged the princely mansion, and killed and wounded troops.

sentences.zh: 貢桑珠爾默特復咨穆圖善乞援。

translations.literal: Gunsangjuermete again appealed to Mutushan for aid.
translations.idiomatic: Gunsangjuermete again petitioned Mutushan for relief.

sentences.zh: 八年，定安派蒙員烏爾罔那遜往是部烏蘭木頭地方剿陸路回匪。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Ding An dispatched the Mongol officer Urgunnason to this tribe's Ulan Mutou district to suppress overland Muslim rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Ding An sent the Mongol officer Urgunnason to the tribe's Ulan Mutou district to suppress overland Muslim rebels.

sentences.zh: 四月，屢敗回匪於下永和薑、上永和薑。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he repeatedly defeated Muslim rebels at Lower Yonghejiang and Upper Yonghejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he repeatedly routed Muslim rebels at Lower Yonghejiang and Upper Yonghejiang.

sentences.zh: 磴口踞匪還竄陝境。

translations.literal: The rebels occupying Dengkou fled back into Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels holding Dengkou fled back into Shaanxi territory.

sentences.zh: 是月董馬原回匪竄是部境，圍定遠營城，毀塚塋、府第、寺廟。

translations.literal: That month Dong Mayuan Muslim rebels raided this tribe's territory, besieged Dingyuan Camp city, and destroyed tombs, mansions, and temples.
translations.idiomatic: That month Dong Mayuan Muslim rebels entered the tribe's lands, besieged Dingyuan Camp, and destroyed graves, mansions, and temples.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾多斯與額濟訥河土爾扈特文報路斷，貢桑珠爾默特督蒙古官兵嬰城固守。

translations.literal: Communication with Ordos and the Ejin River Torghut was cut off; Gunsangjuermete led Mongol officers and soldiers in holding the city under siege.
translations.idiomatic: Routes to Ordos and the Ejin River Torghut were severed; Gunsangjuermete commanded Mongol troops in defending the city under siege.

sentences.zh: 七月九日，提督張曜遣部將楊春祥等率兵解定遠城之圍，匪退廣宗寺，又敗之，越山遁。

translations.literal: On the ninth day of the seventh month Regional Commander Zhang Yao sent his officers Yang Chunxiang and others with troops to lift the siege of Dingyuan; the rebels withdrew to Guangzong Temple, were defeated again, and fled over the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth day of the seventh month Regional Commander Zhang Yao sent officers Yang Chunxiang and others to relieve Dingyuan; the rebels fell back to Guangzong Temple, were beaten again, and escaped over the mountains.

sentences.zh: 次日，楊春祥等進軍賀蘭山。

translations.literal: The next day Yang Chunxiang and the others advanced toward Helan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The following day Yang Chunxiang and his men marched toward Helan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 八月，金順進軍磴口，遂次平羅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Jin Shun advanced on Dengkou and then encamped at Pingluo.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Jin Shun marched on Dengkou and then stationed at Pingluo.

sentences.zh: 九月，張曜抵寧夏，沿途之沙金托海、三道河、磴口、石嘴山等處皆駐官軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Zhang Yao reached Ningxia; government troops were posted all along the route at Shajintuohai, Sandaohe, Dengkou, Shizuishan, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Zhang Yao arrived at Ningxia; imperial troops were stationed along the way at Shajintuohai, Sandaohe, Dengkou, Shizuishan, and other points.

sentences.zh: 九年十一月，回匪復竄阿拉善南界之紅井一帶，貢桑珠爾默特派副佐領鄂肯會官軍副將郝永剛等敗之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the ninth year Muslim rebels again raided the Hongjing district on Alxa's southern border; Gunsangjuermete dispatched deputy company officer Eken to join Vice General Hao Yonggang and others in defeating them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the ninth year Muslim rebels again broke into the Hongjing area on Alxa's southern frontier; Gunsangjuermete sent deputy company officer Eken to join Vice General Hao Yonggang and others in defeating them.

sentences.zh: 匪竄永磴口，掠阿拉善，復設台站十一處。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Yongdengkou, raided Alxa, and relay stations were again established at eleven places.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled toward Yongdengkou, plundered Alxa, and eleven relay stations were set up again.

sentences.zh: 十年五月，金順奏：「寧夏山后阿拉善旗有西來竄賊劫掠。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year Jin Shun memorialized: "West of the mountains behind Ningxia, in Alxa banner, raiders coming from the west have been plundering.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year Jin Shun reported: "Behind the mountains west of Ningxia, in Alxa banner, raiders from the west have been looting the country.

sentences.zh: 現籌於南北要衝磴口、橫城等處派隊扼紮。

translations.literal: We are now planning to dispatch detachments to hold the vital passes north and south, at Dengkou, Hengcheng, and other points.
translations.idiomatic: We are now arranging to post detachments at the key north-south crossings—Dengkou, Hengcheng, and the like—to block them.

sentences.zh: 」十一年，賽盟阿爾米畢特旗竄來回匪至沙爾雜一帶，張曜以阿拉善王請兵剿辦，令孫金彪分紮柳林湖一帶，兼顧蒙地。

translations.literal: " In the eleventh year Muslim rebels from the Sayin Noyon Alimbiit banner raided as far as the Sharza district. At the Alxa prince's request for troops to suppress them, Zhang Yao ordered Sun Jinbiao to post a separate detachment around Liulin Lake, covering Mongol territory as well.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eleventh year Muslim rebels from the Sayin Noyon Alimbiit banner broke into the Sharza region. At the Alxa prince's request for troops to suppress them, Zhang Yao ordered Sun Jinbiao to station a detachment around Liulin Lake, with an eye to Mongol lands as well.

sentences.zh: 是年八月，陝甘總督左宗棠奏准蒙鹽仍祗從一條山、五卡寺至皋蘭、靖遠、條城，經安定、會寧、隴西、秦州，轉運漢南一帶銷售，每百斤收稅銀、釐銀各八分。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of that year Shaan-Gan Governor-General Zuo Zongtang memorialized and received approval that Mongol salt would still be sold only via transport from Yitiao Mountain and Wukasi Temple to Gaolan, Jingyuan, and Tiaocheng, then through Anding, Huining, Longxi, and Qinzhou for sale in the Han south region, with a tax of eight fen each in silver tax and lijin silver per hundred jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of that year Shaan-Gan Governor-General Zuo Zongtang memorialized and received approval that Mongol salt would still be marketed only along the route from Yitiao Mountain and Wukasi Temple to Gaolan, Jingyuan, and Tiaocheng, then through Anding, Huining, Longxi, and Qinzhou for sale in the Han south, with eight fen each in tax silver and lijin silver levied per hundred jin.

sentences.zh: 十三年四月，袁保恆奏：「寧夏采運，須取道阿拉善額濟訥蒙古草地，以達巴里坤。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirteenth year Yuan Baoheng memorialized: "Ningxia grain procurement and transport must pass through Alxa and Ejin Mongol pasturelands to reach Barkol.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirteenth year Yuan Baoheng reported: "Ningxia grain collection and transport must run through Alxa and Ejin Mongol pasturelands to reach Barkol.

sentences.zh: 而額濟訥牧地近年被匪蹂躪最深，無可藉資，必以阿拉善駝只為主。

translations.literal: But Ejin pasture has suffered the heaviest rebel ravages in recent years and affords no resources to rely upon; Alxa camels must serve as the mainstay.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Ejin grazing grounds have been ravaged by rebels more severely than anywhere else in recent years and offer nothing to draw on; Alxa camels must be the mainstay.

sentences.zh: 當飭阿拉善協理台吉派員來甯商辦。

translations.literal: I shall order the Alxa assistant taiji to send officers to Ningxia to discuss arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: The Alxa assistant taiji will be instructed to send men to Ningxia to work out the details.

sentences.zh: 臣與管旗章京瑪呢阿爾得那籌擬，按程設立三十四台，專司帶領道路。

translations.literal: I, together with banner secretary Mani'arde'na, have drawn up plans to establish thirty-four relay stations by route, solely responsible for guiding the road.
translations.idiomatic: Together with banner secretary Mani'arde'na I have planned thirty-four relay stations along the route, devoted entirely to guiding travelers.

sentences.zh: 另雇蒙駝一千五百，民駝五百，各以五百任運一段，班轉遞運，每次可運官斛八百石，限四十月運至巴里坤，間二十日由寧夏發運一次。

translations.literal: In addition we shall hire fifteen hundred Mongol camels and five hundred civilian camels; five hundred will carry each segment in rotational relay transport. Each shipment can move eight hundred shi of official grain, to reach Barkol within forty months, with one dispatch from Ningxia every twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: We shall also hire fifteen hundred Mongol camels and five hundred civilian ones, five hundred carrying each leg in rotating relays. Each run can move eight hundred shi of official grain, reaching Barkol within forty months, with a convoy leaving Ningxia every twenty days.

sentences.zh: 」諭左宗棠酌度情形，派員赴寧夏接辦。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Zuo Zongtang to weigh the circumstances and send officers to Ningxia to take over the project.
translations.idiomatic: " The court ordered Zuo Zongtang to judge the situation and dispatch officers to Ningxia to take over.

sentences.zh: 光緒四年七月，以關內外肅清，裁阿拉善所設台站。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of Guangxu 4, as inner and outer regions had been pacified, the relay stations established in Alxa were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Guangxu 4, with order restored inside and outside the passes, the relay stations set up in Alxa were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳匪滋事，阿拉善亦出教案。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxers rose in rebellion, and Alxa also saw an anti-missionary incident.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxers stirred up trouble, and Alxa saw an anti-missionary case as well.

sentences.zh: 二十七年三月，予各省官員上年保教不力懲處，阿拉善親王貢桑珠爾默特傳旨申飭。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year officials of every province who had failed to protect missions the previous year were punished; the Alxa prince Gunsangjuermete was summoned to receive an imperial reprimand by edict.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year officials in every province who had failed to protect missions the year before were punished; the Alxa prince Gunsangjuermete was called in to receive an imperial rebuke.

sentences.zh: 其後是部三道河一帶教堂租種地畝益多，引河為渠，開田萬頃，日以富饒。

translations.literal: Afterward in this department's Sandaohe district church-leased farmland grew steadily; channels were cut from the river and ten thousand qing of fields opened, day by day growing more prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, in the Sandaohe district of this department, church-leased acreage steadily increased; channels were drawn from the river and ten thousand qing of land opened, and the area grew richer by the day.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，督辦鹽政大臣載澤奏：「山西行銷蒙鹽，西路以阿拉善為主，以鄂爾多斯輔之。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 2 Supervising Salt Administrator Zaize memorialized: "For Mongol salt sold in Shanxi, the western route relies chiefly on Alxa, with Ordos in support.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 Supervising Salt Administrator Zaize reported: "For Mongol salt marketed in Shanxi, the western route depends chiefly on Alxa, with Ordos as supplement.

sentences.zh: 有礦，有林木，幅員廣闊。

translations.literal: It has minerals, forests, and a broad domain.
translations.idiomatic: It has mines, timber, and a vast territory.

sentences.zh: 其北毗連賽盟南境各旗，南鄰甘肅鎮番等九縣，為漠南蒙古大部落。

translations.literal: On the north it adjoins the southern banners of the Sayin Noyon league; on the south it borders nine Gansu counties including Zhenfan—it is a great tribe of Inner Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: To the north it meets the southern banners of the Sayin Noyon league; to the south it neighbors nine Gansu counties including Zhenfan—a major tribe of Inner Mongolia.

sentences.zh: 自為一部，不設盟，受寧夏將軍節制。

translations.literal: It forms a department of its own, with no league; it falls under the Ningxia general's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: It stands as a department in its own right, without a league, and is subject to the Ningxia general.

sentences.zh: 」有佐領八。

translations.literal: It had eight zuoling.
translations.idiomatic: It had eight zuoling.

sentences.zh: 額濟訥，舊土爾扈特部，在阿拉善旗之西。

translations.literal: Ejin was the old Torghut department, west of Alxa banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ejin was the former Torghut department, lying west of Alxa banner.

sentences.zh: 東古爾鼐，南甘肅毛目縣丞地，北阿濟山，東南合黎山，南與東北、西北皆大戈壁，當甘肅省甘州府及肅州邊外。

translations.literal: East was Gur Na; south, the Gansu Maomu sub-prefectural district; north, Aji Mountain; southeast, Heli Mountain; south, northeast, and northwest were all great deserts. It lay beyond the borders of Ganzhou and Suzhou prefectures in Gansu province.
translations.idiomatic: East lay Gur Na; south, the Maomu sub-prefectural district of Gansu; north, Aji Mountain; southeast, Heli Mountain; and to the south, northeast, and northwest stretched great deserts. It stood beyond the frontier of Ganzhou and Suzhou prefectures in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 系出翁罕六世孫，曰瑪哈齊蒙古。

translations.literal: The line descended from the sixth-generation descendant of Ong Khan, called Makachi Mongol.
translations.idiomatic: The line went back to the sixth-generation descendant of Ong Khan, known as Makachi Mongol.

sentences.zh: 有子二：長曰貝果鄂爾勒克，有曾孫曰書庫爾岱青。

translations.literal: He had two sons: the elder was Beigu Oorlog; he had a great-grandson named Shuku'erdaiqing.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons: the elder was Beigu Oorlog, and among his descendants was a great-grandson named Shuku'erdaiqing.

sentences.zh: 第四子曰納木第淩，生納扎爾瑪穆特，為土爾扈特阿玉奇汗族弟。

translations.literal: The fourth son was Namjiling; he fathered Nanzar Mamut, cousin to Torghut Khan Ayuqi.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth son was Namjiling, who fathered Nanzar Mamut—a kinsman of Torghut Khan Ayuqi.

sentences.zh: 阿玉奇汗遊牧額勒濟河。

translations.literal: Khan Ayuqi pastured along the Elet River.
translations.idiomatic: Khan Ayuqi grazed along the Elet River.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，詔封納扎爾瑪木特之子阿喇布珠爾為固山貝子，賜牧色爾騰。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 4 an edict enfeoffed Nanzar Mamt's son Alabuzhur as a gushan beile and granted him pasture at Sereng.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 an edict enfeoffed Nanzar Mamt's son Alabuzhur as gushan beile and granted him pasture at Sereng.

sentences.zh: 先是阿喇布珠爾嘗假道準噶爾謁達賴喇嘛，既而阿玉奇與準噶爾策妄阿喇布坦修怨，阿喇布珠爾自唐古特還，以準噶爾道梗，留嘉峪關外，遣使至京師。

translations.literal: Earlier Alabuzhur had traveled through Dzungar territory to pay homage to the Dalai Lama. Later Ayuqi and the Dzungar Tsewang Araptan renewed their feud. Alabuzhur returned from Tangut, but with the Dzungar route blocked he remained beyond Jiayuguan and sent envoys to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Alabuzhur had passed through Dzungar lands to visit the Dalai Lama. Later Ayuqi and the Dzungar Tsewang Araptan fell out again. Alabuzhur came back from Tangut, but with the Dzungar road cut he stayed beyond Jiayuguan and sent envoys to the capital.

sentences.zh: 上憫其無歸，故有是命。

translations.literal: The emperor pitied him for having no home to return to, hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took pity on his homelessness, and so this appointment was made.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，阿喇布珠爾奏請從軍效力，詔率兵五百駐噶斯。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year Alabuzhur memorialized requesting to serve in the army; he was ordered to lead five hundred men stationed at Gas.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year Alabuzhur asked to serve in the field; he was ordered to lead five hundred men garrisoned at Gas.

sentences.zh: 旋卒，子丹衷襲。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died, and his son Danzhong succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after, and his son Danzhong inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，來朝，晉貝勒。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 7 he came to court and was promoted to beile.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 he came to court and was raised to beile.

sentences.zh: 九年，以色爾騰牧通噶斯之察罕齊老圖，懼準噶爾掠，乞內徙。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because pasture at Sereng connected with Chahan Qilaotu near Gas, fearing Dzungar raids he begged to move inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, because Sereng pasture adjoined Chahan Qilaotu near Gas, he feared Dzungar raids and pleaded to move inward.

sentences.zh: 陝甘總督查郎阿令攜戚屬遊牧阿拉克山、阿勒坦特卜什等處，尋定牧額濟訥河。

translations.literal: Shaan-Gan Governor-General Zhalang'a ordered him to bring his kinsmen to graze at Alak Mountain, Altan Tebshi, and other places; pasture was soon fixed along the Ejin River.
translations.idiomatic: Shaan-Gan Governor-General Zhalang'a ordered him to move his kin to graze at Alak Mountain, Altan Tebshi, and elsewhere; pasture was soon fixed along the Ejin River.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十八年，予世襲罔替。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 48 perpetual hereditary rank was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 48 he was granted perpetual hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 同治中，回匪滋事，陷肅州。

translations.literal: During the Tongzhi reign Muslim rebels rose and captured Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongzhi reign Muslim rebels rose in rebellion and took Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 是部與連境，蹂躪特重。

translations.literal: As this department shared a border with them, devastation was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Because this department bordered them, the destruction was especially heavy.

sentences.zh: 時西路文報梗，是部設台站，遞至阿拉善以達歸化。

translations.literal: At that time western-route dispatches were blocked; the department established relay stations relaying to Alxa and on to Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: At that time dispatches on the western route were cut off; the department set up relay stations, handing messages on to Alxa and thence to Guihua.

sentences.zh: 九年以後，肅州回匪累出擾是部境以北，竄賽、紮兩盟，犯烏里雅蘇臺、科布多。

translations.literal: After the ninth year Suzhou Muslim rebels repeatedly raided north of this department's territory, breaking into the Sayin Noyon and Jasaktu leagues and striking Uliastai and Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: After the ninth year Suzhou Muslim rebels repeatedly harried the country north of this department, breaking into the Sayin Noyon and Jasaktu leagues and raiding Uliastai and Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 福濟、定安、張廷嶽先後奏：「賊匪皆來自土爾扈特貝勒遊牧，請飭左宗棠撥軍防剿。

translations.literal: Fu Ji, Ding An, and Zhang Tingyue memorialized in succession: "The bandits all come from Torghut beile pasturelands; we request that Zuo Zongtang be ordered to dispatch troops for defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ji, Ding An, and Zhang Tingyue reported in turn: "The bandits all issue from Torghut beile grazing grounds; we ask that Zuo Zongtang be ordered to send troops to guard against and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 」十二年，是部貝勒達什車淩以防堵回匪陣亡。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth year the department's beile Dashiling was killed in battle while blocking Muslim rebels.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twelfth year the department's beile Dashiling fell in battle while holding Muslim rebels at bay.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，大學士陝甘總督左宗棠為請恤。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 5 Grand Secretary and Shaan-Gan Governor-General Zuo Zongtang petitioned for posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 5 Grand Secretary and Shaan-Gan Governor-General Zuo Zongtang petitioned for posthumous honors on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 十二月，贈郡王銜，予恤銀一千一百兩。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was posthumously granted the rank of junwang and given one thousand one hundred taels in condolence silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was posthumously granted the rank of junwang and awarded one thousand one hundred taels in condolence silver.

sentences.zh: 三十年，延祉等迎護達賴喇嘛往西寧，經是部。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year Yan Qi and others escorted the Dalai Lama west to Xining, passing through this department.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Yan Qi and others escorted the Dalai Lama westward to Xining, traveling through this department.

sentences.zh: 地雜戈壁，較諸部為瘠苦，北接紮盟南境。

translations.literal: The land is largely Gobi and is poorer than the other departments; on the north it adjoins the southern border of the Jasaktu league.
translations.idiomatic: The terrain is mostly Gobi and poorer than the other departments; to the north it meets the southern frontier of the Jasaktu league.

sentences.zh: 各旗有佐領一，不設盟長，受陝甘總督節制。

translations.literal: Each banner had one zuoling; there was no league chief, and it was under Shaan-Gan governor-general jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Each banner had one zuoling; no league chief was appointed, and the department answered to the Shaan-Gan governor-general.
